About us
WEX is a global commerce platform that helps businesses solve operational complexities like employee benefits, managing and mobilizing fleets, and streamlining payments.
With over 5,500 employees, we work with large and small companies in more than 200 countries and territories, and can tailor our services to meet the unique needs of their businesses.

About the Team

The Technical Program Management Office (TPMO) is a strategic function of the Technology Innovation & Strategic Operations (TISO) department within WEX. Our mission is to accelerate WEX’s product innovation velocity by optimizing how we deliver technology.
As part of the TPMO, you will work closely with Technology and Digital leadership to enable seamless execution of strategic priorities. We drive impact by aligning teams across departments, supporting proactive planning, risk mitigation, and cross-functional coordination to ensure successful delivery of critical initiatives. If you are passionate about systems thinking, innovation, and making technology delivery a competitive advantage, this team is for you.

​

About the opportunity
A Technical Program Manager is a key partner to the Technology leaders and their Digital leadership counterparts in driving end-to-end outcomes. You will be responsible for driving delivery on key initiatives within and across Technology Departments. As a Senior TPM at WEX, you will be responsible for enabling your teams and partners to plan, de-risk, and execute critical initiatives while reporting on progress, coordinating across technology teams, and ensuring project financial health. This role will focus primarily on a portfolio of work, and execution of projects within that, to enhance internal tooling and services for WEX employees.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Fluency: Demonstrate strong technical competency in relevant technologies and systems to effectively communicate with engineering teams, understand technical challenges, and make informed recommendations and escalations.

  • Program Planning/Continuous Planning: Based on Product and Technology leadership direction and priorities, facilitate ongoing planning sessions to adjust priorities and ensure continuous alignment with business goals within and across your portfolio. This will require close cross-functional partnership with technology team leaders, solution architects, and product partners. Ensure alignment of program increments with overall business goals and priorities. Encourage adaptive planning to respond to changing delivery and project requirements.

  • Program Management: Own and drive end-to-end technical implementation programs and workstreams focused on enhancements to internal tooling for WEX employees. Your work will be critical to creating operational efficiencies within the organization and to execute against several key strategic focus areas. You’ll create detailed work breakdowns, milestones, risks, success metrics, and deliverables for key initiatives in these areas, and execute multi-quarter roadmaps in partnership with engineering leadership. On an ongoing basis, plan, support and execute against a roadmap of enhancements to these systems, tools, and processes.

  • Execution Management: In support of the Tech Lead, monitor progress and recommend necessary adjustments to surface risks of program execution to key stakeholders in a targeted and timely way, with the goal of course correction. Facilitate these course corrections, as needed.

  • Stakeholder Management: Engage with stakeholders - Technology, Product, Solution Architecture, among others - at all levels to ensure visibility, provide updates, and address concerns. Facilitate communication between teams, ensuring transparency and alignment. Provide clear, consistent, and timely information flow and reports out on status.

  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies in partnership with accountable Tech and Product leaders. Monitor program risks and implement corrective actions as necessary. Escalate to senior leadership as appropriate.

  • Dependency Management: Identify, document, and manage dependencies across multiple projects, technologies, and teams. Proactively coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that dependencies are clearly understood, tracked, and addressed in a timely manner to minimize risks and avoid delays.

  • Tooling and Data Hygiene: Accordingly, ensure the use of standard project management tools - ideally within the Atlassian suite - and maintain high standards of data hygiene to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity. Avoid duplication of administrative effort. As a part of Jira stewardship, support accurate and transparent reporting and on-target capitalization within the organization through reporting and partnership.

  • Delivery and Outcome Tracking: Track program performance against the committed plan and goals. Use data and metrics to drive decision-making and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Education: BS/BA Degree in technical/information science or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • Experience: Strong experience in technical program management overseeing key projects with high visibility to internal or external customers, with a high degree of complexity and inter-dependent work.

    • An ideal candidate blends technical acumen with strong program management skills to drive execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, bring structure and clarity to fast-paced environments, and excel at scaling cross-functional programs. With a deep understanding of the requirements of an Enterprise-wide effort, they are passionate about implementing solutions with lasting value for the company, and in service to that, developing plans and communicating effectively with senior stakeholders.

Technical Skills:

  • Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including hands-on experience with various phases, and ability to work closely with cross-functional teams including product, engineers, security, database administrators, and architects to help ensure alignment with best practices.

  • Solid understanding of, and detailed experience with, common internal organizational tools for email, chat, work management, project management, product ideation, continuous integration and delivery of software, and workspace management.

  • Strong familiarity with technologies and processes associated with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Experience driving highly technical transformation initiatives that represent new ways of working for cross-functional teams in various areas and disciplines.

  • Demonstrated expertise in at least one Agile methodology (e.g., Scrum).

    • Leadership and Communication: Proactive leadership, and confidence to drive results. Proven ability to motivate cross-functional teams. Model close partnership, with an emphasis on execution, collaboration, and empowerment. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

    • Problem-Solving: Ability to anticipate risks and effectively mitigate them. If risks then become issues, solve these complex problems efficiently in partnership with Digital and Technology leadership. Analytical mindset with strong decision-making capabilities.

​

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications: Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Agile Certified Practitioner).

  • Previous experience in FinTech or highly regulated environments.

  • Hands-on familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, Google Drive, etc.

jobs.description:
Supplax — це американська компанія з українським серцем, яка вже понад 5 років активно розвивається на ринку.Ми виконуємо роль віддаленого бек-офісу для майстрів у США, що спеціалізуються на ремонтних роботах. Наша команда повністю бере на себе всі організаційні та операційні процеси, окрім самих ремонтних робіт. Серед них: маркетинг, продажі, управління командами майстрів, контроль якості, збір відгуків, навчання технічного персоналу тощо. Працюємо у 25 найбільших містах США та вже успішно реалізували понад 20000 ремонтних проєктів.

Детальніше про компанію ти можеш дізнатися за посиланням , де ознайомишся з нашою метою, критеріями, перевагами, а також відео-відгуками про роботу в Supplax від наших співробітників.

Ми активно масштабуємось і шукаємо сильного бізнес-асистента в команду.

Основні задачі:
  • Процеси: оптимізація бізнес-процесів, написання регламентів, контроль ClickUp.
  • Координація: управління календарем команди, фіксація рішень і контроль рішень та домовленостей.
  • Аналітика: збір даних, участь у створенні дешбордів та моніторинг KPI бізнесу.
  • Автоматизація: впровадження нових сервісів, розробка ТЗ для розробників, контроль виконання.
  • Комунікація і сапорт компанії: контроль міжвідділової комунікації, виконання задач на запит бізнеса.
Вимоги до кандидата:
  • Досвід: 2+ роки (Business Assistant, PM)
  • Хард-скіли: Google Work Space, досвід з таск-менеджерами, вільне володіння AI-інструментами, СРМ.
  • Технологічність: здатність самостійно і швидко розібратися з будь-яким софтом (CRM, менеджери паролів тощо) з нуля.
  • Софт-скіли: відповідальність, критичне мислення, автономність та лідерський потенціал.
Що ти отримаєш, ставши частиною Supplax:
  • Повну зайнятість та п’ятиденний робочий тиждень.
  • Віддалений формат роботи.
  • Графік роботи: 9:00-18:00 за Києвом.
  • Повноцінне навчання та занурення у специфіку роботи.
  • Заробітну плату, що складається зі ставки і бонусів, виплата в $.
  • Кар'єрний ріст завдяки високим результатам роботи.

Наша команда налічує понад 100 фахівців та повністю бере на себе всі організаційні та операційні процеси, окрім самих ремонтних робіт. Серед них: маркетинг, продажі, управління командами майстрів, контроль якості, збір відгуків, навчання технічного персоналу тощо. Працюємо у 30+ найбільших містах США та вже успішно реалізували понад 30 000 ремонтних проєктів.


Детальніше про компанію ти можеш дізнатися за посиланням . Ти ознайомишся з нашою метою, критеріями, перевагами, а також відео-відгуками про роботу в Supplax від наших співробітників.

Ми активно масштабуємо команду рекрутингу та шукаємо Talent Sourcer, який буде працювати з комерційними вакансіями та будувати сильну воронку кандидатів через різні канали пошуку.


Це роль для людини, яка любить системний сорсинг, працює з даними та хоче впливати не лише на пошук кандидатів, а й на стратегію сорсингу в компанії.

Ця роль для тебе, якщо ти:

  • Не чекаєш поки кандидат прийде сам, а знаєш, де шукати справжні таланти;

  • Boolean\X-Ray search— основний інструмент в твоїй роботі;

  • Ти вмієш зацікавити кандидата з першого речення і не знаєш, що таке copy\paste;

  • Ти не просто скролиш стрічку, а працюєш з цифрами, розумієш конверсію воронки та тестуєш гіпотези.

Твої задачі

  • Працювати одночасно з 4–5 активними вакансіями (Sales / Digital / Operations напрямки).

  • Щодня робити якісні персоналізовані контакти через LinkedIn та інші канали.

  • Використовувати різні джерела пошуку: LinkedIn, Boolean/X-Ray search, AI-інструменти, професійні спільноти, job boards.

  • Вносити всі дані по кандидатах у внутрішню ATS-систему компанії та підтримувати порядок у воронці.

  • Проводити первинну оцінку кандидатів перед передачею рекрутеру.

  • Брати участь у формуванні та покращенні стратегії сорсингу.

  • Аналізувати ефективність каналів і підходів та пропонувати покращення.

Тобі точно підійде, якщо ти:

  • Маєш 1+ рік досвіду в сорсингу або рекрутингу.

  • Вмієш працювати з Boolean Search та X-Ray Search.

  • Використовуєш AI-інструменти для пошуку та підвищення ефективності.

  • Маєш англійську від рівня A2+ для роботи з кандидатами та платформами.

  • Мислиш через метрики (response rate, conversion, швидкість наповнення воронки).

Що ти отримаєш, ставши частиною Supplax:

  • Стабільний дохід в $: ставка (обговорюється на співбесіді) + бонуси за результативність.

  • Зручний формат: 100% віддалена робота з будь-якої точки світу.

  • Графік: Пн–Пт, 8-годинний робочий день. Субота та неділя — вихідні.

  • Роботу з сучасною ATS-системою та AI-інструментами.

  • 20 робочих днів відпустки + вихідні на основні свята США + 5 лікарняних;

  • Менторство, підтримку керівника та живу командну культуру, де кожен має голос.

Якщо ці пункти про тебе — Supplax чекає саме на твій відгук!

jobs.excerpt: About TruegenicsTruegenics Pte Ltd is a leading e-commerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales.
jobs.description:
About Truegenics

Truegenics Pte Ltd is a leading e-commerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales. We specialize in e-retailing our own brand of health supplements to a global audience.
We strive to create value and make a positive difference in the world, one life at a time. We believe that even the smallest action can define one’s destiny, and we are committed to creating products that enhance the lives of our consumers.

Why This Role Matters

We are looking for a Senior Graphic & Web Designer who is passionate about creating meaningful brand experiences. Someone who combines creativity with technical precision and takes full ownership of their work.
You will be the visual voice of our brands, shaping how our products look, feel, and perform across packaging and web experiences. This is a fully remote role, so clear communication, strong collaboration, and accountability are key to your success.
You will partner closely with the marketing, copywriting, and sales teams to create designs that not only look exceptional but also deliver measurable results, driving conversions, strengthening brand reputation, and deepening customer loyalty.

Mission of the Role

To elevate Truegenics’ visual identity across all touchpoints by ensuring every design supports business objectives, reinforces brand integrity, and resonates with our target audience.
As a senior creative, you will lead by example, maintaining design excellence, guiding junior team members, and setting high standards for creativity, performance, and consistency across all brands.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic & Packaging Design (30%)

  • Conceptualize and execute creative ideas for digital and packaging projects based on brand direction, marketing briefs, and customer experience principles.
  • Design and adapt packaging across product lines using established brand templates, ensuring consistency while introducing fresh variations for new launches.
  • Create digital design assets for websites, social media, emails, and campaigns that engage users and drive conversions.
  • Maintain a strong and consistent visual identity across all design outputs, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and marketing objectives.
  • Develop and evolve key brand visuals including logos, icons, color systems, typography, and layout frameworks.
  • Translate marketing strategies into visually compelling campaigns that strengthen brand equity and support sales growth.
  • Mentor and guide junior designers, providing clear feedback and creative direction to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Research and incorporate emerging design trends, creative formats, and audience insights to keep the brand relevant and competitive.

Web Design & Frontend Development (70%)

  • Design and develop responsive, high-performing web pages with a strong mobile-first approach, ensuring layouts, navigation, and performance are optimized for mobile users.
  • Collaborate with marketing, media, and copywriting teams to design and optimize eCommerce landing pages that convert effectively across devices.
  • Apply UX/UI best practices to build layouts that are visually engaging, intuitive to navigate, and optimized for performance.
  • Develop reusable page templates and modular design systems to improve speed, consistency, and scalability.
  • Ensure all web assets meet quality standards for responsiveness, accessibility, and loading performance.
  • Coordinate the execution of promotional web materials, ensuring accuracy, brand consistency, and timely delivery.
  • Review and refine the work of junior designers, providing constructive feedback that enhances both creative quality and execution.

Key Requirements

  • Strong portfolio showcasing both digital and web design work. Clear examples of mobile-first design projects will be a plus.
  • Expertise in responsive and mobile UX/UI design, including optimizing layouts, images, and performance for smaller screens.
  • Experience using AI tools to streamline creative processes, generate ideas, or enhance productivity (for example, generating layout variations, assisting with copy, or automating production tasks).
  • Willingness to learn, explore, and adopt new AI tools to improve design quality and efficiency.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present ideas, feedback, and updates clearly in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Self-driven, highly organized, and accountable to deadlines.
  • Skilled in managing multiple projects while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Comfortable collaborating through digital tools and workflows such as Figma, Slack, and Wrike.

Working Arrangement

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates who can collaborate effectively across digital platforms and time zones.

The potential hire must also be equipped with the following to carry out this role effectively:

  • Laptop / CPU with acceptable speed
  • At least 1 monitor screen (inclusive of laptop screen)
  • Headset with Mic (Noise cancelling)
  • Webcam
  • Designated Workstation
  • Stable and strong power and internet connectivity
  • Noise-free and conducive environment

***This is a remote position. You may work from a remote home office location anywhere in the Eastern or Central US time zones***

Wolters Kluwer is a leading provider of innovative tax and accounting software solutions, dedicated to empowering individuals and businesses with tools that streamline financial management and enhance compliance. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional value to our clients through cutting-edge technology and unparalleled customer service.

As a Global Account Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining and growing Tax and Accounting’s largest Global customers in North America. You will be responsible for managing 4-8 customers, developing and executing comprehensive sales strategies, expanding our overall relationship and partnership within the firm. In this high visibility role, you will establish and maintain senior level relationships that aid in driving the partnership into the future. You will be accountable for all new business and retention activity and sales for Tax and Accounting’s software and research products and services for these customers. Additionally, you will also be responsible for interacting, influencing and updating senior executives within Tax and Accounting on status and progress of overall relationship with the firm. Specific job responsibilities are outlined below:

What You’ll Do

  • Customer Knowledge: Through partnership with the firm, establish and maintain a consistent knowledge of the customers' global goals and objectives, both short term and long term, linking these objectives to our product strategy and vision to help them in the present and future state of their firm.
  • Product Expertise: Maintain a deep understanding of our software solutions, features, and benefits, enabling effective communication and demonstration of value to potential customers.
  • Sales Strategy Development: Formulate and execute a comprehensive global sales strategy to achieve revenue targets for new business and retention and expand penetration in the tax and accounting sector for both software and research.
  • Executive Relationship Management: Cultivate and maintain relationships with senior executives in North America and globally (where appropriate) and decision-makers at key accounts, understanding their business needs and aligning our solutions to drive value. This will also include key senior executives within Tax and Accounting to ensure we are developing and maintaining strong, collaborative executive relationships between our company and the firm.
  • Competitive Awareness: Maintain constant awareness of the global competitive market, including all competitive products and services firms are using or evaluating to solve their business needs. This would include product functionality, pricing and global market positioning.
  • Account Planning: Through extensive knowledge of the firm, facilitate timely customer Account Planning sessions with both client and internal stakeholders to align on the vision of our partnership into the future.
  • Sales Presentation and Negotiation: Deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals, effectively communicating our value proposition, pricing and ROI. Effectively negotiate contracts and close deals that contribute to revenue growth, partnering closely with our product team, ensuring profitability. Collaborating on and co-creating contracts with our legal team ensuring compliance with company policies and practices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with marketing, product development, and customer success teams to ensure alignment on messaging, product features, and client feedback.

Other duties:

  • Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor
  • Consistent and accurate forecasting of new business and retention
  • Ongoing and consistent salesforce.com compliance with pipeline management
  • Consistent communication with sales leadership
  • Attend key customer and industry conferences

What You bring

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA preferred

Minimum Experience:

  • Experience: 12+ years of B2B sales or account management/client relationship management experience with a focus on Enterprise software solutions in a comparable role, including proven track record of exceeding sales targets in a global market. Prior sales of Tax & Accounting applications/software solutions is preferred
  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of financial regulations, tax compliance, and accounting practices. Ability to translate complex concepts into actionable business strategies.
  • Sales Skills: Exceptional negotiation, presentation, and communication skills. Demonstrated ability to build relationships and influence at all organizational levels.
  • Analytical Thinking: Proficient in using data to drive decision-making and assess market opportunities. Familiarity with CRM systems and sales analytics tools.
  • Global Perspective: Experience working in international markets, with an understanding of cultural nuances and varying business practices.

Other Knowledge, Skills, Abilities or Certifications:

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on building and sustaining relationships.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to client needs.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Project manages with a highly collaborative style, deadline sensitive high priority programs and deliverables with a team-focused attitude.
  • Team oriented, cooperative, and flexible. Demonstrated ability to collaboratively work with a wide range of people at all levels of the organization.
  • Proficiency with CRM software, client success platforms, and data analytics.

TRAVEL

  • Up to 50% annually for client visits, conferences and team meetings as required

Remote

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$137,900.00 - $246,350.00 USDThis role is eligible for Commission.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

Business Analytics & Reporting

Data Governance & Process Improvement

• Improve data quality and integrity across key business processes. Identify data inconsistencies and work with process owners to correct root causes at source.

jobs.description:
JUICE is a performance marketing agency that has driven more than $2.5 billion in client revenue for brands like L’Oréal, CBDistillery, Effy Jewelry, Bond Vet, and [solidcore]. Our average client stays with us for over three years, our teams are senior only, and we run on proprietary AI built by our parent company, ONAR. The agency wins consistently once we’re in the room. This role exists to get us into more rooms and to turn those conversations into signed clients.

This isn’t a seat where you build your own pipeline from a cold start. A dedicated BD operations lead runs targeting, outbound, and scheduling, and books qualified discovery calls onto your calendar. The CEO joins your largest closing calls. You own the number.

What you’ll do

  • Own new business revenue for JUICE: run discovery calls, shape the pitch to each brand, write and present proposals, negotiate, and close.

  • Sell monthly retainers to e-commerce and consumer brands, with a minimum engagement size we hold firm on. Quality matters as much as volume: your compensation includes a second-year component, so clients that stay make you money.

  • Work the pipeline our BD operations lead builds for you, and bring your own network on top of it.

  • Keep the pipeline honest: stages, values, and next steps current, reviewed in a weekly meeting with the ONAR leadership team (CEO, President, and Finance).

  • Feed what you hear in the market back into our targeting, our pitch, and our creative.

What good looks like

  • Roughly 20 held discovery calls a month, booked for you, converting to 8 proposals and 2 or more signed clients at or above our engagement floor.

  • A first close inside your first 90 days, with a compounding book from there.

Who you are

  • 5+ years selling agency retainers, ideally $5K to $25K per month, at a performance or digital marketing agency. You’ve carried a number and hit it.

  • A real network in e-commerce, DTC, or consumer brands, and the credibility to get a founder or CMO on the phone.

  • A discovery-led seller. You ask about margins, LTV, and channel mix before you ever show a deck.

  • Confident enough in your close rate to want commission-heavy compensation with uncapped upside.

  • Fluent with modern tools. We use AI daily across the company and expect you to as well.

Compensation

A recoverable draw plus uncapped commission paid on collected revenue, including a trailing component in each client’s second year. On-target earnings are strong six figures with no ceiling; the economics reward sellers who sign clients that stay. Full structure shared early in the process.

How to apply

Submit your resume and a short note answering one question: What’s the largest retainer you’ve ever sold, and how did you win it?

  • Conocimientos avanzados de CI/CD y experiencia real con herramientas como Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD o similares

  • Experiencia con Git y metodologías de integración y despliegue continuo

  • Experiencia en automatización Day 2, gestión de configuraciones e infraestructura como código

  • Capacidad de scripting y automatización con Python y/o Shell Script

  • Experiencia trabajando en entornos híbridos, on-premise y cloud

  • Capacidad para realizar troubleshooting de problemas complejos en plataformas distribuidas y contenerizadas

  • Buenas capacidades de comunicación, organización y trabajo con diferentes equipos

  • Mentalidad orientada a la automatización, mejora continua y calidad del servicio

  • Experiencia en entornos de alta disponibilidad y producción 24x7

Your AI strategy is only as strong as the data behind it. Quest Software builds the foundation for enterprise AI with solutions in data governance, cybersecurity, and platform modernization. The Customer Success Organization focuses on our most strategic customers. The CSM will manage a portfolio of accounts and lead engagement throughout the customer lifecycle—from deployment and adoption through value realization and renewal—ensuring satisfaction and long-term success.

You’ll leverage your expertise to guide customers through their journey, maintain consistent engagement, and ensure they achieve their goals and derive measurable value from Quest solutions. You’ll also surface Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) and coordinate with Account Management for follow-up. CSMs support renewal contracting processes and are expected to stay informed on Quest’s evolving product portfolio, demonstrating the ability to quickly learn and communicate the value of new offerings.

Above all, this role is accountable for retention—sustaining business growth and profitability by maximizing value, driving usage and adoption, supporting services, and reducing churn.

Responsibilities

  • Owns the customer relationship of a global or large-scale strategic account and actively manages the stakeholder relationship at all levels (i.e., executive, management, technical leaders) including strategic roadmap discussions
  • Develops and nurtures relationships and adjusts value and adoption messaging according to the levels and interests of customer stakeholders
  • Coaches peers on strategic approaches, provide mentorship for Enterprise CSMs to help them grow their knowledge and provide premium customer experience
  • Identifies and creates solutions to address Customer Success needs, improve effectiveness and efficiency, and delivery to or exceed key customer metrics.
  • Develops and maintains strategic Success Plans that align to value milestones and customer-defined business outcomes.
  • Partners with the customer to build a joint plan for success, maintaining a detailed understanding of the customer’s business to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction, engagement, and adoption of Quest technologies.
  • Monitors customer analytics and KPIs to reinforce the value of the customer solution, identify areas to improve customer experience, and optimize the solution.
  • Facilitates Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) in collaboration with Account Management, using the Success Plan and business case to demonstrate impact, value delivered, and opportunities for growth.
  • Delivers an outstanding customer experience to support our brand promise of delivering superior outcomes and to support and identify cross-sell and upsell of services and products.
  • Actively monitors customer engagement signals and sentiment; log risks and opportunities in CRM and trigger internal playbooks where applicable.
  • Supports collaboration across Sales, Support, Product, Renewals, and Professional Services to ensure continuity and strategic alignment.
  • Acts as an escalation point for high-impact customer issues when necessary, ensuring appropriate teams within Quest are engaged for quick resolution.
  • Works within the wider CSM team to implement scalable programs and process improvements to drive efficiency of internal customer success processes and improve customer experience.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in customer success, technical account management, sales engineering, or similar role responsible for driving customer success and product/service adoption.
  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in customer management within platform management and security solutions, focusing on growth, adoption, retention, and issue resolution at both the business owner and senior executive levels.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into business value, and work with sales and marketing to promote value-driven solutions
  • Ability to manage executive relationships and discussions (VP/CxO)
  • Skilled in bringing in a SAE/AE/ISR to see through upsell opportunities, whilst maintaining executive overlay and ensuring a positive customer experience
  • Strong knowledge of Customer Success best practices, with experience in defining process and providing enablement programs to promote adoption in CS and across the company
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to establish milestones and keep success plans on task.
  • Adept at handling internal and external escalations.
  • Exceptional ability to communicate and foster positive business relationships, and comfortable facilitating change and being accountable for driving success with customers.
  • Experience in leading, adopting and driving change internally or externally.
  • Experience in identifying, translating and prioritizing customer issues and needs into business or solution requirements.
  • Demonstrated success as a trusted advisor to senior executives in large organizations and ability to build success plans.
  • An understanding of how organizations measure value realization and drive revenue. Experience in recurring revenue sales models and renewal processes is an advantage.
  • Fluency in English and German.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience in transformational Customer Success projects or experience where products shift from On-Premise to SaaS.
  • Previous Customer Success experience in a company with B2B Software.
  • Proficiency in customer success tools (e.g., Gainsight, Totango) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) to manage customer health, success plans, and engagement tracking. Experience with AI prompting and leveraging AI tools to streamline processes.
  • Fluency in Dutch would be an advantage.

This role is also eligible to participate in a commission plan, with commission governed by a formal corporate compensation plan. Benefits are offered on a country-by-country basis.

This is a remote position.

Electrical Drafter & Designer
Position Type: Full-Time/Part-Time

Build smart systems. See your designs come to life.

Are you passionate about electrical design and control systems? Do you enjoy turning concepts into clean, functional drawings that power real-world operations? We’re looking for an Electrical Drafter & Designer to join our team and play a key role in designing power distribution and control solutions across diverse projects.

If you’re detail-oriented, curious, and ready to grow alongside experienced engineers and designers, we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

You’ll work closely with engineers and senior designers to create high-quality electrical drawings and documentation that drive projects from concept through completion.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Create electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, PLC I/O, motor control, and panel layout drawings using AutoCAD Electrical

  • Design MCCs, switchboards, LT panels, control panels, and power distribution systems

  • Develop interconnection drawings, BOMs/BOQs, load calculations, and cable schedules

  • Prepare submittals, RFIs, test forms, and technical documentation

  • Assist with project coordination, submittal tracking, quality reviews, and hours forecasting

  • Support panel testing, site coordination, production planning, and dispatch documentation

  • Interpret engineering sketches, contract drawings, and specifications

  • Collaborate with PLC/SCADA teams on I/O lists, control logic, and instrumentation

  • Participate in estimation, quotations, cost control, and material planning

  • Ensure drawings meet standards and accurately represent system functionality

What You’ll Design

You’ll gain hands-on experience designing a wide range of electrical and control systems, including:

  • MCCs, PCCs, PDBs, LDBs, LT Panels, AMF Panels, DG Synchronizing Panels

  • DOL, Star-Delta, and VFD-based motor control panels

  • Automatic Power Factor Correction (APFC) panels

  • Residential and industrial metering panels

  • Power and control circuits, wiring harnesses, and junction box layouts

  • Control panel GA and internal layouts based on site conditions

  • MIMIC diagrams and graphical plant representations

What We’re Looking For

Required Skills & Knowledge:

  • Strong experience with AutoCAD / AutoCAD Electrical (SolidWorks is a plus)

  • Understanding of electrical design, power distribution, and control logic

  • Ability to read and interpret control schematics and single-line diagrams

  • Familiarity with PLCs, SCADA, field instrumentation, and motor control systems

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to solve practical problems and work with limited standardization

Mandatory Technical Experience Includes:

  • VFDs, motor starters, MCCs, switchboards, transformers

  • Control panel design, P&IDs, I/O lists, loop and interconnection diagrams

  • PLC-based control circuits and instrumentation integration

Experience & Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (EE, ME, CPE preferred, not mandatory)

  • 1–5 years of experience with AutoCAD (AutoCAD Electrical preferred)

  • 1–2 years of electrical circuit or control panel design experience

  • CAD certification is a plus

Why Join Us?

  • Work on real, hands-on projects that make a visible impact

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and designers who support your growth

  • Gain exposure across design, production, testing, and project execution

  • Grow your skills in industrial power, automation, and control systems

Ready to Apply?

If you’re excited about electrical design and want to be part of a team that values precision, collaboration, and growth — we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Clinical Recruiter
jobs.excerpt: Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.
jobs.description:
Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

The Role

As a Clinical Recruiter at Prosper Health, you'll be instrumental in building our world-class clinical team by identifying, attracting, and hiring exceptional clinicians. You'll build relationships with future Prosper Health clinicians, and create seamless candidate recruiting experiences that reflect our values. By expanding our clinical talent pipeline, you'll directly enable us to serve more clients and transform mental health care for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

What You'll Do

  • Source and recruit psychologists and therapists who are passionate about serving autistic and neurodivergent adults
  • Build and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals through authentic outreach and long-term engagement
  • Manage the full recruiting process from initial contact to offer acceptance, ensuring a smooth candidate experience at each step of the recruiting process
  • Work closely with our clinical team to understand exactly what we're looking for and adjust your approach based on different specialties and backgrounds
  • Keep everything organized: track candidates, verify credentials and licenses, maintain our ATS, and report on your progress
  • Jump in when standard approaches aren't working and come up with new solutions to help the team

What We're Looking For

  • Communication & relationship building - You articulate company mission and values compellingly, connect exceptionally well with healthcare professionals, build rapport quickly, and maintain long-term candidate networks through authentic engagement
  • Effective prioritization - You manage competing deadlines and allocate time strategically to meet hiring targets in a fast-paced environment
  • Bias for action - You proactively optimize recruiting processes, leverage recruiting software effectively, and source candidates with quick response times and sense of urgency to move prospects efficiently through the recruitment process without compromising quality
  • Organization & attention to detail - You manage full-cycle recruiting from LinkedIn outreach to offer closure, systematically verify clinical licenses across multiple states, and maintain precise ATS documentation
  • Creative problem solving - You possess natural curiosity to develop creative solutions when standard approaches fail, knowing when to ask for help as needed
  • Technology/ATS proficiency - You are an expert with Greenhouse (or similar), LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other recruiting platforms

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to impact a critical function within a growing startup
  • Competitive salary
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Flexible PTO policy

More about Prosper Health

  • Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindess, and high-performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.
  • We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.
  • Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.
  • Here are a few of our favorite operating principles:
    • Clients first - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side.
    • Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less.
    • Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher.
    • Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Video & Multimodal
jobs.excerpt: Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company.
jobs.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

Video is where multimodal models are weakest and hardest to grade. Temporal reasoning, long-form understanding, grounding events in time, and holding audio, video, and text together do not fall out of image benchmarks — and the evaluations for them are still immature. Closing that gap is gated as much by how we design data and evaluation as by architecture. Innodata builds that data and those evaluations for the customers and frontier labs advancing video and multimodal models, and we are hiring a Research Scientist to own the science behind it.

You will partner directly with the customers and frontier labs building video understanding, video-language, and video-generation models, as interested in the data behind them as in the models themselves. Video spans two model families judged in completely different ways: models that understand video — answering questions, localizing events, grounding language in time — where the question is whether the answer is correct; and models that generate it, where fidelity, temporal coherence, and physical plausibility matter and no automatic metric is settled. You own the evaluation science for both, and knowing when model-based scoring can stand in for a human versus when it can't. Your conclusions shape what our partners measure and collect next.

What You’ll Own:

You will define how Innodata designs, structures, and evaluates video data for video and multimodal models, and you will validate those choices experimentally. Concretely, you will:

  • Translate the requirements of video and multimodal models — video understanding, temporal and event localization, action recognition, long-form video, video-language models, video generation, cross-modal reasoning, and multimodal retrieval and grounding — into concrete data specifications: modalities, annotation schemas, sampling, and evaluation criteria.
  • Build evaluation methodology for video understanding — temporal grounding accuracy, long-context and long-horizon reasoning, and dynamic multi-turn, cross-modal, and retrieval-and-grounding evaluation — clear about when model-based scoring is trustworthy and when a human is needed.
  • Build evaluation methodology for video generation — fidelity, temporal coherence, and physical plausibility, including generative video used as a world model — the regime where automatic metrics are weakest and human judgment matters most.
  • Decide how existing and incoming video should be structured, enriched, and sampled to extract the most model value from it, including from messy, domain-specific footage.
  • Run experiments that prove data decisions matter: fine-tune and evaluate models on Innodata data, with ablations tying specific data choices to measurable improvement.
  • Design adversarial and stumping evaluations that surface where video and multimodal systems fail, and turn those failures into better data.
  • Publish. Turn what you learn into benchmarks, methodology, and papers that advance the field and earn the trust of the customers and frontier labs we partner with.
  • Work with annotation teams, subject-matter experts, and the synthetic-data pipeline to turn specifications into operational collection and labeling plans.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • Roughly 5+ years of hands-on industry experience in video understanding or multimodal ML. We weight practical experience over formal credentials; a PhD with a compelling, current research agenda can offset the lower end.
  • A Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related technical or quantitative field is required; an advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a relevant field is preferred.
  • Trained and evaluated video or multimodal models yourself, with strong PyTorch fundamentals.
  • Fluency in the formats and tooling video work runs on: ffmpeg and decord pipelines, temporal and COCO-style annotation, WebDataset, Parquet and Arrow, and HuggingFace datasets.
  • Experience fine-tuning large video or vision-language models with the modern toolchain (HuggingFace transformers, PEFT, efficient inference), and with long-form video, streaming, temporal segmentation, or synthetic video generation.
  • A way of thinking in datasets and benchmarks: you have built evaluation sets, calibrated difficulty, and argued about what makes video data good for a given objective.
  • A track record the field recognizes: first-author publications or strong open-source contributions at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, or ICLR.
  • The ability to work directly with the research scientists at the customers and frontier labs we partner with, and to explain data and modeling decisions clearly to both expert and non-expert audiences, backed by a rigorous, reproducible approach to experiments and documentation.
  • Bonus: interest or hands-on experience in responsible-AI evaluation and red-teaming — safety and robustness testing for video and multimodal systems.

The expected salary range for this position is $160,000 - $185,000 p/year, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

jobs.title: AI Agent Engineer, Client Experience
jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewOrbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Orbis is building the agentic AI capability its mission support operations run on, and the AI Agent Engineer builds and operates it. Sixty percent of this role is common to every AI Agent Engineer at Orbis: designing, building, and deploying the multi-agent workflows behind triage, data retrieval, summarization, reporting, and escalation routing. The remaining forty percent is this role's focus — owning how clients get support on Orbis products already in the field. This engineer owns the Mission Support Desk (MSD) workflows behind client requests — intake, triage, escalation, and resolution — operates the client-facing surfaces those workflows run on, and holds the response and resolution commitments Orbis makes on deployed products.

Travel: Occasional (up to 10%), which may include international travel.

Key Responsibilities — Common Core (60% of the Role)

Every AI Agent Engineer at Orbis, regardless of focus area, owns the following:

  • Design, build, and deploy agentic AI workflows. Architect and ship the multi-agent and automated workflows that run in production: triage, data retrieval, summarization, reporting, and escalation routing.
  • Translate in both directions. Explain to non-technical stakeholders what the systems do, where they are reliable, and where they are not, in terms those stakeholders can act on. Equally, take a process owner's plain-language description of how their work happens and turn it into a workflow specification that holds up.
  • Partner with process owners to build what they actually need. Work directly and iteratively with the colleagues who own a process so the resulting capability fits their operation rather than forcing them to fit it. Push back constructively when a stated requirement will not survive contact with production.
  • Keep the workflows reliable. Monitor what is running in production, diagnose failures across prompts, tools, data, and orchestration, and resolve them. Know which problems are yours to solve and when to bring in engineering.
  • Own the cost of execution. Track what your AI workloads cost to run. Identify where a tighter prompt, a caching layer, or a simple deterministic step delivers the same outcome, and keep those costs defensible as volume grows.
  • Set the quality bar for AI-assisted output. Define accuracy standards, human review checkpoints, and escalation criteria for the automated workflows, and build the checks that prove those standards are being met.
  • Document what you build. Author and maintain the runbooks and SOPs that allow others to operate and troubleshoot these workflows without you. Nothing lives only in one person's head.
  • Integrate across Orbis products. Work across Catalyst, Pulse, and Discovery, with engineering support where needed, so workflows can access and act on the data they require.
  • Deliver the reporting leadership and the team depend on. Build and maintain the outputs behind resolution rate, escalation rate, output accuracy, response time, and employee satisfaction, and turn the Senior Operations Manager's requirements into structured, recurring reports and data exports.
  • Close capability gaps and keep the practice current. Recognize when a need is not served by existing tooling, scope the gap clearly, and either build it or bring it to engineering and product with enough detail to act on. Track developments in agentic AI tooling and enterprise automation platforms, and form a defensible view on what is worth adopting, at what pace, and for which use cases.

Focus Area — Client Experience (40% of the Role)

In addition to the common core above, this role owns what the client sees and touches:

  • Build and operate the external-facing interfaces and portals through which clients interact with Orbis capability.
  • Design and automate client onboarding: provisioning, configuration, and the first-run experience.
  • Build the support workflows behind client requests — intake, triage, escalation, and resolution — and instrument them so performance is measurable.
  • Hold the reliability and accuracy bar on anything client-facing, including documented failure modes and response commitments.
  • Turn client friction into product change: capture where clients struggle and carry it back to engineering and product with enough detail to act on.
  • Maintain the client-facing documentation, release notes, and status communication that keep clients informed without a support request.

Required Qualifications

Orbis weighs what a candidate has built over tenure or credentials. The following are true minimum requirements for this role:

  • Must have 5 years proven experience translating user requirements into wireframes, workflows and such.
  • Must have 1-year proven experience utilizing Claude or similar commercial offering to build AI agents.
  • Demonstrated experience building a functioning multi-agent workflow, with the ability to walk through the design rationale, how the agents hand off work and share context, what broke, and how it was fixed
  • Practical command of prompt engineering, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool or function calling
  • Proven ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences — describing a system's behavior, limits, and failure modes to a process owner or executive without hedging or retreating into jargon
  • Demonstrated ability to elicit requirements from stakeholders who cannot hand over a specification, and to reach a working solution regardless
  • Ability to troubleshoot agent workflows built on platforms such as Claude, GPT-class models, LangChain, AutoGen, or CrewAI, and to isolate whether a failure originates in the prompt, the tool, the data, or the orchestration
  • Working proficiency with APIs and sufficient scripting ability to build and debug workflows independently; software engineering experience is not required, but a JSON payload or a Python script must not be a blocker
  • Sound judgment about model output, including the discipline to state plainly when an output should not be trusted
  • Strong written communication. This role produces documentation, runbooks, and reports that program leads and executives rely on
  • Experience building and operating external-facing interfaces, portals, or client-facing applications in production
  • Experience designing or automating customer onboarding and provisioning
  • Experience designing support workflows — intake, triage, escalation, resolution — and instrumenting them so performance is measurable

Desired Qualifications

Strong candidates will bring depth in one or more of the following. Do not screen yourself out for lacking items on this list.

  • 5-7 years experience in software development
  • Experience coding using Python
  • Interface build: a modern front-end framework such as React; API design for external consumers; accessibility and usability practice
  • Support tooling: integration with ticketing or CRM platforms such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management
  • Client accountability: defining and reporting against service commitments; running client feedback loops or usability research
  • Bridging technical and operational teams: prior work as a solutions consultant, technical program manager, forward-deployed engineer, or in a product-adjacent role
  • AI reliability practice: monitoring, evaluation, or observability tooling for AI systems in production; automated evaluations or regression checks for LLM-based workflows; human-in-the-loop review steps that maintain quality without creating bottlenecks
  • Process design: designing SOPs or escalation frameworks that hold up across multiple stakeholders
  • AI-assisted development tooling: working fluency with Claude, Copilot, or Cursor
  • Mission environment: operating within or supporting a government or defense program; OSINT, DIGINT, or intelligence analysis workflows and tradecraft; data governance concepts, federated access control models, or zero-trust architectures
  • Operating range: a track record of coming up to speed quickly on unfamiliar systems, and effectiveness in a distributed, multi-program environment with competing priorities

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
  • Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions

Travel: Occasional (up to 10%), which may include international travel.

Orbis Benefits

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

Orbis Locations

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,

qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

As the Customer Advocacy Lead for APJ, you will celebrate our customers and spotlight their achievements, turning GitLab's most successful customers into visible, influential champions. You will identify and activate advocates and their stories that showcase customer outcomes, support pipeline and revenue goals, and deepen trust in GitLab across Asia Pacific and Japan.

What You'll Do

As Head of Archaeology, you will provide strategic leadership in archaeological research beyond excavation, with a focus on artefact-based and scientific analysis.   • Set and implement the organisations archaeological strategy in alignment with its mission, strategic priorities, and Board‑approved directions.

  • Provide expert advice and reporting to senior management and, where required, Board and Board Committees on archaeological matters, risks, and opportunities.
  • Ensure compliance with governance requirements, including approvals, documentation, and delegated authorities.
  • Oversee archaeological research, post‑excavation analysis, and interpretation to ensure responsible stewardship of heritage assets held in public trust.
  • Ensure artefacts, records, and data are properly processed, documented, and stored to support long‑term access and institutional memory.
  • Guide research priorities, methodologies, and interpretive approaches to ensure academic rigour and organisational relevance.
  • Oversee the quality and integrity of technical and interpretive outputs through robust review and quality assurance processes.
  • Lead outreach and knowledge dissemination through scholarly and public platforms to enhance public understanding and appreciation of heritage.
  • Build and sustain partnerships with academic, cultural, and community stakeholders to maximise public value and impact.
  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team, ensuring capability development, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Manage budgets, resources, and procurement responsibly in line with approved budgets and governance requirements.
  • Identify and manage operational, reputational, and research‑related risks, while driving continuous improvement and embedding lessons learned across programmes.

Requirements

  • Postgraduate qualification (Masters or PhD) in archaeology, heritage studies, or a related discipline is preferred.
  • Preferred at least 10 years in archaeology or heritage practice, including at least 3 years in leadership or management role.
  • Experience working within or closely with public sector, museum, and archaeology is preferred.
  • Experience in overseeing archaeological research, post‑excavation processes, and documentation standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multidisciplinary teams, budgets, and external service providers.
  • Strong professional knowledge of archaeological practice, documentation, and interpretive methodologies.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strategic, collaborative leader with a strong sense of stewardship, accountability, and stakeholder engagement.

Why Join HeritageSG?

Be Part of Singapore's Creative Heritage Force As a subsidiary of the National Heritage Board under MCCY, HeritageSG stands at the forefront of cultural innovation. We're the creative minds transforming how heritage connects with contemporary audiences.

Whether you're curating exhibitions, coordinating festivals, or developing digital experiences, you'll contribute to thoughtfully curated experiences that bring heritage to life for millions. Our collaborative environment encourages creative thinking whilst maintaining the highest professional standards.

Grow Your Career in Cultural Innovation Be part of an organisation that values both tradition and innovation. You'll work alongside passionate professionals who are reshaping the cultural landscape, with opportunities to develop expertise across multiple disciplines – from traditional curation to emerging technologies.

Make Heritage Relevant for Tomorrow Join us in our mission to ensure heritage remains vibrant and meaningful for future generations. At HeritageSG, your work doesn't just preserve the past – it actively shapes how culture evolves and connects with contemporary society.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to define how Colibri positions, launches, and grows its Healthcare B2B products and solutions. You’ll turn customer and market insight into compelling product stories, focused go-to-market plans, and practical tools that help our teams connect with the right buyers.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Head of B2B Marketing. You’ll own positioning and messaging, competitive intelligence, launch readiness, and sales enablement across a growing portfolio. You’ll partner closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, Client Success, and other teams to move work forward and build alignment—without needing direct reporting authority.

We’re looking for a hands-on product marketer who understands complex B2B buying decisions, is comfortable asking thoughtful questions, and can bring people together to solve problems. You should enjoy shaping strategy, digging into research, pushing launches forward, and making technical or multifaceted solutions easy to understand.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Healthcare B2B product marketing approach, including priorities, positioning, messaging, and go-to-market plans across a growing product portfolio
  • Build clear value propositions, buyer personas, segmentation, and customer journeys that reflect how healthcare organizations evaluate and purchase solutions
  • Lead customer and competitive research, develop competitive frameworks, and turn market intelligence into useful recommendations for Marketing, Sales, and Product
  • Partner with Product Managers to bring customer needs and market opportunities into product planning and roadmap discussions
  • Lead product launches from planning through market readiness, aligning narratives, messaging, customer-facing content, and cross-functional deliverables

  • Bring together Product, Engineering, Sales, Client Success, Marketing, and Content partners to resolve challenges, align priorities, and keep initiatives moving
  • Define and track meaningful measures of launch performance, customer adoption, engagement, and business impact; use insights to improve future plans

What You’ll Bring

  • 6+ years of hands-on product marketing experience in B2B or enterprise software, with the judgment to operate at a senior level
  • Current or recent ownership of core product marketing work, including go-to-market strategy, product launches, positioning, and messaging—not simply campaign support
  • A demonstrated track record of bringing complex products, platforms, or product portfolios to market and translating customer needs into compelling value propositions
  • Experience working directly with Product Managers, Sales, and Marketing teams throughout the product lifecycle, including building alignment without direct authority
  • Strong customer and competitive research skills, including the ability to develop frameworks and communicate actionable market insights
  • Clear, confident communication, strong interpersonal skills, a proactive problem-solving approach, and comfort asking questions and driving decisions
  • A data-informed mindset, with experience using performance metrics and customer feedback to evaluate impact and refine strategy

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with clinical healthcare audiences or solutions, such as pharmacy, nursing, behavioral health, healthcare organizations, or healthcare professionals
  • Experience in continuing education, workforce development, or a multi-brand or portfolio business

Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use

Experience with every tool, platform, or methodology below is not required. We care most about how you turn research and market knowledge into effective positioning, launch decisions, and measurable outcomes.

  • Go-to-market planning, product launch and readiness frameworks
  • Customer research, buyer personas, segmentation, and journey mapping
  • Competitive intelligence, battlecards, and positioning frameworks
  • Product usage, adoption, engagement, and performance reporting
  • Sales enablement, collaboration, and project management tools

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own meaningful product marketing work with visibility across our Healthcare B2B business
  • Help shape the story behind a growing portfolio serving healthcare organizations and professionals
  • Work directly with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Client Success partners to solve challenging business problems
  • Have room to bring ideas, build stronger processes, and influence how we go to market
  • Join a growing team where future leadership paths may develop as business needs evolve
  • Join a mission-driven organization where your expertise and judgment can have a visible impact

We Encourage You to Apply

You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! We welcome experienced product marketers from B2B software, enterprise technology, education technology, workforce development, and related complex business environments. Prior healthcare experience is a plus, not a requirement.

This role does require hands-on product marketing experience, ownership of go-to-market and positioning work, and the ability to partner effectively across Product, Sales, and Marketing. If your background has primarily focused on general brand marketing, digital campaigns, or product management without direct product marketing ownership, this may not be the right opportunity.

What You Can Expect From Our Hiring Process

We want our interview process to give you a clear picture of the role, the team, and what it’s like to work at Colibri while giving us the opportunity to understand your experience, how you approach your work, and what you’re looking for next. We do not use AI to review applications; applications are reviewed by a human member of our Talent Acquisition team. While the exact process may vary slightly by role, you can generally expect:

1. Recruiter Conversation

An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to learn more about your experience, career goals, and interest in Colibri. We’ll also share more about the role, team, compensation, and what to expect throughout the process.

2. Hiring Manager Conversation

A deeper discussion with the hiring manager focused on your relevant experience, how you approach the work, and the priorities and challenges this person will own.

3. Team and/or Cross-Functional Interviews

Depending on the role, you may meet with future teammates, partners, or leaders you would work closely with. These conversations are designed to explore the skills most relevant to the position while giving you the opportunity to learn more about how the team works together.

4. Final Conversation and Decision

For some roles, there may be a final conversation with an additional leader or stakeholder. Our Talent Acquisition team will keep you informed about next steps and timing throughout the process.

Application deadline: October 22nd, 2026

Our goal is to make the experience thoughtful, respectful, and transparent. We encourage you to ask questions throughout the process—we’re evaluating the opportunity together.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Colibri Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and career paths to apply.

jobs.description:
Location: Fully remote (Europe)
Contract: Freelance (per project requirements)
Day Rate: TBD based on role, experience, and project scope

The problem we solve

Most corporate innovation fails because teams spend months (and millions) building things nobody wants. They guess. They assume. They plan in detail, and then reality arrives – the customer.

At Future Foundry, we help large organisations test first, build later. We replace costly assumptions with lightweight, real-world experiments that reveal what customers actually want before our clients commit serious time and money.

We've spent the last five years developing a structured, repeatable approach to business experimentation. In that time, we've run +500 experiments and saved +£1 billion in misallocated investment for some of the largest global innovation teams. Working with the likes of Mars, Experian, HSBC, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Hilton to de-risk new propositions, get to market faster, and make evidence-backed investment decisions.

What we do

We break experimentation into four core services:

1. Innovation Strategy – Defining where and how corporate innovation teams can realise growth over the next 3–5 years, forming an investment thesis around a portfolio of new opportunities.

2. Opportunity Validation – This is where the practical testing comes in. We design and deploy lightweight, behavioural experiments to validate the riskiest assumptions about new growth opportunities. The outcome is a clear, de-risked investment decision to accelerate, adapt, or withdraw.

3. Pre-launch Test Roadmap – Once teams have decided to pilot an opportunity, we develop structured test plans that ensure they're measuring the right things to make an informed decision on launch or roll-out.

4. Capability Building – Designing the capability and operating model required to embed experimentation in large organisations – from hands-on experiment training and innovation leadership programmes to practical courses and workshops.

Requirements

We're always on the lookout for great talent to help us deliver our projects on a freelance basis. Whether you have a few days or a few weeks available, we'd love to hear from you.

We typically hire across three types of roles:

Lead: 5–10 years of experience, including proven leadership of experimentation or innovation programmes. You'll lead the design and execution of experimentation programmes for clients, manage small teams (2–3 people), and act as the primary client interface. You're comfortable facilitating workshops with senior stakeholders, turning evidence into strategic recommendations, and taking ownership of complex projects end-to-end.

Consultant: 3–7 years of experience in experimentation, user research, venture design, or corporate innovation. You'll design and run experiments hands-on – from recruiting participants and conducting interviews to setting up ads and tracking data. You can facilitate workshops, synthesise findings into clear recommendations, and flex across research, analysis, and client management with comfort in ambiguity.

Associate: 1–3 years of experience in user research, customer validation, or supporting innovation teams. You'll support the execution of behavioural experiments, recruit and coordinate participants, conduct customer interviews, and track validation metrics. You're highly organised, proactive, and comfortable documenting findings clearly while working collaboratively with senior consultants.

Across all our roles, we are looking for the following attributes:

  • Hands-on experimentation experience – We're not looking for "desk research" consultants; we need people who've run real-world tests with customers
  • A proactive, get-things-done mentality – We're a lean, flat organisation where everyone rolls up their sleeves
  • Comfort with ambiguity – Experiments don't always go to plan; you adapt quickly when they don't
  • Collaborative mindset – You're energised by working closely with clients and teammates, not operating solo
  • Strong communication skills – You can distil complex findings into clear, compelling insights (written and verbal)
  • Right to work in Europe – We're unfortunately not able to sponsor visas at this time

Nice to have:

  • Experience working in or with startups (you understand the "build-measure-learn" mentality)
  • Familiarity with the industries we work in: retail, FMCG, healthcare, and financial services
  • Knowledge of design thinking, lean startup, jobs-to-be-done, or similar methodologies

Benefits

  • Flexibility – Work on projects that fit your schedule, whether that's a few days or a few weeks
  • Impact – Be part of the innovation journey for top-tier corporate clients, helping them make multi-million-pound investment decisions with confidence
  • Learning – Work with a small, dedicated team of highly skilled practitioners; you'll learn cutting-edge experimentation methodologies
  • Variety – Exposure to diverse industries and complex challenges (construction, financial services, healthcare, climate tech)
  • Remote-first – Work from anywhere in Europe with occasional travel to client sites (UK/Europe/US, all expenses covered)
  • Fair compensation – Day rates negotiated based on role, experience, and project scope
