jobs.excerpt: About TJM LabsTJM Labs builds Pharmacy AI: the AI agents hundreds of pharmacies rely on to handle the repetitive work that keeps pharmacists away from patients.
jobs.description:
About TJM Labs

TJM Labs builds Pharmacy AI: the AI agents hundreds of pharmacies rely on to handle the repetitive work that keeps pharmacists away from patients. Our platform handles prescription intake, data entry, refill management and patient calls. It works on top of the systems pharmacies already run, across 26+ pharmacy management systems and the portals and tools around them, so teams can take on more volume with the same staff. Today TJM Labs supports more than 550 pharmacies across the U.S. and Canada and automates over a million pharmacy tasks a day.

TJM Labs is built by pharmacists. Through our Dual-Expert Model™, pharmacists and engineers work side by side to design automation around the real workflows, systems and challenges pharmacies face every day.

We are a remote-first, high-growth organization united by a shared mission to help pharmacies scale without proportionally scaling their workforce. Our culture emphasizes direct impact, autonomy with responsibility, collaboration, practical problem-solving, continuous learning, and a commitment to healthcare. Team members have the opportunity to see their work make a meaningful difference in real pharmacies while contributing to technology that helps healthcare professionals focus on what matters most: their patients.

About the Role

We're hiring a Mid-Market Division Lead to own the commercial health of our Mid-Market segment end to end: revenue, headcount, and every resourcing and pricing call that shapes how the segment grows.

TJM Labs is in hyper-growth, building out a widening portfolio of AI products live across pharmacies nationwide. Running a business at this pace means someone needs to own the full picture for each major piece of it, not just a function within it. This role owns that picture for Mid-Market: what to charge, where headcount goes, which accounts get resourced, and how the segment expands.

You will report to the COO, with real latitude to run the segment as your own. There is no finished playbook. Part of the job is building the judgment calls and the process that don't exist yet, while you are already running the business.

Key Responsibilities

Segment Ownership and Resourcing

  • Own revenue and headcount decisions for the Mid-Market segment, and the resourcing and prioritization tradeoffs across the pods that serve it
  • Evaluate every staffing request against its actual revenue impact. The default question is always whether the segment needs a person, or better process and tooling
  • Prioritize across accounts and pods when resources are scarce. This call belongs to you within the quarter, not something that has to go back up the chain each time
  • Identify and prioritize expansion opportunities across existing Mid-Market accounts, and resource them alongside new implementations

Efficiency and Automation Ownership

  • Own the efficiency outcome for the segment: how much of Mid-Market runs without added headcount. You will drive this through Product, Engineering, and Operations, not build the fix yourself
  • Identify automation opportunities within the segment that would meaningfully improve growth or margin
  • When the cause is how the delivery org operates, raise it to the team that owns fixing it. When the cause is what the product requires a human to do, raise it to Product and Engineering

Revenue Quality and Expansion

  • Be accountable for account health and expansion outcomes across Mid-Market, prioritizing where that effort goes and partnering with Customer Success, who execute the account relationship day to day
  • Partner with Finance on pricing and packaging strategy for the tier, grounded in what the segment can deliver at strong margin
  • Partner with Sales during late-stage deal review so new business is scoped and priced for profitable delivery from day one

Escalation and Relationships

  • Own escalation for at-risk or strategic Mid-Market accounts beyond what a Customer Success Manager (CSM) can resolve alone
  • Hold the relationships that matter most for this segment's retention and growth, including periodic onsite visits for key accounts

Customer Signal to Product and Engineering

  • Aggregate patterns across Mid-Market accounts, not individual anecdotes, into segment-level input for the product and pricing roadmap

Requirements

What You Will Bring

Required

  • Experience owning revenue, headcount, or resourcing decisions for a business unit, book of accounts, or segment, not just executing a plan someone else set
  • Comfortable evaluating a staffing request, a pricing decision, or a deal against its actual economic impact before approving it
  • Track record of driving outcomes and holding a line with people and teams outside a direct reporting line
  • Experience partnering with Sales, Product, and Engineering as equals, including holding a peer function accountable without a formal tie-breaker to fall back on
  • Comfortable enforcing standardization and process discipline in some accounts while building custom, relationship-driven solutions in others, and knowing which one a given situation calls for
  • History of building process or infrastructure that didn't exist yet, rather than executing an established playbook
  • Comfortable reading unit economics, margin, cost-to-serve, and ROI, and using them to judge whether a specific deal, hire, or exception is a good idea
  • 6 to 8 years of professional experience, including prior ownership of a P&L, book of business, or revenue-accountable function, or equivalent ownership experience such as running a location, a territory, or a function at a startup with direct revenue accountability
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Nice to have

  • Experience with U.S. healthcare, pharmacy, or another regulated or technical buying environment

Why This Role Is Unique

You'll own the outcomes for a real piece of the business: what to charge, where headcount goes, which accounts to resource, and where the segment expands next, driven through partnership across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering rather than a team of your own. TJM Labs is growing fast and building out an expanding portfolio of AI products, and this role is where a meaningful slice of that growth actually gets run. If you want ownership that's real rather than titular, and the latitude to build the playbook as you go, this is that role.

Benefits

  • Remote-first collaborative work environment
  • Paid time off
  • 401K with company match
  • Health Plan
  • The opportunity to work at the intersection of healthcare, pharmacy, and AI
  • Meaningful ownership and opportunity to grow as TJM Labs continues to scale

Equal Employment Opportunity

TJM Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the hiring process, email .

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, qualifications, or requirements. Responsibilities and requirements may change based on business needs.

Motion Graphics | Animation | Video Editing | Creative Design

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a creative and execution-focused Animator / Motion Graphics Designer to produce engaging visual content for brand campaigns, digital marketing, social media, and product storytelling.

This role is responsible for transforming creative ideas, scripts, and briefs into polished animations and motion graphics that strengthen brand presence and drive engagement across digital platforms.

You’ll work closely with creative, marketing, and video teams to produce compelling visual experiences through motion design, animation, typography, and storytelling.

This is more than a video editing role. We’re looking for someone with a strong eye for motion, pacing, and modern digital content who can combine creativity with technical execution while delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

If you’re passionate about creating motion content that captures attention and delivers measurable impact, this role is a great fit.

What You’ll Own

Motion Graphics & Animation Production

  • Create 2D and 3D animations, kinetic typography, and motion graphics for marketing campaigns, advertisements, presentations, and branded content.
  • Develop animations for explainer videos, product demonstrations, social media campaigns, reels, and digital advertising assets.
  • Transform storyboards and creative concepts into engaging motion experiences.
  • Design transitions, visual effects, and animated sequences aligned with campaign objectives.
  • Deliver visually compelling, modern animations optimized for engagement across platforms.

Creative Collaboration & Brand Execution

  • Collaborate with graphic designers, video editors, marketers, and creative leads.
  • Ensure all motion assets align with brand guidelines and messaging.
  • Contribute creative concepts, animation styles, and storytelling ideas during campaign planning.
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback while maintaining creative quality and consistency.
  • Support multiple campaigns with efficient turnaround times.

Video Editing & Multimedia Integration

  • Edit motion-based video content using Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects.
  • Integrate music, voiceovers, sound effects, and audio into animated projects.
  • Combine footage, graphics, animation, and visual assets into polished deliverables.
  • Produce short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, and other digital platforms.

Asset Management & Optimization

  • Export assets optimized for web, social media, paid advertising, presentations, and broadcast.
  • Maintain organized project files, templates, plugins, and animation libraries.
  • Ensure assets remain scalable, editable, and reusable.
  • Optimize content for multiple aspect ratios and platform specifications.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Stay current with animation trends, platform updates, and creative best practices.
  • Create content optimized for engagement, watch time, click-through rate (CTR), and campaign performance.
  • Continuously improve workflows, creative quality, and production efficiency.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of professional experience in:
    • Motion Graphics
    • Animation
    • Multimedia Design
  • Strong portfolio showcasing motion graphics, animations, branded content, or advertising work.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in:
    • Adobe After Effects
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Adobe Illustrator
    • Adobe Photoshop
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Motion design principles
    • Timing and pacing
    • Animation techniques
    • Visual storytelling
  • Experience creating motion content for marketing campaigns, digital advertising, or social media.
  • Familiarity with modern platform specifications and content optimization.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with:
    • Cinema 4D
    • Blender
    • Maya
    • Other 3D animation tools
  • Background in:
    • Advertising agencies
    • SaaS
    • Entertainment
    • E-learning
  • Experience with sound design and audio integration.
  • Understanding of marketing performance metrics such as CTR, engagement, and watch time.
  • Experience producing high-performing paid advertising creatives.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Strong visual storyteller with excellent motion design instincts.
  • Creative while maintaining brand consistency and quality.
  • Highly organized with excellent project management skills.
  • Comfortable managing multiple deadlines and revision cycles.
  • Collaborative and communicative in remote environments.
  • Adaptable across multiple animation styles, formats, and creative requests.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review creative briefs and storyboard concepts.
  • Design and animate motion graphics for digital campaigns.
  • Edit and refine video content for multiple platforms.
  • Collaborate with creative and marketing teams on campaign execution.
  • Export optimized deliverables for advertising, web, and social media.

In short: You create engaging motion content that enhances brand storytelling, improves audience engagement, and supports high-performing marketing campaigns.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to join our team. This role is crucial in managing and optimizing our infrastructure and deployment processes, ensuring high availability and performance of our services. The Case IQ and Lextegrity product suites process millions of transactions, providing risk scores and insights that help compliance users prioritize reviews and proactively avoid risks like fraud, corruption, and bribery.

What You'll Do

  • Infrastructure Management: Maintain and optimize our infrastructure across Azure and AWS, ensuring the seamless operation of services such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Docker Swarm, Azure Application Insights, Amazon ECS, DynamoDB, AWS Lambda, Application Load Balancers (ALB), API Gateway, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and more. Support platform administration and security while identifying cost-optimization opportunities as we scale.
  • Deployment Automation: Develop and manage CI/CD, automating deployment processes to ensure rapid and reliable software delivery.

  • Performance Optimization: Monitor system performance and observability metrics and implement improvements to ensure the high availability and scalability of the compliance monitoring platform.
  • Security and Compliance: Implement security and compliance best practices, ensuring all systems and processes adhere to industry standards and regulations.
  • Quality Assurance: Work closely with QA to define a testing strategy that empowers them to run automated tests and deploy to their own environments and enables high confidence in functionality with each deployment.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with development to ensure the seamless integration and deployment of new features and updates.
  • Incident Management: Respond to and resolve system incidents, minimizing downtime and ensuring the reliability of our services.

Who You Are

  • Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 5+ years of experience in a DevOps or similar role.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong experience with Azure and AWS services and infrastructure as code. Solid familiarity with containerization technologies, particularly Docker. Experience operating modern SaaS web applications, including auto-scaling, load balancing, gateways, monitoring, observability, and secrets management. Multi-cloud experience is a plus.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Azure and AWS infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform and CDK) for managing cloud resources.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Proven experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with Github Action and Jenkins, with a focus on automation and efficiency.
  • AI-Enabled Operations and Development: Experience with and knowledge of vibe coding, agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, and AIOps tools for intelligent monitoring, incident response, automation, and operational optimization.
  • Security Practices and Acumen: Knowledge of security best practices and experience implementing security measures in cloud environments. Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 web application security risks and a strong understanding of software security principles.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively within a team and engage stakeholders across the organization.

What Success Looks Like

  • 30 Days: Complete onboarding and required security/compliance training. Build a strong understanding of Case IQ’s platform architecture, cloud environments, deployment processes, observability tools, current infrastructure priorities, and incident-management practices.
  • 60 Days: Begin contributing to infrastructure maintenance, CI/CD improvements, monitoring, and deployment workflows with support from the team. Identify quick wins related to reliability, security, documentation, automation, or cost optimization.
  • 90 Days: Independently manage assigned infrastructure and deployment work, troubleshoot common production issues, and contribute to reliable, well-documented releases. Partner effectively with Development and QA to improve deployment confidence and environment readiness.
  • 6 Months: Deliver meaningful improvements to platform reliability, scalability, observability, security, or deployment efficiency. Help advance infrastructure-as-code, automated testing/deployment practices, and AI-enabled operational workflows.
  • 1 Year: Serve as a trusted DevOps partner across Engineering—strengthening the stability, security, and scalability of the platform; reducing operational friction and incident risk; and helping shape a mature, automation-first, AI-enabled SDLC.

jobs.excerpt: About UsSlashData empowers product, platform and engineering leaders with best-in-class research on developers and the future of software in the AI era.
jobs.description:
About Us

SlashData empowers product, platform and engineering leaders with best-in-class research on developers and the future of software in the AI era. We have done so for over 20 years. We survey more than 20,000 developers a year for research projects for the likes of Microsoft, Google, Meta and Amazon. Alongside that client work, SlashData maintains its own premium software developer panel under the Developer Nation brand. The role of Growth Marketer and Community Builder is critical for SlashData’s vision, which is to become the industry reference of the software development economy.

We want SlashData to be the place where you do your best work ever. That means work with real meaning and impact, a genuine say in where the company goes next, and colleagues who challenge you candidly, help you grow and have your back. It's a place where it's safe to take risks, ask for help and say what you really think, and where your work is noticed and appreciated.

About You

You're a growth marketer who loves building audiences and communities with a bold desire to experiment and improve, and you get a kick out of testing ideas and seeing the numbers move. Here, you'll lead the growth of SlashData’s Developer Nation panel. Our ambition is to grow it five-fold by the end of 2027 and make it the go-to premium panel for software developers.

About three-quarters of your time will go on bringing new developers into the panel. The rest will go on keeping them engaged, so they stay active and keep taking part.

It is a mix of strategy and hands-on work. You'll be out in developer communities and professional networks, starting conversations with people you have not met yet, as a visible face of Developer Nation. If building a network and being part of the community sounds like fun rather than a chore, if you’re a motivated communicator, you'll enjoy this role! You would need some experience doing this before; we’re thinking this role would suit someone with four to five years of experience in growth or performance marketing, and a track record of working to empirical goals and meeting KPIs.

About our Panellists

Our Developer Nation panellists are LinkedIn- and GitHub-verified, and held to the highest quality standards. It is the quality of their answers that our clients pay for. Part of the challenge, and a big part of what makes the role interesting, is finding channels that bring in real, verified developers at scale.

How you’ll work

You'll have a lot of freedom. You decide which channels to try, how campaigns look and how they run, within the agreed budget and data protection standards. You'll be responsible for improving the unit economics of acquisition and then running your own budget, putting forward where the money should go and why. You are responsible for improving the unit economics of acquisition and then running your own budget.

We value openness. Sharing what didn't work is as useful to us as sharing what did, and we'd always rather hear early if something isn't landing.

What you’ll do (key responsibilities)

Strategy and channels

  • Shape and lead the panel acquisition strategy, including the budget development.
  • Find the audiences and communities that fit our survey topics.
  • Search for and evaluate channels where potential panellists can be recruited: online communities, forums, social media groups, professional networks and paid media.
  • Minimise acquisition cost per verified panellist while growing the panel.

Campaigns and outreach

  • Plan, launch and optimise paid and organic acquisition campaigns.
  • Conduct outreach to invite suitable individuals to join our survey panel.
  • Run structured experiments and move on quickly from the ones that do not work.
  • Launch calls to existing panellists to answer surveys and answer queries from panellists that may arise.
  • Use AI tools to assist and automate wherever possible.

Onboarding and panel quality

  • Support the onboarding of new panellists and maintain accurate participant records.
  • Protect the verification standard. Volume that fails LinkedIn and GitHub verification does not count.
  • Challenge and improve our existing processes wherever possible.

Measurement

  • Track and report the performance of your own campaigns end to end.
  • Monitor recruitment results and identify which acquisition channels earn more budget.

Requirements

What you’ll bring

  • Four to five years of relevant experience in growth/performance marketing.
  • You have owned a CPA or CAC target end to end, and can show knowledge of that process: how the target was set, what you did when it moved, and how you decided to keep spending or stop.
  • Analytical skills strong enough to run your own measurement: attribution, funnel and cohort analysis, channel-level unit economics, and honest reporting of what did not work.
  • Strong written communication skills in English.
  • Based in Europe (any country).
  • Comfortable initiating contact with people you do not know, in public developer communities, under the SlashData and/or Developer Nation brand name.
  • Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns and follow structured processes.
  • Comfortable using spreadsheets and online tools for tracking tasks and participants.
  • Experience engaging with online communities or professional groups.
  • Use of advanced AI tooling, e.g. Claude Code or similar

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling a community.
  • Experience in participant recruitment, panel management, or survey or market research.
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn and HeyReach, and with metrics like CAC, LTV, payback period and UTM tracking. (A separate team supports tooling set-up.)

Three & Six-month Success

Within the first three months, you will be expected to have demonstrated the following:

  • Proactive reporting
  • Analysis of successful versus unsuccessful campaigns, with the reasoning for each decision.
  • 800 new developers onboarded into the panel. (Acquisition)
  • Good selection of suitable panel candidates, evidenced by the share of new panellists passing LinkedIn and GitHub verification and completing their profile.
  • Working independently and managing your own time well.

Within the first six months, the successful candidate will be expected to have demonstrated the following:

  • A clear acquisition strategy, with documented evidence behind it.
  • Around 2,500 new developers onboarded into the panel.
  • At least half of new panellists come back to take part again, and more than a quarter of the panel are active at any one time.
  • A clear picture of cost per verified panellist by channel, and a view on where to invest next.

Benefits

Benefits and What You’ll Get

Meaningful Work at the Centre of AI & Software Evolution

Join a company shaping how technology leaders understand developers in the AI era. Your work directly influences platform strategy, tooling decisions, and the future of software engineering.

Competitive Compensation & Performance Upside

  • Competitive base salary depending on experience and location: €30-38k (gross).
  • Additional bonus based on company profitability

Truly Remote, Globally Connected

We are a fully distributed team across continents, but we prioritise real connection.

  • Two team events per year:
    • One in-person international meetup (our last 4-day offsite was in Berlin)
    • One virtual global team event
  • Flexible working environment built on trust and ownership

We combine autonomy with meaningful collaboration.

Annual Personal Development Budget

We invest seriously in growth.

  • £1,000.00 per year training budget
  • Monthly Amazon book allowance (on any book you choose)
  • Exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making

We actively support continuous development, not just in theory.

Work Where You Work Best

  • £500.00 annual co-working budget to collaborate in person with teammates when working on projects
  • £500.00 initial home office setup budget (plus laptop) to ensure you have the right equipment

You’ll have the flexibility to choose the environment that maximises your productivity.

Lifestyle Perks

  • Spotify Premium or Netflix subscription
  • One self-care day to take whenever you need it

A Culture That Listens

We genuinely listen to our team.

  • Open access to leadership
  • Clear feedback loops
  • Real autonomy and accountability
  • Space to test ideas and improve systems

We’re entrepreneurial, direct, and focused on impact, not hierarchy.

Salary

€30-38k (gross), depending on experience and location.

Scope

Our client is seeking an experienced and highly skilled Database Administrator (DBA) with expertise in the banking domain to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of data migration processes and requirements, particularly in migrating data from on-premises environments to AWS using DMS, and RDS or EC2. Additionally, the candidate should be proficient in documenting and presenting technical information to customers. Experience with PostgreSQL and MariaDB is essential.

The following sections provide a detailed breakdown of the scope of work and additional tasks and considerations essential for the project's successful execution.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead, implement and responsible for Database Migration of on-premises workloads to AWS.

  • On-Premises Assessment
  • Conduct assessment phases to discover existing database sizing and schema compatibility using AWS tools.
  • Document all aspects of database management, including design, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
  • Strategy Development
  • Work with other Delivery team members to provide Database input for Migration Strategy
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align migration strategy with business objectives and technical requirements.
  • Ensure that Database designs adhere to AWS best practices and security standards.
  • Migration
  • Plan and execute data migration projects from on-premises to AWS within expected RPO, and RTO.
  • Ensure database performance, availability, and security by industry best practices.
  • Provide strategy documents including but not limited to migration, rollback, cutover, and validation process.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to migrate and verify the correctness of the database when migrate
  • Testing and Quality Assurance
  • Perform sample runs and test data ingestion, processing
  • Create and execute test cases to validate data accuracy and performance
  • Performance Optimization
  • Monitor system performance and identify bottlenecks
  • Optimize Database configurations for memory, timeout, connection pool, etc.
  • Transition to Client
  • Handover all necessary documentation and knowledge to the customer team
  • Assist with the transition process and provide ongoing support if required
  • Provide training and support to internal teams on Database migration & Administration best practices.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Technical Skills:
  • Solutions Architect - Associate or Professional, AWS Database Speciality
  • Minimum of 4+ years experience with DBA, familiar with MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, OracleDB, MongoDB, Redis etc. Skillful in database high-availability deployment
  • Proven experience in migrating on-premises workloads to AWS.
  • In-depth knowledge of AWS services and Database features.
  • Proficiency in conducting Database assessments and implementing mitigation strategies.
  • Experience in Linux and Windows Server
  • Proficient in shell, bat, python or other scripting languages
  • Soft Skills:
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Project Deliverables

  • Migration: Successfully migrates the on-premises database to AWS.
  • Current State Assessment Report: A detailed report on the current state of on-premise applications, including architecture, infrastructure, and dependencies.
  • Migration Strategy Document: A strategic roadmap for migrating on-premise applications to AWS Cloud, including timelines, resource requirements, and cost estimates.
  • Migration Plan: Detailed migration plans for each application, including AWS service selection, architecture design, and implementation steps.
  • Risk Assessment and Mitigation Plan: Identification of potential challenges and risks, along with mitigation strategies.
  • Migration Runbooks: Comprehensive runbooks for migration processes, including
    • Inventory list
    • Data mapping and transformation: Definition of data schema, transformations, and data mapping from on-premises to AWS.
    • pre-migration, migration, and post-migration steps.
    • Environment setup: Creation and configuration of the AWS environment, including database cluster, backup solution
  • Training and Knowledge Transfer Materials: Documentation to support training and knowledge transfer to internal teams and client personnel.

At Hopscotch Primary Care, we believe great healthcare should be accessible to all people across all communities. Today, we are serving thousands of patients in our value-based care model and the number is growing every day. If you want to bring your experience, skill and passion to make a lasting impact in healthcare, we’d like to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Data & AI Governance
jobs.excerpt: Mercury is seeking a Data & AI Governance leader to build and spearhead an enterprise-wide governance program for data and artificial intelligence.
jobs.description:
Mercury is seeking a Data & AI Governance leader to build and spearhead an enterprise-wide governance program for data and artificial intelligence. Reporting to the Chief Risk Officer, this leader will establish practical standards for how data and AI are owned, developed, used, protected, and monitored across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong governance and risk-management experience with sufficient technical fluency to work effectively with Data, Engineering, Product, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and business teams. This person should be comfortable building in a fast-moving environment and designing governance that supports responsible innovation without creating unnecessary complexity.

This role will work closely with the Model Risk Management and Information Security teams while maintaining a distinct mandate: Data & AI Governance will establish enterprise governance and responsible-use standards, while Model Risk Management will retain responsibility for model inventory, tiering, validation, and model-risk oversight.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement Mercury’s enterprise Data and AI Governance frameworks, policies, standards, and operating model.
  • Establish clear accountability for data ownership, stewardship, quality, lineage, classification, access, retention, and appropriate use.
  • Create a risk-based governance process for AI use cases across their lifecycle, including intake, assessment, approval, implementation, monitoring, and retirement.
  • Develop responsible-AI principles and standards addressing transparency, explainability, fairness, privacy, security, human oversight, reliability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Maintain an enterprise inventory of material data assets, AI use cases, and related governance decisions in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Define risk-based classifications and governance requirements based on the sensitivity, complexity, materiality, and customer or regulatory impact of each use case.
  • Establish governance for internally developed, vendor-provided, and embedded AI capabilities, including generative AI.
  • Partner with various Product, Engineering, Data, and business teams to embed governance requirements into development and change-management processes.
  • Coordinate with Model Risk Management to determine when an AI use case meets the definition of a model and is subject to model-risk requirements.
  • Partner with Information Security and Technology Risk on data protection, cybersecurity, access, architecture, resilience, and technology-control considerations.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance to identify and implement applicable regulatory, contractual, consumer-protection, and privacy requirements.
  • Develop processes for identifying, documenting, escalating, and remediating data- and AI-related risks and issues.
  • Establish metrics/reporting to provide management and Board committees with visibility into data quality, governance maturity, AI adoption, exceptions, incidents, and emerging risks.
  • Monitor regulatory developments, industry practices, and emerging risks related to data and AI, and translate them into proportionate governance expectations.
  • Support relevant Data and AI governance forums/committees and facilitate timely, well-documented decisions.
  • Eventually, build and lead a high-performing Data & AI Governance team as the program matures.
  • Promote a culture in which data is treated as an enterprise asset and AI is used responsibly, transparently, and in alignment with Mercury’s risk appetite.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in data governance, AI governance, technology risk, information governance, model risk, privacy, compliance, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience building or materially enhancing a data governance, AI governance, or responsible-AI program.
  • Strong understanding of data ownership, stewardship, quality, lineage, metadata, classification, access, retention, and lifecycle management.
  • Working knowledge of AI and machine-learning concepts, including generative AI, large language models, training and inference data, explainability, bias, performance monitoring, and human oversight.
  • Experience developing practical, risk-based policies and governance processes that can operate effectively in a fast-moving technology environment.
  • Ability to distinguish among data governance, AI governance, model risk, information security, privacy, and compliance responsibilities while coordinating effectively across those functions.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to balance innovation, customer outcomes, regulatory expectations, and risk management.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives, technical teams, and business leaders without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical and risk concepts to executive and Board audiences.
  • Experience leading teams and managing cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong 1LOD/2LOD judgment with an understanding of how enterprise Risk should govern, challenge, and partner with Engineering without taking ownership of 1LOD risks.
  • Pragmatic judgment: Translates principles into workable processes and focuses on material risks over theoretical ones.
  • Technical curiosity: Understands technical complexity while staying focused on business and customer outcomes.
  • Decisive and collaborative: Makes sound decisions amid ambiguity, moves quickly, and challenges constructively across teams

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience within a fintech, financial institution, technology company, or other highly regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with banking regulatory expectations for data management, model risk, third-party risk, privacy, consumer protection, and information security.
  • Experience with recognized data- and AI-governance frameworks and standards, such as DAMA-DMBOK, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, or comparable frameworks.
  • Experience governing third-party data, vendor AI solutions, and embedded AI capabilities.
  • Technical or analytical experience in data architecture, data engineering, machine learning, analytics, or software development.
  • Experience operating in a company-building or bank-building environment

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Compensation:

The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following:

  • US employees in New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area: $225,800 - $282,300 USD
  • US employees outside of New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area: $203,300 - $254,100 USD

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Software Quality Operations (SWQOps) team is at the heart of ensuring the safety, reliability, and quality of the Waymo Driver. Our mission is to build an adaptable and scalable operation, increasingly powered by AI, to deliver the crucial insights necessary to confidently deploy and grow Waymo's autonomous vehicle service.

Why This Team is Essential to Waymo's Success:

Waymo is undergoing unprecedented growth, rapidly expanding into new cities (targeting ~20 new cities by EOY 2026) and launching new vehicle platforms. SWQ Ops plays a critical role in this expansion, making it possible to scale safely and efficiently. The Safety Operations team within SWQ Ops owns the scale delivery of datasets and methodologies used to evaluate the Safety and performance of the driver as Waymo continues to scale. We are on the front lines of:

  • De-risking New Deployments: Through meticulous triage of driving and simulated events, issue discovery, and continuous field monitoring, SWQOps provides early warnings and critical insights. This "early intervention in RO issue detection" ensures operational resilience and safety, particularly in new and complex environments, which is critical as Waymo enters multiple new cities and ramps up platforms like Ojai.
  • Driving Engineering Velocity: By handling the vital work of performance evaluation, issue deep-dives, and data set curation, SWQOps collaborates heavily and allows Waymo's Engineering, SysEng, Simulation, and Data Science teams to focus on their core tasks of developing and improving the Waymo Driver.
  • Enabling Market Expansion: Our team is deeply integrated into every stage of Waymo's market entry framework, from initial city evaluation (OK2Plan) to scaling operations (OK2Scale). We provide the necessary data analysis, policy development, and quality assurance to unblock critical milestones, preventing slowdowns in market expansion velocity.
  • Data Flywheel: Supporting the development of a single, automated, end-to-end machine learning flywheel for the entire Waymo Driver. A successful flywheel will be the core engine for scaling our technology, enabling faster ODD expansion, quicker remediation of driving issues, and a significant reduction in the engineering effort required to maintain and improve the driver.

You will:

  • Drive the strategy and technical implementation of decomposing complex safety triage workflows. Develop and apply advanced operational and ML techniques to enable automation, ensuring scalability as mileage and geographic operations expand.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for human-in-the-loop ML systems in the safety problem space. Define and refine requirements for generating high-quality, dense, and broad human feedback to optimize ML models performance.
  • Partner with Engineering to design, test, and deploy cutting-edge Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (Gen-AI) models and tools to drive step-change improvements in issue discovery & detection, triage efficiency, and quality assurance.
  • Leverage AI-powered insights and traditional triage signals to proactively identify emerging on-road issue trends, new risk scenarios, and edge cases. Develop and refine data-driven strategies for issue discovery and monitoring, enhanced by ML model outputs.
  • Serve as the key link between AI/ML development and operational execution. Author and drive the adoption of foundational technical policies and standards, strategic roadmaps, and process blueprints that enable the organization to scale and support stakeholder needs.
  • Advise senior stakeholders on the long-term technical strategy and operational capabilities of the organization, serving as a trusted partner for critical decisions.

You have:

  • BS/BA degree or 7+ years of relevant work experience in AV Software Quality Operations / ML Operations
  • Proven ability to manage complex, technical projects and experience working across technical partners (Product, Engineering, Data Science, Systems Engineering) to drive outcomes.
  • Increased competency in supporting all phases of the machine learning development lifecycle, from data preparation and training to validation, deployment, and continuous monitoring.
  • Experience with ML testing and validation, including dataset quality assurance, bias detection, edge-case scenario testing, and performance evaluation using statistical metrics.
  • Ability to quickly learn and implement new concepts and utilize proprietary tools. Strong understanding of driving rules and regulations.
  • A proven ability to work in a fast-paced, high-stress environment while maintaining good judgment

  • Configure authentication methods and access policies for users, applications, workloads, and machine identities.

  • Partner with application, cloud, platform, cybersecurity, and DevSecOps teams to integrate secrets-management capabilities into enterprise architectures and development workflows.
  • Troubleshoot authentication, authorization, credential rotation, certificate, API, and platform integration issues.

This position ensures migrated environments meet applicable security, compliance, performance, resiliency, and operational requirements. The engineer/architect will also support modernization initiatives, enterprise migration governance, Zero Trust architecture, secure connectivity between on-premises environments and AWS GovCloud, and standardized cloud landing-zone patterns.

Job Responsibilities

  • Assess enterprise application portfolios and determine the appropriate migration approach for each workload using the 7 Rs: rehost, replatform, refactor, repurchase, retire, retain, and relocate.

jobs.description:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we're expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Recognized by industry analysts like Forrester and G2 and backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures, we empower high-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe with the flexibility and insights needed to drive revenue performance.
Join a talented, fast-growing team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems in sales performance management.

About the Role

We're hiring a Director of Project Management to help us evolve our Project Management practice to scale along the growing needs of the organization - to build a team of PMs who own delivery end-to-end across our full customer base, a governance system that surfaces risk before it becomes an escalation, and an operating rhythm that makes “on track” a verifiable claim rather than a status update. You'll start by upleveling how we deliver our largest, most complex enterprise implementations, then build out how project management scales efficiently across the rest of our customer base. This is a builder role - you will establish project management as a first-class function here, not maintaining an existing one.

What You'll Do

    Own Delivery Governance Across the Full Portfolio

  • Serve as the single accountable owner for project governance across implementation segments, from our largest enterprise accounts to our highest-volume, scale-motion accounts.

  • Build and run a risk-visibility system — dashboard, thresholds, escalation triggers — that surfaces problems before they reach leadership, not after.

  • Define milestone gates for engagements at every scale, from high-touch enterprise builds to lighter-touch scale delivery, and hold the team accountable to them.

    • Build and Lead the PM Organization

  • Hire, develop, and manage a team of project managers and project coordinators; build a defined career path across levels and segments.

  • Own the standards this function runs on — best practices, change management, workflow documentation — and make sure they scale from our most complex accounts down to our highest-volume ones.

  • Design and build a project coordinator model to support scale delivery: milestone-based check-ins, AI-assisted monitoring, and a delivery model that can responsibly cover a high volume of concurrent projects per coordinator.

    • Raise the Bar on Enterprise Delivery

  • Partner with Architecture leadership to draw a clear line between system design ownership and project accountability ownership — and hold that line as the organization scales.

  • Diagnose and close the specific gaps that let complex projects run today without a single accountable owner.

    • Drive Operating Rhythm and Visibility

  • Run a recurring delivery forum reporting progress, risk, and change management status across segments.

  • Report delivery health, risk, and escalation trends to the VP of Technical Services and CX leadership on a defined cadence.

What You'll Need

  • 8+ years in project or program management for software implementations, including 5+ years building or leading a PM team — not solely individual-contributor PM experience.

  • Direct experience implementing enterprise SaaS within an internal delivery team or a partner organization (systems integrator, consulting firm, or implementation partner) — deep familiarity with the operational rigor enterprise buyers expect, independent of any single product.

  • Experience designing delivery models that work at more than one scale — you've built or run both high-touch, complex delivery and higher-volume, lighter-touch delivery, and know how those operating models differ.

  • A demonstrated track record of building a PM function or operating system where one didn't previously exist, or was under-resourced — not just operating inside an already-mature one.

  • Comfortable being the accountable owner of a project's outcome without owning the technical solution — this is an operational and stakeholder-management role, not an architecture role.

    • Nice to Have

  • Experience with incentive compensation management (ICM) or a similarly complex, configuration-heavy enterprise software category.

  • Experience designing or scaling a project coordinator / delivery-ops model for a high-volume, lower-touch customer segment.

Benefits

  • (US-ONLY)Comprehensive Healthcare: 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for all FTEs, with roughly 75% coverage for dependents.
  • Flexible Time Off: Flexible vacation days plus quarterly mental health days to ensure you have the space to recharge.
  • Annual Stipends: Dedicated funds for your professional development and caretaking needs.
  • Work Anniversary Bonuses: Annual bonuses to celebrate your milestones and contributions to the CaptivateIQ team that grow as your tenure does.
  • Retirement Savings (US-Only): A 401(k) plan to help you invest in and secure your future.
  • Premium Tools: The latest Apple hardware to empower you to do your best work.
  • Inclusive Community: Active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that celebrate shared identities and support our DEI goals by fostering an environment where diverse talent thrives.

Notice for Prospective Candidates

  • Only emails from @captivateiq.com should be trusted.
    • We are aware of active recruitment scams using the CaptivateIQ name, in which individuals pose as our recruiters and post fake remote job openings and make fake job offers on the Internet. Please note, we will never do the following:
  • Attempt to correspond with a candidate using a free web-based account, such as an email address that ends in @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @hotmail.com, etc.
  • Make an offer of employment without conducting multiple rounds of interviews face-to-face using secure video-conferencing technology.
  • Ask candidates to cash checks to buy equipment on behalf of CaptivateIQ.
  • Ask candidates to make a payment in order to be considered for a position.
  • Make early requests for candidates' personal information such as date of birth, passport details, credit card numbers, bank details and social security number, etc.
  • Please note that we’ll only ask for more sensitive personal information in connection with background checks after an offer is made.

jobs.description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

We are building out a new research function at the intersection of artificial intelligence and quantitative trading to improve the efficiency of execution algo models and more, and we are looking for a Junior Quantitative Researcher to be a founding member of this effort. You will work alongside senior quants, engineers, and traders to design AI-driven workflows that generate alpha signals, diagnose model and PnL behavior, and deepen our understanding of market microstructure.

This is a high-ownership role suited to someone who is genuinely excited about markets, has a strong research background, and is already building with modern AI tooling — including LLM-based agents. We are open to hiring at the fresh-PhD level, provided you can demonstrate research depth and a real interest in trading.

Responsibilities

  • Signal research and construction. Develop, test, and productionize predictive signals across asset classes using a combination of statistical methods, machine learning, and AI agent–driven research workflows. Take ideas from hypothesis through backtest, validation, and deployment.

jobs.excerpt: In 1954, architect Eero Saarinen designed a radically modern bank branch for Irwin Union in Columbus, Indiana.
jobs.description:
In 1954, architect Eero Saarinen designed a radically modern bank branch for Irwin Union in Columbus, Indiana. With glass walls, no private offices, and a floor plan that invited openness, it embodied a new kind of transparency in finance. The building was surrounded by trees, furnished by Herman Miller, and featured rustic brick flooring. Today, that space is a conference center, and that spirit of design-forward thinking in banking* feels all but extinct.

Mercury believes that level of care and craft in design has been lost in modern finance, and we’re building products that bring it back. Cards and credit are built on complicated systems and inherited conventions, but our customers shouldn’t have to experience that complexity. We believe thoughtful design can turn something traditionally transactional into an experience that feels simple, intuitive, and distinctly Mercury.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Cards & Credit team. You’ll tackle complex product problems, question inherited assumptions, and shape experiences that help startups spend less time banking and more time building.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own meaningful Cards & Credit product problems from initial framing through shipped experience, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to understand the problem and shape what we should build.
  • Turn complicated systems, requirements, and edge cases into experiences that feel remarkably simple and intuitive.
  • Work across the entire design stack, from framing problems and exploring concepts to workflows, detailed interactions, visual design, prototyping, and final implementation.
  • Explore broadly and design from first principles, questioning inherited patterns and assumptions when a better answer may exist.
  • Bring a high level of interaction and visual craft to the Cards & Credit experience, from the structure of a workflow to the details of hierarchy, typography, motion, and state.
  • Collaborate with Mercury’s Brand team on physical cards and related products, creating a cohesive experience between the objects our customers hold and the product experiences surrounding them.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our customers, communicate the reasoning behind your decisions clearly, and work through tradeoffs with your partners to arrive at the strongest solution.

What you’ll bring:

  • A strong portfolio of product work demonstrating exceptional product thinking, interaction design, and visual craft.
  • An ability to understand complicated systems and turn them into simple, thoughtful product experiences.
  • Deep curiosity about why a problem exists before deciding how to solve it, with a willingness to question assumptions and work from first principles.
  • Real ambition for the work itself. You want to do the best work of your career here, and you’re energized by being surrounded by people who hold themselves to the same bar.
  • A high bar for craft and the judgment to know where additional thought and detail meaningfully improve an experience.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and taking ownership without waiting for every requirement to be defined.
  • A habit of exploring multiple possibilities, prototyping ideas, and changing direction when a stronger solution emerges.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to articulate your thinking, explain tradeoffs, and build conviction with Product and Engineering partners.
  • Deep care for customers and an ambition to create products that don’t just function well, but genuinely make their lives better.

You don’t need a background in banking, fintech, cards, or credit. We care much more about whether you’ve demonstrated the ability to understand complicated problems and turn them into simple, thoughtful product experiences.

Complexity can be learned. The instinct to find its essence is harder to teach.

jobs.excerpt: Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer Location: Remote, Option for Hybrid in Bay AreaFor generations, midlife women's health has been neglected.
jobs.description:
Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer
Location: Remote, Option for Hybrid in Bay Area

For generations, midlife women's health has been neglected. While roughly 2 million American women enter perimenopause or menopause every year, up to 75% of those who seek medical care walk away untreated—often because less than 20% of OB-GYN residency programs offer formal menopause training.

Most women come to Midi seeking relief from symptoms like hot flashes and poor sleep. But what they receive is comprehensive, whole-woman care. At Midi, we know that achieving the best health outcomes requires looking at the complete picture. Beyond symptom management, our clinical model proactively targets the critical health shifts happening under the surface—including cardiovascular health and cholesterol, bone density, thyroid function, and metabolic risks like pre-diabetes.

As the leading virtual care clinic dedicated to midlife health, Midi is scaling rapidly to meet this overdue demand. We are now onboarding 1,000 new patients every day and conducting 25,000 virtual visits per week. To ensure this high-standard care is accessible to all, Midi operates as a fully integrated partner across the broader healthcare ecosystem—collaborating closely with major health plans, employers, and leading health systems to make comprehensive midlife care a connected, covered, and standard part of healthcare.

The Role:

Midi is looking for a VP of Commercial Marketing to own the strategy, execution, and results that establish Midi as a B2B powerhouse. This is not a support function — you are the executive accountable for the commercial marketing P&L, for the pipeline our enterprise partnerships depend on, and for the credibility of the Midi brand across the entire B2B landscape.

You will build and lead a multidisciplinary marketing organization, evolve Midi's brand beyond DTC, and architect high-impact programs that expand strategic partnerships and drive member acquisition pull-through at scale. You will be judged on outcomes: pipeline generated, partnerships closed, LTV/CAC improved, and revenue influenced. You bring the strategic vision of a marketing executive and the operating discipline of someone who has personally driven a number before.

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer and sitting on the extended leadership team, this role demands command of the full commercial marketing function — team leadership, budget ownership, cross-functional influence at the C-suite and board level, and a deep, working understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, including payers, employers, health systems, and the patients we serve together.

What You'll Own:

Critical Functions:

B2B Messaging & Positioning — Partner with Midi Commercial leadership to refine positioning across payers, employers, and health system partners, crafting the narrative that creates urgency and closes the gap between interest and commitment.

Account-Based Marketing (ABM) — Architect and run high-touch, data-informed ABM strategies that penetrate high-value enterprise accounts, including large payers and Fortune 500 employers, with clear ownership of account-level outcomes.

Modern MarTech & AI-Enabled Infrastructure — Build and scale a sophisticated MarTech stack with robust attribution and end-to-end data visibility. Bring an innovation mindset to how AI and automation reshape marketing operations, content velocity, and campaign performance — you should be someone who's already using AI tools daily and pushing your team to do the same, not waiting for a mandate to do so.

Data-Driven Thought Leadership — Partner with Midi's clinical and research teams to build and run an authoritative thought-leadership engine that strengthens brand trust and fuels demand generation — and hold it accountable to pipeline impact.

Market & Competitive Intelligence — Build and maintain command of the competitive and market landscape, translating research into positioning and product marketing decisions the business acts on.

Commercial Marketing Strategy & P&L — Set and own the B2B marketing strategy, budget, and KPIs. You are accountable for the results this function delivers against Midi's enterprise growth goals, not just for producing the plan.

Pipeline & Revenue Outcomes — Drive measurable pipeline contribution and revenue influence across payer, employer, and health system channels. Own LTV/CAC as a metric you actively manage, test against, and improve — not one you simply report on.

Member Acquisition & Growth — Drive scalable, segment-specific member acquisition through continuous testing, message refinement, and multi-channel optimization, owning the growth number end to end.

Commercial Partnership — Act as the marketing counterpart to the Commercial leadership team, delivering the collateral, training, RFP support, and deal-stage content that shortens sales cycles — and take shared ownership of the commercial outcomes that result.

Leadership & Executive Alignment — Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing marketing organization. Drive alignment across executive leadership, and represent commercial marketing as a full voice at the leadership table.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role building, scaling, and running high-performing marketing teams and budgets in high-growth environments; healthcare, digital health, or a highly regulated B2B/B2B2C environment strongly preferred.
  • A demonstrated track record of owning a number — pipeline, revenue influence, LTV/CAC, or similar — and being able to speak concretely to how you moved it.
  • Deep understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, with direct experience marketing to and negotiating credibility with payers, employers, and health systems.
  • Fluency with modern marketing automation and MarTech stacks (HubSpot a plus), and genuine enthusiasm for using AI tools to increase team leverage, speed, and creative output — you see AI as a lever for competitive advantage, not a compliance checkbox.
  • Experience owning and managing a significant marketing budget.
  • Proven success architecting and executing data-driven ABM strategies that penetrate large enterprise accounts and accelerate sales pipelines.
  • Executive presence: comfortable operating and influencing at the CMO/C-suite and board level, translating strategy into a story that lands with non-marketers.
  • A bias toward action — someone who moves from strategy to execution without needing to be pushed, and who treats ambiguity as something to resolve rather than escalate.
  • Strong people leadership: a track record of hiring, mentoring, and retaining strong marketers, and of building a team culture that expects ownership rather than assigns tasks.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewBeing on medication is tough enough.  We want to make getting it the easy part.
jobs.description:
Overview

Being on medication is tough enough. We want to make getting it the easy part. Getting prescriptions to patients has become increasingly complex. When things get messy along the prescription journey, pharmaceutical manufacturers rely on us to untangle the process and create a clear path—allowing patients to build trusting relationships with their medication brands.

We’re not only committed to taking the pain out of the prescription process, but we’re also devoted to bringing the brightest minds together under one roof. We bring together diverse voices—engineers, pharmacists, customer service veterans, developers, program strategists and more—all with one vision. Each perspective and experience makes ConnectiveRx better than the sum of its parts.

The Senior Manager, Data Analyst plays a pivotal leadership role in driving the organization's data strategy and leading a team of analysts to deliver consistent reporting and impactful insights for Life Science clients, agency partners, and internal stakeholders. With deep technical expertise and comprehensive domain knowledge of Life Science sponsored messaging, this role influences organizational decisions and leads the design of advanced reporting, dashboarding, and analysis. The Senior Manager acts as a strategic advisor and collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to drive business outcomes through data.

Responsibilities

Core Areas of Focus

  • NPI-based reporting (PLD) with a focus on automating, optimizing, and scaling reporting infrastructure.
  • Claims-based analyses focused on identifying optimal audiences and assessing impact.
  • Self-service reporting solutions that enable technical and non-technical stakeholders to access data that supports business needs.
  • Rx impact reporting focused on identifying scalable solutions for complex impact analysis methodologies rooted in claims data.

Essential Functions

  • Support the development of high-quality reporting with a focus on efficiency, scalability, and advancement through new technologies such as AI-supported tools.
  • Oversee the design and execution of complex SQL and Python-based solutions, guiding the team on best practices and scalable approaches. Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure robust ETL pipelines, data integrity, and adherence to governance and security protocols.
  • Lead high-level discussions with senior executives and key stakeholders, clearly communicating complex analytics and their impact on business goals.
  • Lead and oversee the analytics team's day-to-day activities, ensuring the successful delivery of multiple concurrent data projects.
  • Mentor and coach team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Partner with senior leadership, external clients, and cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize strategic data initiatives. Evaluate and implement emerging technologies to enhance the organization's data analytics capabilities.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field required.
  • Master's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, or a related discipline strongly preferred.
  • Relevant certifications in SQL, business intelligence tools, or data strategy are preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving, leadership, and strategic thinking skills with the ability to align team activities with organizational goals.

Experience

  • 10–15 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience.
  • Proficiency with SQL and Python.
  • Experience with AWS cloud-based infrastructure.

Knowledge

  • Deep technical expertise and comprehensive domain knowledge to influence organizational decisions and lead the design of advanced reports, dashboards, and analyses.
  • Experience managing complex data initiatives, driving business-impacting insights, and mentoring junior team members.

Skills

  • Advanced SQL skills, including designing and implementing complex database schemas, utilizing CTEs and window functions, and optimizing queries for large datasets.
  • Advanced data wrangling skills, including automating data cleaning, managing large datasets, feature engineering, and data normalization.
  • Expertise in data visualization, including custom visualizations, geospatial visualizations, and interactive dashboards.
  • Strong statistical knowledge, including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, ANOVA, and the ability to interpret and communicate statistical results.
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced business intelligence solutions, including data modeling, ETL processes, and performance optimization.
  • Strong coding experience with the ability to develop complex software solutions using advanced programming techniques and frameworks. Python preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Significant healthcare domain knowledge to provide meaningful context for data analysis and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Analytical and logical reasoning
  • Oral and written communication
  • Project management
  • Negotiation and persuasion
  • Consultation
  • Decision quality

Travel Requirements

  • Travel to office locations or client sites as needed.

Compliance Requirements

Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and required training consistent with ConnectiveRx's Information Security and Compliance Programs, including SOC1, SOC2, PCI, and HIPAA requirements.

Maintain strict compliance with company and client policies regarding business rules and ethics, as well as all applicable local, state, and federal laws.

The company regularly reviews and updates its health, welfare, and fringe benefit policies to ensure competitive offerings. Employees may also participate in the company’s 401(k) plan, with employer contributions where applicable.

Time-Off & Holidays: ConnectiveRx provides a flexible paid time off (PTO) policy for exempt employees, covering sick days, personal days, and vacations. PTO is determined based on an employee’s first year of service. Les grands acteurs de l’automobile font confiance à DriiveMe pour déplacer leurs véhicules : Stellantis, Aramisauto, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar, et bien d’autres.

Partout en France, des centaines de sociétés ont besoin de déplacer des véhicules d’un point A à un point B. Elles publient chaque jour leurs besoins sur DriiveMe afin de proposer ces missions à la communauté DriiveMe Partenaire.

En quoi consiste une mission DriiveMe ?

C’est simple : en tant que chauffeur indépendant, vous conduisez un véhicule d’un point A vers un point B. Voici comment ça fonctionne :

  1. Vous créez votre compte sur

  2. Vous accédez aux missions disponibles dans votre région.

  3. Vous consultez le trajet, la rémunération et les conditions de chaque mission.

  4. Vous réservez en quelques clics les missions que vous souhaitez réaliser.

  5. Le jour de la mission, vous récupérez le véhicule au point de départ et le livrez au point d’arrivée.

  6. Une fois la mission terminée et validée, vous recevez votre paiement automatiquement sous 10 jours.

Chaque mission dispose d’une rémunération spécifique, définie selon le trajet, le nombre de kilomètres et la complexité du transport.

Our work also expands to federal agencies and public sector organizations that protect national critical infrastructure.

Internally, you will take part in designing how the legal department works with cutting edge AI technologies. On the product side, you will advise on how AI is revolutionizing our platform and be deeply involved in the go-to market and product mapping and structuring.

You will have a seat at the table on M&A deals, strategic alliances, and federal and public sector growth initiatives that define the company’s next chapter.

You will partner closely with cross-functional leadership to negotiate key contracts, manage risk, and ensure regulatory compliance in a fast-paced environment. In this high-impact position, you will help shape risk-mitigation strategies while directly supporting the business's growth and strategic objectives.

If you’re a sharp, commercially minded lawyer who likes solving hard problems, learning fast and owning things end-to-end, you’ll understand why people love it here.

  • Commercial Contracts & Deal Execution: Negotiate and close complex global commercial transactions with some of the world’s largest enterprises, including enterprise SaaS agreements and strategic partnerships.

The team is small and high-talent-density by design, not by necessity, and moves at a pace that matches the scale of what it's building.

About the Role

As Technical Lead, Machine Learning, you own the execution layer of the company's intelligence — translating research direction into reliable, scalable, production-grade ML systems. This role sits at the intersection of research, infrastructure, and product: you're responsible for making models trainable, deployable, observable, and performant under real-world constraints.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end ML system execution: data pipelines, training workflows, evaluation systems, inference architecture, deployment

  • Fine-tune and adapt models using state-of-the-art methods — LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, distillation

  • Architect and operate scalable inference systems, balancing latency, cost, and reliability

  • Design and maintain data systems for high-quality synthetic and real-world training data

  • Implement evaluation pipelines covering performance, robustness, safety, and bias, in partnership with research leadership

  • Own production deployment, including GPU optimization, memory efficiency, latency reduction, and scaling policies

  • Collaborate closely with application engineering to integrate ML systems cleanly into backend, mobile, and desktop products

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs and ship improvements quickly, learning from real usage

  • Work under real production constraints: latency, cost, reliability, and safety

Requirements

  • You've built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos

  • You're comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes

  • You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness

  • You're self-directed, pragmatic, and take full ownership of outcomes

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate well in small, high-trust teams

Tech Stack

Python · PyTorch / JAX · GPU-based training and inference systems

What Success Looks Like

  • Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets

  • ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable

  • Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact

  • Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction

  • Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time

What to Expect

The best products in the world are built by small, world-class teams. Decisions are made collectively, at rapid speed — balancing high-quality shipping with fast learning. You'll be expected to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently.

Department: Sales
