Role Overview

We are looking for a commercially-savvy, growth-oriented Customer Success Manager to drive strategic expansion across our NHS and Public Sector client portfolio. If you're passionate about unlocking commercial value, building deep client relationships, and delivering measurable impact, this is your next move.

Key responsibilities:

  • Grow and Retain Key Accounts: Manage relationships with senior stakeholders and drive expansion through upsell, cross-sell, and repeat business
  • Strategic Planning: Partner with Account Executives to shape and deliver account growth strategies aligned to client goals.
  • Executive Engagement: Deliver impactful QBRs and strategic reviews using data storytelling to surface value and opportunity.
  • Customer Advocacy & Visibility: Drive client engagement by promoting success through tailored marketing, events, and thought leadership initiatives that showcase programme impact.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Delivery, Sales Enablement and Marketing to ensure a seamless client experience and surface success stories that drive brand credibility and pipeline.
  • Commercial Acumen: Ability to link our solutions to business KPIs, identifying growth signals across regions, business units or new use cases.
  • Stakeholder Updates: Provide regular updates to HR and L&D stakeholders on learner progress and programme impact, ensuring visibility of key milestones, engagement levels, and outcomes throughout the learner journey.
  • ROI Reporting: Collect and communicate clear, data-backed ROI insights to demonstrate the business impact of our programmes.
  • Case Study Development: Own the creation of compelling public success stories—both written and video—by collaborating with Marketing and clients to showcase real-world outcomes.
  • Opportunity Identification & Lead Generation: Proactively surface new strategic needs, use cases, or expansion areas within accounts, and help drive lead generation for new programmes and audiences.

Candidate Specification:

  • Proven track record: Experience in growing & retaining strategic enterprise accounts within digital, data, AI or tech environments.
  • Commercial mindset: You spot and shape revenue opportunities and understand what matters to C-suite stakeholders.
  • Strategic and analytical: You bring insights to life through data storytelling, dashboards and engaging presentations that link impact to business priorities. Experience using CRM tools like HubSpot to manage account workflows and reporting is beneficial.
  • Solution-focused: Confident in solving complex challenges and navigating ambiguity.
  • Customer-focused: Passionate about delivering value and ensuring a gold-standard experience.
  • Executive presence: You can influence and build trust with senior decision-makers in large enterprises.
  • Self-starter: Energetic, organised and disciplined—able to thrive in a high-autonomy, remote-first environment with occasional travel.
  • Enterprise methodology awareness: An understanding of strategic enterprise sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Sandler) is preferred for identifying opportunities and supporting commercial value

Company Benefits:

Background to our Organisation

We are an education technology company that enables corporate and government organisations to achieve their business goals by educating their workforce with critical digital transformation skills to succeed in the AI era.

We deliver unique and innovative professional education that is accelerating the digital transformation of our clients, advancing the careers of their employees, helping people get into work and closing the digital skills gap. Tangible is a fast-growing, tech-enabled platform providing liquidity solutions to LPs and GPs in the private markets secondaries ecosystem. By combining deep sector expertise with modern infrastructure, we unlock liquidity across private equity, private credit, and real assets, enabling investors to move faster and smarter.

Role Overview

You will be a senior leader on Tangible's Deal Team, partnering directly with the founders to own the firm's most complex and strategically important transactions end-to-end, from origination and structuring through commercial negotiation and close. You will personally lead live deals, not just oversee them.

You will manage and mentor a team of Deal Managers and Analysts, set the bar for execution quality, and shape how Tangible scales its deal-making capacity through people, process, and platform. You will represent Tangible externally at principal level with GPs, LPs, placement agents, and institutional counterparties.

The role demands someone who combines genuine senior transactional depth with entrepreneurial instinct. The platform is young, the deal flow is complex, and you will be expected to get into the details of the hardest conversations.

Tasks

Deal Leadership & Execution

  • Lead live transactions end-to-end across GP-led continuation vehicles, LP portfolio sales, direct secondaries, fund-of-fund liquidity, and NAV / preferred solutions.
  • Own the most commercially and legally demanding conversations with GPs, LPs, advisors, and counsel.
  • Make the judgment calls on pricing, structuring, portfolio construction, and deal trade-offs.
  • Take accountability for transactions from negotiation through to close, partnering with the Closing team on execution handoff.

Origination & Counterparty Relationships

  • Leverage and expand an existing network across GPs, LPs, secondaries advisors, placement agents, and institutional investors to source proprietary deal flow.
  • Build and maintain senior-level relationships with secondaries advisors, fund managers, and institutional counterparties across jurisdictions.
  • Represent Tangible externally in market conversations, conferences, and principal-to-principal dialogue.

Deal Team Leadership

  • Manage and develop a team of senior leads and junior team members.
  • Set execution standards, and mentor the next layer of deal talent.
  • Partner with the founders on hiring, succession, and team design as the deal function scales.

Strategy & Platform Scale

  • Work with the founders on deal team strategy, capacity planning, and pricing philosophy.
  • Partner with Product, BD, and Compliance to translate lived deal experience into standardised workflows, buyer profiles, and platform capabilities.
  • Identify where technology can create leverage over manual execution and help design the operating model.

Regulatory & Compliance

  • Operate within FINRA, FCA, and other applicable regulatory frameworks.
  • Liaise with internal compliance and external counsel to ensure that transactions comply with jurisdictional requirements.

Requirements

You are a senior transactional professional with a demonstrable track record of leading complex private-market transactions from origination through close.

To succeed in this role, you bring:

  • 10+ years in private-market transactions, with a material portion in secondaries, private equity, fund-of-funds, or adjacent private-markets M&A advisory.
  • Prior experience at Vice President, Director level at a secondaries advisor, investment bank, financial sponsors / M&A team, or similar institution.
  • A clear track record of leading transactions from origination to close, including owning the hardest commercial and legal negotiations.
  • A strong external network across GPs, LPs, advisors, and institutional counterparties.
  • Experience building, managing, and mentoring a deal team or sub-team.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and genuine appetite to work in a high-growth, tech-enabled environment where process and infrastructure are still being built.
  • Clear, direct communication, written and verbal, with sophisticated external counterparties and internal stakeholders.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Secondaries experience at a tier-one advisor (e.g. Campbell Lutyens, Evercore PCA, PJT Park Hill, Lazard, Jefferies, or equivalent Greenhill, Moelis).
  • Deep exposure to GP-led continuation vehicles, NAV lending, or preferred equity structures.
  • Existing FINRA Series 7 / 63 / 79 registration.
  • Prior experience at a growth-stage firm or tech-enabled platform scaling a deal function.
  • Fluency with US- and UK-law transaction documentation and multi-jurisdictional closing processes.

Enterprise Applications Manager

Location: Remote, United States

About the Role

We are seeking a highly technical and strategic Enterprise Applications Manager to join our CRM & Revenue Technology team within Revenue Operations. This newly created role sits at the intersection of Revenue Operations and Product Management, serving as the technical bridge between our Salesforce CRM ecosystem and internally developed enterprise applications.

As the Enterprise Applications Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of complex integration projects spanning Salesforce, Credit Platform, Data Platform, Entity Management, and Onboarding systems. This role requires a unique blend of technical depth (integration architecture, API design, Workato development), operational excellence (RevOps processes, data governance), and product thinking (requirements gathering, stakeholder management, feature prioritization).

You will be the primary business point of contact for all enterprise application projects, partnering with Engineering, Product, GTM leadership, and Revenue Operations to design scalable integration solutions that enable revenue growth. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role requiring strong technical skills, excellent communication abilities, and a self-starter mentality. You'll be working in a dynamic environment where you'll need to balance competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and drive projects from requirements gathering through deployment and ongoing optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Integration Architecture & Implementation

  • Own the design and deployment of integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications (Credit Platform, Data Platform, Entity Management, Onboarding) using Workato or similar iPaaS platforms
  • Design integration patterns that ensure data consistency, real-time synchronization, and proper error handling across systems; establish integration best practices and reusable patterns for the team
  • Define Requirements for API connections between Salesforce and internal applications; understand REST/SOAP APIs, authentication methods (OAuth, API keys), and webhook architectures
  • Gather requirements for complex Workato recipes including conditional logic, data transformations, lookup tables, error handling, and batch processing; optimize recipes for performance and reliability
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for all integrations; proactively identify and resolve integration failures, performance issues, and data quality problems

Project Management & Product Ownership

  • Act as technical product owner for enterprise application initiatives; gather requirements from GTM stakeholders, translate business needs into technical specifications, and prioritize feature requests
  • Create detailed technical documentation including integration architecture diagrams, data flow maps, API specifications, and user guides for enterprise applications
  • Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) coordination; develop test plans, manage UAT execution with business users, track defects, and ensure successful production deployment
  • Build product roadmaps for enterprise applications in collaboration with stakeholders; balance technical debt, new feature requests, and operational maintenance needs

Salesforce Administration & Configuration

  • Create Salesforce product roadmap to support enterprise application integrations, including custom objects, fields, validation rules, process builders, flows, and permission sets
  • Manage complex Salesforce data models spanning multiple custom objects and relationships; ensure data integrity and optimize for reporting and integration performance
  • Create and maintain Salesforce reports, dashboards, and list views to provide visibility into enterprise application data and integration health for stakeholders
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators to ensure alignment on data governance, security model, and platform best practices across all enterprise integrations

Data Governance & Quality Assurance

  • Establish and enforce data governance standards for enterprise applications including data dictionaries, field definitions, validation rules, and master data management policies
  • Own data quality for all enterprise application integrations; implement automated data validation, cleansing routines, and exception handling to ensure data accuracy

Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Salesforce administration, or technical product management roles with heavy integration/systems focus
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems using iPaaS platforms (Workato strongly preferred; Zapier, MuleSoft, or similar also acceptable)
  • Deep Salesforce knowledge including data model, security model, automation tools (Flow, Process Builder), custom objects, and API capabilities; Salesforce Administrator certification preferred
  • Strong understanding of API concepts including REST/SOAP, JSON/XML, authentication methods (OAuth 2.0, API keys), rate limiting, and error handling
  • Strong SQL skills for data analysis and troubleshooting; experience querying databases and understanding relational data models
  • Advanced Excel skills for data analysis, transformation, and mapping exercises (XLOOKUP, pivot tables, complex formulas)
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or financial services environments with complex revenue operations and compliance requirements
  • Understanding of revenue operations workflows including lead-to-opportunity, customer onboarding, and renewal processes

Key Competencies

  • Systems thinker with ability to understand complex technical architectures and how systems interact across the enterprise technology stack
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working cross-functionally across Engineering, Product, Operations, and GTM teams to deliver shared outcomes
  • Self-starter with strong ownership mentality; able to take ambiguous requirements and deliver complete solutions with minimal supervision
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills; able to diagnose integration failures, data issues, and performance problems methodically
  • Strong communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and influence decision-making at all levels
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data quality, security best practices, and technical documentation
  • Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity; able to thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities shift and requirements evolve
  • Product mindset with focus on user experience, scalability, and long-term maintainability of technical solutions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Workato certification or extensive hands-on experience building production-grade integrations in Workato
  • Salesforce Admin Certification
  • Experience with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Fivetran) and understanding of ELT/ETL patterns

  • Experience with API testing tools (Postman, Insomnia) and debugging integration issues
  • Previous experience in a technical product management or business systems analyst role

This is an exciting opportunity to build and scale the enterprise application ecosystem for a growing Revenue Operations team. Join our Product team as a Senior Product Manager and play a critical role in advancing accessible digital experiences at enterprise scale. You will own and develop a core product domain within the Level Access platform. You will get results across several squads and help invent how we build and deliver AI-powered products.

This position suits a senior-level PM who works well with strategy execution, systems thinking, and AI-enabled product development. You will focus on customer impact and improving product excellence throughout the organization.

Mission of the Role

You will be accountable for defining, refining, and implementing a key product strategy area focused on helping customers efficiently improve and maintain digital accessibility within live, production environments.

This includes translating strategic intent into executable plans, validating direction through customer and market signals, and evolving solutions over time as user needs, platform capabilities, and AI technologies advance.

In parallel, you will serve as a role model and thought partner within the product organization:

  • AI-powered product discovery and delivery methods
  • High‑rigor experimentation and decision‑making
  • Scalable, results-focused product delivery

Core Responsibilities

Strategy Ownership & Execution

  • Be responsible for a significant product area and drive execution against a defined strategy, ensuring alignment with company objectives and long‑term platform direction.
  • Continuously refine strategy based on customer insight, data, technical constraints, and evolving AI capabilities.
  • Translate strategy into clear multi‑quarter roadmaps, investment trade‑offs, and success metrics.
  • Drive alignment across product, engineering, data science, design, and go‑to‑market teams.

AI‑Native Product Leadership

  • Lead product discovery and delivery using AI‑enabled workflows (e.g., rapid prototyping, automation‑assisted analysis, iterative improvements).
  • Partner closely with engineering and data science teams to deliver AI‑powered customer experiences, from early concepts through production and iteration.
  • Ensure AI‑driven features are trustworthy, measurable, and meaningfully improve user and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to shared standards for responsibly shipping AI capabilities in enterprise software.

Product Ownership & Multi‑Squad Delivery

  • Serve as the product manager across one or more squads, accountable for outcomes rather than output.
  • Drive complex initiatives from discovery through general availability, leading dependencies and cross‑team coordination.
  • Balance innovation with platform quality, scalability, and technical debt considerations.
  • Ensure strong product quality through clear requirements, testing alignment, and post‑launch validation.

Customer, Market & Insight Leadership

  • Maintain a deep understanding of customer workflows, difficulties, and success criteria particularly within enterprise environments.
  • Engage directly with customers to validate problems, test solutions, and refine value propositions.
  • Stay informed on digital accessibility standards and regulatory trends and how they intersect with modern enterprise technology.
  • Monitor market and competitive signals and proactively adapt product direction.

Team & Org Impact

  • Model Senior PM behaviors and expectations across:
  • Critical thinking and execution
  • Data fluency and insight generation
  • Technical depth and system understanding
  • User empathy and evidence‑based decision‑making
  • Mentor and influence other PMs through thought partnership, feedback, and example.
  • Act as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, clearly articulating trade‑offs, risks, and rationale.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with shown success operating at a Senior PM level.
  • Experience owning strategy and execution for complex platform or SaaS products.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver outcomes across multiple squads or large product areas.
  • Strong technical fluency, including a working understanding of modern web technologies and system architecture.
  • Experience contributing to or shipping AI‑enabled or data‑driven product features.
  • High data literacy, including defining success metrics, running experiments, and tying decisions to business outcomes.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience working in an environment using AI‑enabled product discovery and delivery practices.
  • Experience building products for enterprise, developer, or technically sophisticated users.
  • Familiarity with digital accessibility standards and conformance workflows.
  • Comfort driving alignment and decision‑making across disciplines without direct authority.

Nice to Have

  • Background in software engineering, QA automation, or data‑oriented roles.
  • Experience building tools that support remediation, compliance, or continuous improvement workflows.
  • Knowledge of evolving digital accessibility regulations and standards.
  • Experience designing for diverse personas and inclusive user experiences.

How This Role Operates at a Senior PM Level

This role is designed for someone who:

  • Drives strategy and execution with minimal guidance
  • Owns outcomes across squads and initiatives
  • Is a go‑to expert for their product domain
  • Uses data, user insight, and technical judgment fluently
  • Raises the performance bar for the broader product team
  • Ships high‑quality products that deliver measurable customer and business impact

Application Process

If you thrive in a fast‑paced environment and you are eager to make a significant impact in the field of accessibility, we would love to hear from you! This is a full‑time, salaried position offering a competitive benefits package, including bonus opportunities, generous paid time off, paid holidays, and a range of programs designed to support employee well‑being and work‑life balance. jobs.description:
Sobre a Indigo Hive

A Indigo Hive é uma empresa brasileira fundada em 2019 que atua como SaaS B2B, desenvolvendo produtos proprietários de inteligência artificial e automação para grandes empresas e governos. Diferente de uma consultoria, entregam soluções escaláveis que já nascem como plataformas próprias, mas com flexibilidade para se adaptar às necessidades específicas de cada cliente graças à integração com IA generativa. Entre seus clientes estão Braskem, Danone, Eurofarma e órgãos como o INSS e o Ministério da Saúde.

Fazem parte do seu portfólio produtos como o Cogfy (plataforma de mensageria e automação) e, mais recentemente, um novo produto EdTech já lançado com contratos firmados junto a diversas prefeituras no Brasil. Seu ritmo é acelerado, valorizam autonomia, execução e pensamento crítico, e buscam pessoas que queiram construir soluções que realmente mudam a forma como grandes ecossistemas funcionam.

O que fazem:

Eles desenvolvem soluções como:

  • Copilotos conversacionais internos e altamente seguros
    ● Plataformas de extração automática de informações
    ● Automação de processos corporativos
    ● Portais e experiências interativas baseadas em IA
    ● Modelos generativos para texto, vídeo, imagem e detecção de fraude (ex.: KYC)

    Contexto do Produto:
    O Cogfy é a plataforma proprietária de IA generativa da Indigo Hive e hoje funciona como o grande motor tecnológico por trás das soluções da empresa. Ele nasceu com a proposta de permitir que grandes corporações e governos construam copilotos conversacionais, automações inteligentes e sistemas de análise avançada com rapidez, segurança e profundidade técnica.

    O produto combina modelos generativos com machine learning tradicional, criando uma infraestrutura flexível e poderosa para diferentes cenários corporativos. De forma prática, o Cogfy possibilita que empresas transformem processos complexos em fluxos automatizados, permitindo integrações profundas com sistemas internos e acelerando a tomada de decisão. Além das capacidades de texto, o Cogfy atua em múltiplos formatos; vídeo, imagem e detecção de fraude, ampliando o escopo de uso e atendendo demandas como KYC, automação operacional e portais de extração automática.

    O Cogfy possibilita:

    ● Copilotos conversacionais corporativos (um “ChatGPT interno”, com segurança e conexão a sistemas).
    ● Portais inteligentes capazes de extrair e estruturar informações de documentos automaticamente. ● Automação de processos em áreas como benefícios, CRM, estratégia, operações e suporte.
    ● Aplicações multimodais, lidando com texto, imagem, vídeo e validação de identidade/fraude.
    ● Integrações robustas, apoiadas por APIs e arquitetura de microsserviços.

    A base tecnológica que sustenta o Cogfy inclui: ● Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind
    ● Backend: .NET e Node.js
    ● Bancos de dados: SQL e NoSQL
    ● Arquitetura: APIs REST, microsserviços e integrações de alta complexidade

    O Cogfy está em forte expansão e hoje é o principal vetor de crescimento da Indigo Hive, permitindo que novas soluções sejam construídas de maneira muito rápida, escalável e tecnicamente sofisticada.

    O Desafio do Papel
    Precisamos de quem entra entregando. É um projeto de ritmo alto, com escopo claro e prazos curtos. Você ajudará a colocar de pé os três módulos em paralelo, mantendo qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade para futuro handover.

    Frontend: React, TypeScript e Tailwind
    Backend: Node.js, .NET e Integrações intensivas com mensageria/WhatsApp e serviços de analytics
    Infraestrutura: AWS (migração/homologação definitiva na nuvem) e serviços específicos serão alinhados com o time (ex.: bancos gerenciados, filas, storage, observabilidade)

    Padrões desejáveis: Serviços modulares, testes automatizados, CI/CD, boas práticas de segurança e logs / metrics / alerts Eles também usam outras linguagens/tecnologias.

    Foco: boa base, vontade de trabalhar com a stack, capacidade técnica.

    Responsabilidades ● Projetar, desenvolver e manter aplicações fullstack robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance.
    ● Participar ativamente de decisões de arquitetura e melhores práticas de engenharia.
    ● Colaborar com times de produto, design e ciência de dados para construir soluções inovadoras e orientadas a impacto.
    ● Criar e evoluir APIs, integrações e componentes frontend reutilizáveis.
    ● Trabalhar com alto nível de autonomia, senso de dono e foco absoluto em entrega.
    ● Resolver problemas complexos usando tanto criatividade quanto rigor técnico. Tecnologias A stack principal envolve Node.js, React e TypeScript, mas não é imprescindível ser especialista nessas tecnologias.

    A Indigo valoriza profissionais com grande capacidade de aprendizado, iniciativa e adaptabilidade.

    Perfil que brilha aqui:
    ● Senioridade prática: sabe priorizar, corta escopo com elegância e entrega
    ● Conforto com React e ao menos um backend (Node.js)
    ● Vivência com AWS e boas práticas de observabilidade
    ● Diferenciais: edtech, gamificação, mensageria/WhatsApp, PRM/CRM, pagamentos/recorrência
    ● Curiosidade intelectual
    ● Profundidade

    O que não esperam: ● Perfil acomodado
    ● Ritmo lento
    ● Dependente de muita tutela
    ● Apego a tecnologia por si só, sem foco em valor e prazo
    ● Falta de curiosidade

    Modelo de Trabalho ● Preferência: Remoto ou Híbrido

    Remuneração e Benefícios:
    ● Ambiente de alta visibilidade, desafios reais de escala e ownership desde o dia zero
    ● Picpay flexível ~ R$800
    ● Plano de Saúde sem desconto e co-participação
    ● Equipamento
    ● Férias remuneradas (30 dias/ano)

● Escritório pet friendly

Must haves:
● Experiência como Fullstack Engineer. (Média 2 a 7 anos)
● Histórico de alta performance profissional e acadêmica, autonomia e capacidade de entrega.

● Curiosidade e alto nível intelectual.

● Formação acadêmica sólida

Por que trabalhar na Indigo Hive? ● Atuar com tecnologias de fronteira em IA generativa.
● Fazer parte de um time de altíssima densidade intelectual.
● Ambiente que recompensa autonomia, iniciativa e execução impecável.
● Oportunidade real de impactar empresas globais e projetos estratégicos.
● Crescimento rápido junto a uma empresa em forte expansão.

jobs.description:
To independently and efficiently perform the responsibilities assigning accurate diagnosis and procedures codes to the patients health information records for: Emergency Department (ED), Ambulatory Surgical Center (ASC), Hospital Ambulatory Surgical Center (HAS), Observations (OBS), Inpatient (IP) and other selected facility records. Maintain an acceptable level of performance in quality and productivity for ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, and HCPCS/CPT classification and nomenclature systems. All work will be carried out in accordance with the: International Classification of Diseases - Official Coding Guidelines for coding and reporting as established by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) and the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS); American Medical Association (CPT); National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI); Uniform Hospital Discharge Data Set (UHDDS), Medicaid (OMAP), and Kaiser Permanente organization/institutional coding directives. Ability to communicate with physicians in order to obtain clarification for diagnoses/procedures. Ability to understand the clinical content of the health record and abstract the data in the patient health information record data as well as perform other duties assigned. The position requires the new coder to be on-site for one (1) week training or until they meet the departments expectations.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Proficient in medical record review and translating clinical information into coded data. Identify and assign appropriate codes for diagnoses, procedures and other services rendered, while also validating any Computer Assisted Coded (CAC) assignments for dual coding. Utilizing the Code Base Charge Trigger system (CBCT) and OPTUM 360 EncoderPRO software system for professional surgical services, analyzing and maintaining systems accuracy, validity and meaningfulness for both professional and facility services. Utilizes electronic patient data system and clinical information system (EpicCare) to access patient encounter information. Abstracts and enters clinical data elements as defined by the needs of the organization. Identifies and assigns principal diagnosis and procedure codes, sequencing them as needed for proper Ambulatory Payment Classification (APC), Medicare Severity-Drug Related Group (MS-DRG), All Patients Refined Diagnosis Related Groups (APR-DRG) assignment, utilizing applicable coding conventions. Demonstrates knowledge and understand of CMS HCC Risk Adjustment coding. Routinely performs chart analysis to identify areas of the medical record that contain incomplete, inaccurate or inconsistent documentation. Reviews and verifies chart information (i.e. POS, attending provider). Assesses and inputs data. Reviews and verifies component parts of medical records to ensure completeness and accuracy of diagnostic and therapeutic procedures that must conform to CMS coding rules and guidelines. Meets and maintains department standards 95% for productivity and quality. Coding Auditor Senior spends a minimum of 80% of work time assigning codes to Inpatient records.
  • Fully utilizes resources available such as, Coding Clinic and CPT Assistant to research issues to apply coding guidelines. Identifies coding concerns and informs supervisors, managers as appropriate. Utilizes query process when appropriate. Assists in implementing solutions to reduce back-end coding errors. Stays current on coding and regulatory publications, attends workshops to stay abreast of current issues, trends, changes in the laws and regulations governing medical record coding and documentation to mitigate the risk of fraud and abuse and to optimize revenue recovery.
  • May assist with special projects. Maintain confidentiality and effective working relationships with staff. Communicate in a clear and understandable manner, exercises independent judgment. Reviews annual ICD-10 Official Guidelines for Coding, along with review of quarterly Coding Clinic and monthly CPT Assistant. Performs as a team member of Facility Coding Services, and actively participates with peers coding in-services, staff meetings, reporting of performance measures, and quality outcome monitors. May participate in development of organizational procedures. Attends and participates in selected national and regional coding education sessions. Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

Experience

  • Minimum five (5) years experience in coding with four (4) years inpatient facility coding or minimum four (4) years in the Kaiser Coding Auditor position with proficiency in inpatient coding.

Education

  • High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED) required.

License, Certification, Registration

The candidate must have 1 from the following list:

  • Registered Health Information Technician Certificate
  • Coding Specialist Certificate
  • Registered Health Information Administrator Certificate

Additional Requirements:

  • Previous experience with EMR patient documentation system with intermediate knowledge and skill in the use of a computer.
  • Advance knowledge of disease processes, diagnostic and surgical procedures, Inpatient ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, HCPCS/CPT classification systems, health information/medical record department responsibilities with knowledge of government regulations and areas of scrutiny for potential fraud and abuse issues.
  • Advanced knowledge of medical terminology, pharmacology and medial coding principles for ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, HCPCS/CPT and coding.
  • Fluent in English, demonstrating skill and proficiency in oral and written communication.
  • Skills in time management, organization and analytical skills.
  • Ability to manage a significant workload and to work efficiently under pressure meeting established deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to use independent thought and judgement.
  • Abides by the Standards of Ethical Coding as set for by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA).
  • Meets and maintains department standard for performance, productivity and quality.
  • Department will furnish final candidate a coding skill test. The candidate will be required to pass with a 75% or better on the test.
  • Academic knowledge and working experience performing coding and abstracting responsibilities in health information/medical record services.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Minimum five (5) years of experience in health information/Medical record environment, with facility coding experience that includes Medicare reimbursement guidelines.
  • Degree in Health Information Management.
  • Proficient knowledge and skill in the use of a computer and related system and software to include: EMR(s), Microsoft Office Suite and other software programs.
  • Ability to evaluate, analyze, develop information regarding mathematical statistics and percentages that compare finding trends and outcomes related to productivity and /ore medical record audits.
  • Extensive knowledge of ICD-10 coding guidelines; with knowledge and demonstrated understand of CMS HCC Risk Adjustment coding and data validation requirements.

Candidates must reside either in Washington or Oregon to be considered for this position

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

The US is the most demanding and most competitive GRC market in the world — home to security-first enterprises, mature CISO organisations, and the highest bar for what a compliance partner should be. This is where our enterprise ambition is heading, and we're looking for an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to own that frontier.

You'll be one of the early voices defining how Sprinto shows up for US enterprises: carrying a portfolio of high-value accounts, earning the trust of senior security and compliance leaders, and turning first-time adopters of AI-powered GRC automation into long-term, expanding partnerships. Your wins won't just move your book — they'll shape how we win this segment for the years ahead.

  • Be a trusted advisor to security and compliance leadership. Engage directly with CISOs, CIOs, CPOs, Chief Risk Officers, and their teams as a strategic advisor, translating security, compliance, and best-practice insight into outcomes that matter to their business.

  • Lead complex GRC transformation programs. Own the planning and execution of multi-framework, multi-stakeholder GRC transformation initiatives — spanning SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and adjacent US-relevant standards — partnering with internal product and delivery teams to align outcomes to customer goals.

  • Drive strategic reviews. Lead Quarterly and Executive Business Reviews (QBRs and EBRs), presenting value realised and aligning on forward strategy with both operational and executive stakeholders.

  • Shape playbooks and mentor as an SME. Act as a subject-matter expert within the CS org — codifying what works, feeding it back into process and enablement, and mentoring other CSMs on complex enterprise scenarios as the team scales.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

  • Demonstrated ownership of net revenue retention, renewals, and expansion across a portfolio of strategic, high-ACV accounts.

About the Position

FiscalNote Europe is seeking an independent Policy Analyst to support its Brussels operations on a contract basis. You will be responsible for directing and quality-controlling AI-assisted monitoring and reporting on EU policy, ensuring that our clients are up to date with the latest developments and that everything reaching them has been verified for accuracy. As an Analyst, you will use FiscalNote's own AI-powered platform reviewing, correcting and contextualising its output, and helping calibrate the tool itself as you go. You will also gain further experience in understanding EU issues more in depth, with continuous training and support to develop both your subject-matter expertise and your ability to work critically alongside AI tools.

About the FiscalNote EU Issue Tracker Team

Fundamentally aligned with FiscalNote's core mission of connecting the world to its governments, the EU Issue Tracker team helps its clients identify policy opportunities and threats in the EU. Combining FiscalNote's own AI-powered legislative and regulatory tracking with the judgement of our analyst team, we deliver objective, structured and accurate near real-time EU horizon-scanning that gives our clients a systematic edge in regulatory monitoring. Our dedicated analysts work with Product and Business Development teams to make sure AI-generated intelligence is verified, contextualised and translated into the right insight for our client base at the right time. Insightful and diligent, the EU Issue Tracker team works in a fast-paced, continuous-learning environment where teamwork, subject-matter expertise and a critical eye on our own technology are vital for producing the reliable, high-quality analysis we are known for.

About You

You are passionate about EU affairs and eager to learn more. You are detail-oriented and able to pick up the main points quickly even in the most complex texts, including spotting where an AI-generated summary has missed or misread something important. Time management and structuring yourself to manage several tasks simultaneously is something you take pride in. You are a team player who can step in and help others while not being afraid to ask for assistance yourself, and you are comfortable working in a technology-augmented workflow without losing your own critical judgement. Being part of a dynamic and international team is an environment that you enjoy working in.

This is an initial 2-to-3-month independent contractor engagement (with potential for extension), offering a monthly fee of €3,250.

What To Expect In This Position

  • Direct and quality-control AI-assisted regulatory monitoring in the area of EU policy, verifying accuracy and flagging what the platform misses or gets wrong before it reaches a client
  • Collect, structure and analyse data to help calibrate and improve FiscalNote's own digital tools and public affairs platform, contributing directly to product accuracy and development in an iterative process
  • Translate AI-generated monitoring and analysis into client-relevant insight, including flash reports and briefings, and support issues-management work
  • Gain in-depth knowledge about EU legislation and specific EU procedures
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously with high attention to detail and tight deadlines, including quality-assurance checkpoints on AI-generated deliverables before client delivery
  • Provide input to the Business Development Team and participate in internal projects
  • Work both independently and as part of a small team

What Sets You Apart

  • Master's in EU Law or EU Affairs/Politics
  • Good understanding of EU legislative procedures and regulatory processes
  • Knowledge of EU politics and policymaking
  • Comfort using and critically evaluating AI-assisted research and monitoring tools curious about how technology can improve intelligence gathering, without taking its output at face value
  • Ability to write policy briefings, flash reports, and long-form analysis to a consistently high standard
  • Experience working in EU public or regulatory affairs is an advantage
  • Native or equivalent written and spoken English, plus other EU languages
  • Enjoy being part of a fast-paced, and dynamic team

  • Own the end-to-end vulnerability and detection lifecycle — from discovery, triage, and prioritization through remediation and reporting.

  • Build and publish risk dashboards, customer-facing reports, and executive briefings using Splunk, Power BI, Elastic, or AMS/VIPR.

  • Develop and maintain the Armis Vulnerability Prioritization Model (VPM) — aligning exploit intelligence, CVSS/EPSS scoring, Armis Proprietary Risk Scoring, and business criticality to guide customer risk posture.

  • Support penetration test remediation, red team findings, and customer security audits.

  • Author weekly vulnerability intelligence reports, zero-day summaries, and leadership briefings for APJ/APAC stakeholders.

jobs.excerpt: At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.
jobs.description:
At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.

Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products.

As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value.

Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together!

What is this role about? 🚀

As a Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager at Bondora, you'll take ownership of the affiliate marketing channel for Go & Grow, managing and growing the partnerships that bring new investors to the platform. You'll work with content creators, publishers, comparison sites, communities, and affiliate networks across Europe, while building a strong pipeline of new partners.

This is a highly autonomous, hands-on role where you'll combine partner management with business development — strengthening existing relationships, sourcing and onboarding new affiliates, negotiating commercial agreements, and using data and AI to continuously improve partner performance. You'll work closely with Product, Data, Engineering, Brand, CRM, Legal, and Compliance to optimise the full journey from first click to long-term investor value.

You'll have the opportunity to own and shape one of Go & Grow's key growth channels, with direct access to senior leadership and significant freedom to improve how the affiliate programme operates and scales.

Your main responsibilities 🎯

  • Own and Execute the affiliate marketing channel strategy, operating plan, forecast and performance.
  • Source, qualify and close direct partnerships with affiliates (in other words publishers: content creators, comparison sites, communities and relevant affiliate networks).
  • Create clear segmentation, outreach, onboarding and activation routines that move partners from prospect to live
  • Design and negotiate CPA, CPL, fixed-fee and hybrid deals
  • Define and improve the funnel from click and sign-up through funded investor, first 30-day deposits, repeat deposits and 30/60/90-day retained value.
  • Operate and improve Target Circle/Circlewise
  • Build partner- and cohort-level reporting covering acquisition cost, revenue (deposits) value, retention, net revenue (net deposits)
  • Test placements, content, landing pages, incentives, creative and localized messaging with Brand, CRM, Product and Design.
  • Apply country-specific financial-promotion rules, execute approval workflows, required disclosures, content monitoring and documentation together with Legal and Compliance.

What would ensure success in this role?💪

  • Expert in at least one partner management platform (Affiliate platforms such as Target Circle/Circlewise, Impact, Awin or Partnerize, CJ

  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets and BI dashboard experience

  • AI fluency: Comfortable using AI tools for data analysis, partner research and qualification, and content/compliance review, with strong judgment on when human verification is essential.

  • Fluent in English and German is a plus

What can you expect at Bondora?

  • 🎯 Be part of Bondora’s ambitious journey toward 1BN in revenue - your work will have a real impact.
  • 💰 Enjoy a competitive salary and amazing benefits: 5 weeks of vacation, private healthcare compensation, hobby grant, mental health support, share options, and much more!
  • 📈 Work in an environment that encourages growth and innovation - with resources and budget for continuous learning.

The next steps

If you have the guts, ideas, and a team vision, apply now!

Our hiring process:

1️⃣ Meet Anna, our Recruiter — your first chat to share your story and ambitions.
2️⃣ Meet Krzysztof Schmidt, CMO at Go&Grow
3️⃣ Tackle a home task to showcase your skills.
4️⃣ Complete our personality and logic assessments via Alva Labs.
5️⃣ Meeting Pärtel Tomberg, CEO of Bondora
6️⃣ Chat with Olga Kikas, our Chief of People
7️⃣ 🎉 If the stars align — welcome to Bondora!

Join our team of Bondorians, and let's make it happen!

jobs.excerpt: About LyraLyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships.
jobs.description:
About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role

Our physicians practice in a collaborative care model, closely consulting with psychiatrists and primary care physicians to provide clients with easily-accessible, culturally-responsive, high-quality mental health care. You always have a team behind you, even while working remotely. And our technology platform makes it easy to refer patients to therapy and coaching services in tandem with your care.

As a part-time Mental Health Telemedicine Physician you’ll provide short-term, evidence-based treatment via live 90-minute video intake appointments and 30-minute follow-up appointments. You'll conduct mental health evaluations and provide mental health medication management. Lyra's clients come from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally-responsive care—an approach that is mindful of the impact of cultural background on each person’s care experience.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Practice comprehensive, virtual mental health medication management via a 90-minute intake appointment and 30-minute follow-up appointments

  • Conduct mental health risk assessments and evaluations

  • Document treatment recommendations, message patients, and prescribe medication using Lyra’s custom-built mental health EHR

  • Consult with team psychiatrist and peers in regular 1:1 and group consultation

Role Requirements:

  • Board certified MD or DO, ideally in internal medicine or family medicine

  • Two+ years post residency, with experience in longitudinal, continuity of care models

  • Unrestricted license

  • Strong interest in, and passion for, mental health

  • Desire to deepen expertise in mental health care

  • Excellent time management skills

  • Comfortable using technology to deliver care virtually

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States

  • Able to dedicate 20 hours total across 3-5 days per week. Flexible scheduling is allowed and encouraged, however the primary commitment is during regular business hours with some patient communication requiring communication outside of these set hours as well.

Lyra Benefits:

  • Advance your career with training in mental healthcare through a collaborative care model

  • Paid onboarding and training

  • Determine your own schedule and work remotely from your own home or office. Get paid for administrative time—not just clinical hours

  • 401k with up to 3% matching

  • Competitive time off with pay policies, including vacation, sick days, and company holidays

  • Access to the tools and equipment you’ll need to be successful in your role, including a Lyra laptop, custom-built EHR, and UpToDate software

  • Full malpractice coverage

  • Offer licensing support when new licenses are requested

  • CME reimbursement opportunities and CME accredited hours through ongoing training

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Paid Acquisition
jobs.excerpt: Apollo. io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises.
jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Your Role & Mission

As the Senior Manager of Paid Acquisition, you will own Apollo.io's performance marketing engine across all paid channels. You will lead a team of highly proficient channel specialists, driving scalable, efficient growth through Paid Search, Paid Social, Connected TV, Audio, OOH, and emerging channels. You'll operate as both strategic architect and hands-on operator, setting the vision for how paid acquisition fuels Apollo's growth while staying close enough to the data to drive results directly. You'll be a key voice in our growth strategy and a culture-builder who raises the bar for the team around you.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of paid channel specialists across Paid Search (Google, Bing), Paid Social (Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit), TV, Audio, OOH, and adjacent channels.
  • Manage an 8-figure annual budget with a relentless focus on efficiency, incrementality, and pipeline contribution.
  • Build and evolve Apollo's full measurement and attribution framework, including pixel configurations, CAPI integrations, and marketing mix modeling.
  • Drive a systematic testing and experimentation strategy across creative, audience, bid strategy, landing pages, and channel mix.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Creative, Brand, Analytics, Product, and Finance to align paid programs with broader company goals.
  • Own forecasting, pacing, and performance reporting, translating data into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Manage relationships with external agencies, media partners, and technology vendors.
  • Champion both PLG and SLG acquisition motions, understanding how paid channels serve different parts of the funnel and buying journey.

Skills & Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in performance marketing, with significant time in B2B SaaS.
  • Proven track record of driving strong, measurable results at a high-growth company managing a large, complex media budget.
  • Deep hands-on expertise across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and offline channels (TV, Audio, OOH).
  • Strong command of tracking and attribution; pixel setup, server-side/CAPI configurations, UTM frameworks, and multi-touch attribution models.
  • Highly analytical; comfortable working in data tools (e.g., Looker & Amplitude) and partnering closely with analytics teams.
  • Experienced at building, managing, and mentoring senior individual contributors.
  • Excellent communicator who distills complex data into clear narratives for executive audiences.

The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Tier 1 Pay Range (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle)
$183,100—$228,900 USD
Tier 2 Pay Range (All other US Locations)
$159,200—$199,000 USD

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Learn more here!

Job Description:

Strategic Sr. Business Analyst - Cloud Expertise

GDIT is seeking an experienced Senior Business Systems Analyst with strong strategic analysis, enterprise planning, and delivery-focused functional analysis expertise to support our PPS Modernization Program. This role blends high‑level strategic capability with deep hands-on functional analysis needed for large-scale modernization, cloud migration, and process transformation initiatives.

Role Overview
The Senior Business Analyst serves as a strategic advisor, translating executive priorities into actionable roadmaps while ensuring functional requirements for complex IT systems are fully defined, analyzed, and validated. This position operates across both strategic planning and system delivery workstreams—shaping early-phase initiatives, conducting business and capability modeling, and driving requirements through the full modernization lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Analysis & Enterprise Planning

  • Collaborate with executive stakeholders to define business problems, strategic objectives, and high-level solution approaches for modernization.
    • Develop and present business cases, including business process automation, analysis, and recommendations.
    • Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Product Strategy, and Portfolio Governance teams to create and maintain strategic roadmaps.
    • Evaluate business processes at the macro level using enterprise capability mapping, value stream analysis, and process decomposition.
    • Facilitate strategic workshops, decision forums, and prioritization sessions with senior leadership.
    • Shape the initial scope, objectives, and success criteria for new modernization initiatives before transition to delivery teams.
    • Ensure alignment between strategy, technology, modernization goals, and organizational priorities.
  • Provide expert guidance to clients recommending functional and strategic improvements.
    • Deliver recommendations, analyses, and briefings to senior-level stakeholders.
    • Operate effectively in ambiguous environments and shape early-phase initiatives into actionable plans.

Functional Analysis & Delivery Support

  • Analyze user needs to determine functional requirements for a wide variety of projects and highlights areas of improvement.
  • Utilize advanced, highly complex modeling and measuring techniques. Performs functional modeling based on requirements analysis.
    • Direct functional testing of various projects or systems.
    • Research, identify, and recommend resources required for task execution and completion.
    • Develop new functionality or updates the existing, to meet client needs.
    • Write and update project documentation including procedures, presentations, and training materials.
    • Perform functional allocations to identify tasks and their inter-relationships.
    • Consult with clients to determine optimum design for assigned projects.
    • May provide guidance and work leadership to less-experienced analysts.
    • May serve as a mentor to less experienced analysts.
    • May serve as team or task lead. (Not a people manager)
    • Serve as advisor to clients in assigned subject areas, recommends functional changes, and identifies areas for further investigation.
    • Generate recommendations in the form of briefings, reports, and other major documents provided to senior level client personnel.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of experience, including at least 8 years specialized in IT system functional analysis, preferably supporting cloud or large-scale modernization efforts.
    • Demonstrated experience in strategic analysis, enterprise planning, or business consulting.
    • Superior functional knowledge of modernization programs and complex, integrated IT systems.
    • Strong analytical abilities (market research, financial analysis, modeling, capability assessments).
    • Expertise in defining, documenting, and managing complex business rules.
    • Experience using Agile tools and processes, including Jira.
    • Ability to communicate complex strategy and functional concepts to senior stakeholders.
    • Knowledge of enterprise business architecture, capability models, and portfolio management.

• BS degree in an IT-related field.

Nice-to-Have Skills
• Experience in Mainframe Business Process Re-engineering.
• Experience in zCloud and AWS/Azure Cloud Modernization.
• Familiarity with BPA tools and BPMN, CMN, DMN modeling.
• Experience leveraging Generative AI for documenting requirements and business rules.
• Knowledge of database technologies such as DATACOM, DB2, Azure SQL & PostgreSQL
• Experience in Agile methodology for modernization initiatives.

• MBA or related advanced degree.

  • Prior experience in portfolio governance or enterprise strategy.

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

About Our Work:

We are GDIT. As our model footprint grows, ensuring these systems remain accurate, reliable, and trustworthy in production is mission-critical.

We are seeking a Model Monitoring Analyst to design, build, and operate the systems that keep our production models healthy. You will be the owner of model observability across the APD portfolio - establishing how we detect performance degradation, data drift, and anomalous behavior for both classical ML and GenAI systems. This is a highly visible role that partners closely with data scientists, ML engineers, claims business partners, and model governance teams.

  • Build monitoring infrastructure for production models, covering both traditional ML and GenAI/LLM systems, including automated pipelines, dashboards, and alerting.
  • Define and track model health metrics – for ML: accuracy, precision/recall, AUC, calibration, feature and prediction drift. For GenAI: output quality, hallucination/grounding checks, relevance, latency, token/cost usage, and guardrail adherence.
  • Detect and diagnose issues such as data drift, concept drift, performance decay, and data-quality breaks, then triage and escalate to the appropriate model owners.
  • Establish thresholds and alerting that balance early detection with alert fatigue, and document expected behavior and remediation runbooks.
  • Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to integrate monitoring into the model deployment lifecycle (CI/CD, MLOps/LLMOps).
  • Support model governance and compliance by producing monitoring evidence, audit-ready reporting, and documentation aligned with enterprise model risk management standards.
  • Analyze production outcomes against business KPIs to surface opportunities for model improvement or retraining.
  • Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through reporting and periodic model health reviews.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or related), or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in data analytics, data science, ML engineering, or a related analytical role.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python for data manipulation and analysis.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with attention to detail.

Additionally:

  • Graduate degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or related), or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with model monitoring / observability tooling
  • Experience with A/B testing or experiment design to test impact of solutions
  • Familiarity with GenAI/LLM evaluation concepts – prompt/response quality, hallucination detection, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), guardrails, and LLM cost/latency monitoring.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps/LLMOps practices.
  • Knowledge of the auto claims or insurance domain.

jobs.title: Head of AI Safety
jobs.excerpt: Moonshot believes that marginalised people in society — including minority ethnic people, people from working class backgrounds, women, Disabled and LGBTQIA+ people — must be centred in the work we do.
jobs.description:
Moonshot believes that marginalised people in society — including minority ethnic people, people from working class backgrounds, women, Disabled and LGBTQIA+ people — must be centred in the work we do. We strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other communities who are currently underrepresented in our workforce. We know a diverse workforce will enable us to understand drivers behind violent extremism and online harms in an in-depth way and do better work to counter them.

About the role

Moonshot is recruiting a Head of AI Safety to lead the delivery, development, and growth of our AI Safety portfolio. The role combines Moonshot's expertise in violence prevention, behavioural risk, and online harms with the emerging practice of evaluating and improving the safety of AI systems. The portfolio addresses harm categories including pathways to violence, extremism, child sexual exploitation, abuse and grooming (CSEA), mental health and crisis, and risks affecting children and teenagers.

The Head of AI Safety will serve as Moonshot's primary applied AI safety counterpart for frontier AI companies, governments, and regulators. The role will work closely with model, policy, trust and safety, product, research, and engineering teams. This is not an engineering or data-science role, but it is a hands-on position requiring the successful candidate to lead and participate directly in red teaming and adversarial evaluation, working in detail with evaluation methodologies, test scenarios, model responses, safety policies, and intervention frameworks. The role holds responsibility for client and partner relationships, project and staff management, methodological quality, and business development. The Head of AI Safety will build and maintain relationships across the wider AI safety ecosystem, including with governments, foundations, regulators, academics, researchers, and civil society organisations.

Your responsibilities will include:

Applied AI Safety, Evaluation, and Advisory

  • Lead and quality-assure Moonshot's applied AI safety work across harm categories including pathways to violence, extremism, CSEA, abuse and grooming, mental health and crisis, and risks affecting children and teens, using methods such as red teaming and adversarial evaluation of AI systems.
  • Advise frontier AI companies on how to improve the safety of their models, products, policies, and intervention systems.
  • Translate insights from psychologists, child-safety specialists, violence-prevention practitioners, safeguarding experts, and other subject-matter experts into clear, actionable guidance for model safety, policy, product, research, and engineering teams.
  • Set the methodological approach for the portfolio, translating violence-prevention, safeguarding, and behavioural-risk expertise into structured and testable evaluation frameworks.
  • Lead and participate directly in red teaming and adversarial evaluation, working in detail with test scenarios, model responses, scoring criteria, safety policies, and evaluation results.
  • Identify patterns, edge cases, and potential safety failures, and develop practical recommendations for improving model behaviour and user protections.
  • Maintain rigour and clear documentation across the team's technical deliverables, suitable for technical, government, and foundation audiences.
  • Ensure work is delivered within a clear ethical framework and in compliance with contractual, legal, data protection, and ethics obligations.
  • Identify, manage, and escalate operational, reputational, delivery, and partnership risks.

Client & Partner Management

  • Serve as Moonshot's primary applied AI safety counterpart for frontier AI company partners, governments, regulators, and the wider ecosystem invested in AI safety.
  • Build trusted relationships with model, policy, trust and safety, product, research, and engineering teams.
  • Build and sustain relationships across the wider AI safety ecosystem, including governments, foundations, regulators, academics, researchers, civil society organisations, and specialist practitioners.
  • Represent Moonshot externally in meetings, briefings, workshops, and sector engagement, including with regulators and policymaker audiences.

Team Leadership & Management

  • Provide direct leadership, coaching, and management to Moonshot's AI safety team.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and mission-driven team culture, with particular attention to wellbeing given the sensitive nature of the work.
  • Support workforce planning, performance management, and professional development across the team.
  • Ensure effective coordination with internal teams supporting the portfolio, including operations, finance, research, and technical teams.

Portfolio Development & Growth

  • Develop Moonshot's AI safety portfolio, identifying strategic opportunities, partnerships, and funding.
  • Lead proposal development, scoping, and renewals with technical credibility, using precise, defensible language suited to technical and government audiences.
  • Develop repeatable methodologies, service offerings, and partnerships that allow the portfolio to grow while maintaining methodological rigour and delivery quality.
  • Support external communications, publications, briefings, and thought leadership that establish Moonshot as a credible voice in applied AI safety.
  • Oversee project planning, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, and delivery timelines across the portfolio.

Requirements

Essential:

  • Experience in trust & safety, online harms, or a closely related field such as violence prevention, safeguarding, or public health, and the ability to adapt that knowledge to AI systems.
  • Curiosity about AI and the ability to build technical fluency quickly, enough to engage credibly with technical counterparts at AI companies. Much of this work is new, so comfort learning as you go matters more than existing AI safety expertise.
  • Experience designing research, evaluation frameworks, or interventions for harm categories such as violent extremism, CSEA, self-harm and crisis, or targeted violence.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects, teams, budgets, partners, and clients, with strong people management skills.
  • Excellent written communication, with experience producing credible (not promotional) material for government, foundation, or enterprise audiences.
  • Comfort and demonstrated resilience working with highly sensitive or graphic content (CSEA, extremist material, crisis content), with awareness of wellbeing practices for this kind of work.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and sensitive stakeholder environments, including representing organisations externally.
  • Willingness to travel and work outside regular hours where needed to accommodate clients or respond to incidents.
  • Highly trustworthy, with discretion and diplomacy, and willing to undertake relevant security clearance procedures.
  • Experience supporting business development, grant funding, or procurement.
  • Commitment to Moonshot's mission.
  • We require and will check candidates' eligibility to work in the UK and pass any relevant security clearance procedures per the needs of clients.

Desirable:

  • Direct experience in model safety, red teaming, or adversarial evaluation of LLMs or other AI systems.
  • Understanding of LLM architecture, safety tooling, or trust & safety policy.
  • Prior experience in child safety evaluation, teen-safety product work, or grooming and CSEA detection.
  • Familiarity with government or regulatory engagement, such as briefing officials or supporting policy submissions.
  • Experience with intervention or diversion programme design that can transfer to AI-mediated interventions.
  • Academic or applied background in radicalisation studies, forensic psychology, or violence risk assessment.
  • Familiarity with taxonomy or classifier development, including how testing data feeds a classifier.

Benefits

  • 30 days' paid annual leave, excluding public holidays.
  • Flexible public holiday policy with the option to work public holidays in exchange for a day off at another time.
  • Private healthcare package with access to specialist mental health cover, including coverage for partners and children.
  • Dental and Vision Insurance.
  • Life Insurance & Income Protection.
  • Employee Assistance Programme providing access to mental health support.
  • Generous maternity and paternity leave: 26 weeks paid maternity leave, 8 weeks paid paternity leave.
  • All permanent employees are granted share options upon employment.

Salary: €78,000 - €92,000 (depending on skills and experience).
