jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionThe Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is responsible for the successful operational delivery, governance and continuous improvement of recurring customer engagements across Managed Application Services (MAS), Product Administration Services (PAS), Product Monitoring Services (PMS) and other recurring services requiring service delivery management.
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is responsible for the successful operational delivery, governance and continuous improvement of recurring customer engagements across Managed Application Services (MAS), Product Administration Services (PAS), Product Monitoring Services (PMS) and other recurring services requiring service delivery management.

Acting as the primary operational customer-facing lead for the managed service, the SDM ensures that services are delivered effectively, performance is transparent, risks and escalations are actively managed, and customers receive a consistent and high-quality service experience.

As Unit4 continues its transformation towards the Success4U delivery model, the SDM plays an important role in helping customers transition from traditional service engagements to scalable, outcome-focused recurring services. Working closely with Customer Success Managers, Account Management and delivery teams, the SDM connects operational service performance with the customer's broader success objectives and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement.

The SDM owns service governance, operational customer relationships, service performance oversight, risk and escalation management, service reviews, consumption and scope awareness, and continuous improvement across an assigned portfolio of customer engagements. The SDM also provides operational insight and evidence to support customer health, retention, expansion and renewal activities, while strategic customer ownership, success planning and commercial ownership remain with the appropriate Customer Success and commercial roles.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the operational service relationship for an assigned portfolio of customers, acting as the primary point of contact for service delivery, governance and operational escalations.

  • Ensure effective delivery of recurring services in line with agreed service scope, SLAs, KPIs and customer commitments, providing clear visibility of performance and areas requiring action.

  • Lead service governance and operational service reviews, communicating service performance, consumption, risks, escalations, improvement priorities and agreed actions. The broader strategic customer relationship and Success Plan remain with Customer Success.

  • Monitor service performance, customer satisfaction, consumption, case health and operational customer signals, using data and customer feedback to identify risks and drive continuous improvement.

  • Identify, manage and escalate service delivery and customer-retention risks, ensuring the appropriate Customer Success, Account Management and delivery stakeholders are engaged where strategic, commercial or renewal action is required.

  • Collaborate across Delivery, Support, Cloud Operations, Customer Success, Product, Consulting and Account Management to coordinate effective service delivery and support successful customer outcomes.

  • Maintain oversight of contracted service scope, consumption, service commitments and operational delivery milestones, identifying deviations and risks early and escalating them through the appropriate governance route.

  • Connect service delivery with customer outcomes, providing operational insight and evidence that supports Customer Success in value, adoption and Success4U conversations.

  • Identify service needs, gaps and potential growth opportunities through customer interactions and service reviews, sharing these with Customer Success and Account Management for qualification and commercial follow-up.

  • Maintain accurate service records, governance documentation, risks, actions, consumption information and reporting in the appropriate systems.

  • Coordinate service delivery across internal teams, ensuring effective handovers, clear ownership, appropriate escalation and alignment between customer priorities and operational delivery.

  • Support retention and renewal readiness by monitoring service satisfaction and performance, identifying risks early and providing operational evidence to Customer Success and Account Management.

  • Maintain commercial awareness of the service engagement, including contracted scope, consumption, points redemption and delivery risks, supporting accurate forecasting and margin awareness while commercial approval and contract ownership remain with the designated commercial roles.

  • Support compliance with contractual commitments, governance requirements and applicable company policies, escalating potential compliance or contractual risks to the appropriate owner.

  • Drive continuous improvement by using service data, customer feedback, case trends and operational insights to identify and coordinate improvements to recurring services and delivery practices.

  • Share knowledge, best practices and customer insights across the Recurring Services organisation to improve consistency, scalability and customer experience.

The Service Delivery Manager is a senior customer-facing professional accountable for customer outcomes, service excellence, retention, and recurring revenue growth across a portfolio of strategic customer accounts. This individual is an experienced relationship manager capable of balancing customer advocacy, commercial awareness, operational governance, and service delivery excellence.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Service Delivery, Customer Success, Managed Services, Consulting, or Enterprise Software.
  • Proven ability to manage strategic customer relationships and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS, Cloud, Managed Services, and recurring revenue business models.
  • Experience managing multiple customer engagements simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
  • Fluent in Swedish and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills in both languages.
  • Commercial awareness with experience of renewals, contracts, service consumption, and revenue retention.
  • Ability to identify and manage customer, delivery, and commercial risks.
  • Experience working across Sales, Support, Product, Consulting, and Delivery teams.
  • Proven track record of managing escalations and driving successful customer outcomes.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and planning skills.
  • Experience with ERP, enterprise software, or cloud applications preferred.
  • International customer experience is an advantage.

Preferred Attributes

  • Customer-first mindset focused on value realization and long-term partnership.

  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Commercially aware with a focus on retention, adoption, and recurring revenue growth.

  • Comfortable working through organizational change and transformation initiatives.

  • Passionate about improving customer experiences and driving successful outcomes.

  • Known as a trusted advisor who balances customer advocacy with business priorities.

  • Continuously seeks best practices and opportunities to improve service delivery and customer success.

A chance to participate in the development of an international leading software firm. At Unit4, you have the freedom and autonomy to be successful. An attractive salary while working in a challenging international environment. Enthusiastic colleagues who like to learn from each other. At Unit4 we invest in your personal and professional growth. We don't focus on how many days you work, we trust you on delivering results - thus, we have an unlimited vacation policy.

Meet Unit4. With over 40 years of heritage, we’re an agile, fast growing, Cloud company that is on a mission to redefine Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for mid-market people-centric organisations.

With our innovative, self-driving, adaptive and intuitive software, our customers can spend more time on meaningful high-value work.

At the heart of what we do lies a simple yet profound purpose: Improve how people work by focusing on what truly matters. — A powerful statement that enables different priorities for different people.

We’re shaping how work should feel, and we empower our people by providing them with the right tools to achieve the autonomy they need - it's what makes us unique.

jobs.title: Clinical Quality Assurance Lead (Physician, NP, or PA)
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT LIFEFORCEWe are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health.
jobs.description:
ABOUT LIFEFORCE

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

OVERVIEW

    Lifeforce is hiring a Clinical Quality Assurance Lead to run our clinical QA program. You'll manage the program day to day: auditing telehealth visits and chart notes, keeping reviewers calibrated, and turning what the audits show into scorecards, reporting, and recommendations that team leaders and clinical leadership can act on.


    Our QA program runs on Rippit (formerly MaestroQA). You'll own the platform, including scorecard setup, review workflows, dashboards, and reporting. A big part of the job is finding where automation can take on volume, such as sampling, screening, flagging, and reporting, so reviewer time goes to the individual reviews that need clinical judgment. We want both: broader coverage through automation and careful, specific feedback on every individual review.


    To start, this will be an individual contributor and program manager role: you'll run the program and do the reviews yourself. As the team grows, we expect it to take on direct reports. Our network includes 50+ physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants across multiple states, and it's growing quickly. You'll work closely with the Medical Director, clinical leadership and operations, and the Clinical Onboarding & Training team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    QA Program Management

  • Own the clinical QA program for all Lifeforce clinicians (physicians, NPs, and PAs), including review cadence, sampling approach, workflows, and program documentation.

  • Audit telehealth visits and chart notes against the Lifeforce Clinical Evaluation Form and clinical SOPs.

  • Produce monthly QA scorecards for every established clinician, rolled up quarterly and annually, and run targeted reviews triggered by member or partner complaints, missed standards, or safety concerns.

  • Escalate patient safety concerns to clinical leadership right away, including clinically inappropriate recommendations, documentation errors, and unaddressed member concerns.

  • Support ad hoc reporting and insights requests related to clinical QA

    • Rippit Ownership, Reporting & Insights

  • Act as owner and administrator of Rippit (formerly MaestroQA): scorecards, rubrics, review assignments, workflows, integrations, and user access.

  • Build and maintain QA reporting by clinician, visit type, membership type, and evaluation domain.

  • Give team leaders and clinical leadership the scorecard data and context they need to run service delivery and performance conversations with clinicians, and join some of those conversations when it's useful.

  • Identify trends in QA results and turn them into specific recommendations for the Medical Director, clinical leadership, and the Clinical Onboarding & Training team.

  • Keep Rippit as the system of record for all clinical QA data.

    • Automation

  • Identify and implement automation across the program, such as AI-assisted screening or scoring, risk-based sampling, automatic flagging of visits and charts that need a closer look, and automated reporting.

  • Validate automated outputs against human review before relying on them, and keep checking and improving accuracy over time.

  • Protect reviewer time for the reviews that need clinical judgment and individualized feedback.

    • Standards & Calibration

  • Maintain the Clinical Evaluation Form, keep it aligned with clinical SOPs, and set scoring benchmarks.

  • Write scoring anchors for each evaluation criterion so reviewers interpret it the same way.

  • Build and maintain a calibration library of recorded visits and sample charts. Calibrate every reviewer before they score live reviews, and run ongoing calibration sessions.

    • New Clinician Quality

  • Lead QA for newly onboarded clinicians, from mock appointments through early visit and chart reviews.

  • Decide when each new clinician is ready to move to the standard monthly scorecard cycle.

    • Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work with the Clinical Onboarding & Training team to turn QA findings into targeted training and curriculum updates.

  • Flag gaps and inconsistencies in clinical SOPs (e.g. lipid management, cardiovascular imaging, peptide and hormone therapy protocols) and recommend updates to the Medical Director.

  • Apply a review approach consistent with the independent contractor relationship, evaluating clinicians against the standards set out in their agreements.

  • Partner with clinical leadership and People on documented follow-up when a quality

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

    In your first 90 days: get fully up to speed on Rippit and audit the current setup, build the calibration set and score a baseline, write anchors for every judgment-call item, take over new-clinician QA reviews, and run the first monthly scorecard cycle as a dry run.

    In your first year: every established clinician will have a monthly scorecard on schedule, with quarterly and annual roll-ups that team leaders and clinical leadership use in performance conversations. Scores are consistent across reviewers, a meaningful share of review volume is screened or sampled through automation with accuracy checked against human review, QA reporting is driving SOP and training updates, and you've made a data-backed case for when the program needs additional reviewers.

QUALIFICATIONS

    Required

  • Active, unrestricted MD, DO, NP or PA license in good standing.

  • 5+ years of clinical practice, including telehealth.

  • 2+ years in clinical quality work: chart audits, peer review, OPPE/FPPE, or clinical education.

  • Experience running a QA or audit program, including rubric-based review and keeping multiple reviewers consistent.

  • Hands-on experience administering a QA, audit, or review platform (Rippit, MaestroQA, or similar) and building reports in it.

  • Comfortable with data: tracking metrics, building reports, spotting trends, and explaining what they mean.

  • Working knowledge of, and interest in, preventive and metabolic care, including lipids and cardiovascular risk, hormone therapy, GLP-1s, and peptides.

  • Clear written and verbal communication.

  • Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

    • Preferred

  • Experience in longevity, concierge, or preventive medicine.

  • Experience using automation or AI tools in a QA or audit workflow.

  • Experience with Healthie, Nabla, or similar EHR and AI scribe tools.

  • Training in motivational interviewing.

  • Experience growing a function from a team of one, including hiring and managing reviewers.

TRAITS FOR SUCCESS

  • Presents findings clearly and specifically enough that clinicians and their leaders take them seriously, including when the results are hard to hear.

  • Trusted by clinical and operations teams, and able to hold peers to a shared standard without formal authority.

  • Pairs findings with a recommendation rather than just reporting them.

  • Organized and process-minded, and good at building workflows that hold up as volume grows.

  • Keeps the member experience in mind when reviewing care.

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Remote working environment

  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment

  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance

  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.

For more information about this exciting partnership, read Omnidian Announces Acquisition of Solar Service Guys, Accelerating Growth and Service Offerings in Australia

The Job

Build the acquisition engine that powers our significant growth plans in Australia. As our Growth Marketing Manager, you will lead Australian go-to-market strategy and execution as Solar Service Guys transitions to the Omnidian brand. You will drive residential customer acquisition and support commercial pipeline growth, turning creative ideas into measurable, repeatable results.

You’ll have the autonomy to build our local marketing function, with the data, tools and brand resources of a global company behind you. Reporting directly to our Australian Vice President of Growth and partnering with our US Head of Brand Strategy & Innovation, you’ll have direct access to decision-makers and real influence on how Omnidian connects with Australian customers.

In your first year, you will own go-to-market strategy, lead volume and cost per lead, working with sales and service delivery teams to convert leads into delivered work. We’re looking for a resourceful, creative marketer who enjoys turning ideas into action and building something that lasts.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Manager, Commercial Systems is responsible for owning and evolving the commercial systems that power EnableComp's go-to-market engine — Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Clay, and Accord. This role treats the commercial stack as a product: a connected operating system that should get smarter, faster, and more automated every quarter, not just kept running. The ideal candidate is the owner and steward of how EnableComp's revenue systems talk to each other, and increasingly, how AI does the connecting — using tools like Claude to redesign workflows and reduce manual work across the commercial organization, not just administer existing configuration.

  • Serve as platform owner for Salesforce (system of record), HubSpot (marketing/demand gen), Gong (conversation intelligence), Clay (data enrichment/workflow automation), and Accord (mutual action plans/deal execution).
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and Client Success leadership to prioritize the systems roadmap and translate business requirements into technical specs and developer handoffs.

  • Lead the use of AI (Claude and similar tools) as a core part of how the team works — building AI-assisted workflows, automations, and internal tools that reduce manual admin work across the commercial org.
  • Conduct data integrity and governance reviews across the stack: field standards, deduplication, permissioning, and audit-readiness.
  • Coordinate dashboards and reporting that give leadership real-time visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and rep performance.
  • Evaluate and pilot new RevTech and AI capabilities, building the business case and rollout plan for anything recommended.
  • Identify and manage the systems side of the deal lifecycle — pipeline stages, forecasting categories, quoting/CPQ-adjacent workflows, and MAP/mutual-close-plan tooling via Accord.

  • Real, demonstrated experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build workflows, automate tasks, or transform how a system or team operates — not just casual use
  • Strong SQL/SOQL or equivalent query fluency, and comfort translating messy business asks into clean data models
  • Experience writing technical specs and partnering with developers or implementation vendors to ship system changes
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills; healthcare, RCM, or complex B2B sales environment experience is a plus
  • Timely and regular attendance.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered
  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS & PREREQUISITES

  • Minimal travel required (occasional on-site collaboration or team events).
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • A product mindset — comfortable owning a roadmap, prioritizing competing requests, and iterating based on feedback; genuine curiosity about applying AI to eliminate manual, repetitive work
  • Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission.

Join Our Team as a Senior Project Manager/Program Manager, Business Transformation & AI Enablement

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a high-impact role for a candidate can lead complex programs, translate business needs into practical solutions, and modernize how work gets done. The successful candidate will combine disciplined project/program management, business analysis, process improvement, financial and operational insight, and applied AI fluency to help Clinical Assessments deliver work with greater clarity, speed, quality, and scalability.

Position Summary

The Senior Program Manager, Business Transformation & AI Enablement role sits within the Project Management Office and supports business leaders and stakeholders with increased visibility and modernization of financial and business operations work as well as leading product-development and internal business initiatives from concept and business case through implementation, commercialization, and benefits realization. There will be less focus on traditional product-development, but this role may be called upon to supplement the traditional project management team.

This role also strengthens the operating infrastructure of the Project Management Office that supports portfolio planning, financial stewardship, capacity visibility, project governance, reporting, knowledge management, and continuous improvement. The individual will work across project teams, business leaders, Finance, technology partners, and global stakeholders to turn ambiguous needs and fragmented data into aligned plans, informed decisions, and sustainable ways of working.

The balance between program delivery and transformation enablement will flex with business priorities. The role is intentionally broad: it requires someone who is equally comfortable leading a cross-functional program, analyzing financial and operational data, redesigning a process, facilitating a decision, and piloting a responsible AI-enabled solution.

What Success Looks Like

  • Projects and initiatives have clear outcomes, governance, integrated plans, decision pathways, risks, dependencies, and accountable owners as well as planned predicted and met timelines.
  • Leaders and teams have trusted, decision-ready information about scope, schedule, budget, capacity, performance, and trade-offs.
  • Repetitive or fragmented work is simplified, standardized, automated, or augmented through thoughtful process and technology improvements.
  • AI and automation opportunities move from idea to responsible experimentation, measurable business value, scalable adoption, and durable operating practices quickly and efficiently.
  • Stakeholders understand not only what is changing, but why it matters, how success will be measured, and what is expected of them.

Key Responsibilities

Program and Project Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional product-development and business-transformation initiatives from discovery through delivery and transition to operations.
  • Build integrated plans across waterfall, Agile, and hybrid delivery environments; adapt the approach to the work rather than applying methodology mechanically.
  • Provide concise, evidence-based reporting for project teams, sponsors, governance forums, Finance, and senior leaders.

Business, Financial, and Portfolio Infrastructure

  • Support business leaders with annual and long-range strategic planning, budget development, forecasting, actuals tracking, project coding, capacity planning, and portfolio reviews.
  • Develop/improve the tools, reports, dashboards to ensure information is accessible and actionable.
  • Partner with Finance to provide business stakeholders with day to day support re: financial reporting, project and capacity reporting, project coding, visibility and troubleshooting.

Process Excellence and Operating Model Improvement and Modernization

  • Identify business process pain points, bottlenecks, and other opportunities to improve cycle time, quality, cost, scalability, and user experience through automation, AI and modernization efforts.
  • Lead discovery, current-state assessment, root-cause analysis, future-state design, piloting, implementation, measurement, and continuous refinements.
  • Standardize and manage and modernize our process library across the development workflows.

AI Enablement and Intelligent Automation

  • Identify and prioritize responsible AI and automation opportunities tied to clear business problems and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with subject-matter experts, data and technology teams, security, privacy, legal, and other governance partners to design safe and fit-for-purpose solutions.
  • Rapidly prototype and evaluate and implement AI-enabled workflows, agents, copilots, or automation using defined quality criteria, human oversight, testing, and evidence-based go, pivot, or stop decisions.

Influence, Change, and Capability Building

  • Lead change with clear stakeholder analysis, communications, involvement, training, adoption measures, and reinforcement.
  • Create environments in which teams can move quickly, make work visible, learn through disciplined experimentation, and ask for help early.
  • Share practices, coach colleagues, and contribute to stronger project, program, business-analysis, process-improvement, and AI-enabled delivery capabilities.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Demonstrated success leading complex projects or programs with accountability for scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, dependencies, stakeholder alignment, and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience in business analysis, process improvement, operational transformation, or comparable discipline.
  • Practical experience using AI, automation, analytics, or digital tools to improve business work. Candidates should be able to describe what they built or implemented, how they evaluated it, and what business outcome it supported.
  • Strong financial and data literacy, with the ability to reconcile information, identify patterns or anomalies, build clear analyses, and communicate implications.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365. Strong Excel skills are required; experience with tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Copilot, Visio, SharePoint, PjM software, Azure DevOps, as well as LLMs, prototyping tools, etc. or comparable platforms is needed.
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and executive-communication skills, including the ability to make complex work understandable and actionable.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, operate independently, exercise sound judgment, and bring structure to ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in assessment, publishing, product development, research operations, or another complex knowledge-work environment.
  • Experience working across global teams.
  • Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, design thinking, process engineering, change management, data visualization, or benefits realization.
  • PMP, PgMP, Agile, product, data or AI-related credential, or willingness to pursue relevant development.
  • Experience supporting responsible AI practices, including privacy, security, intellectual property, human review, quality evaluation, and risk management.

The Candidate We Hope to Attract

A pragmatic innovator and dependable finisher who can spot an opportunity to modernize, automate, streamline complex processes. This person is energized by meaningful, complex work and is willing to move between strategic thinking and hands-on execution. The successful candidate asks sharp questions, uses evidence rather than assumptions, spots opportunities others miss, and can simplify without oversimplifying. The role suits someone who is collaborative and low ego, yet confident enough to challenge constructively, make recommendations, and lead through uncertainty. Above all, the candidate should care about creating better outcomes for customers, teams, and the business, not simply deploying a new tool or completing a project plan.

jobs.excerpt: With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life.
jobs.description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Employee Contract Type:

Local - Fixed Term Employee (Fixed Term)

Job Description:


Homeworking position. Please submit your CV in English.

Preferred locations: Asia Region, the Middle East, Eastern Europe Region (MEER), or Africa Region. This is a remote/homeworking opportunity open to candidates internationally. Given the highly collaborative nature of the role and the team's global footprint, candidates located within a time zone that allows reasonable overlap with Nepal working hours will be preferred. We nevertheless encourage qualified candidates from all eligible locations to apply. Final appointment will be subject to the selected candidate residing in a country where World Vision International (WVI) is registered and legally able to employ staff.

JOB PURPOSE

The Evidence to Influence Advisor is a strategic role within Advocacy & External Engagement, established to drive World Vision's evidence-based policy influence agenda. This position is responsible for curating and producing evidence products from in-house data systems such as AIM (Advocacy Impact Measurement) and CVA (Community Voice and Action), translating evidence into compelling influencing products, gathering external intelligence to identify policy influencing opportunities, and building the capacity of identified stakeholders to engage effectively in advocacy and policy processes. Collaborating and Advocating for Broader Impact as a core imperative of Our Promise Phase Three – Bold Hope for Children. In response to the call to address the root causes of challenges facing children through context-driven and locally led approaches, this position plays a critical role in translating Shift 3 ambitions into action. It supports regional and field offices to embed unified, data-driven advocacy—grounded in children’s voices—into national strategies and integrated programming frameworks. The role ensures that advocacy is not fragmented or ad hoc, but prioritised, intentional, and aligned with a clear set of partnership-wide advocacy child results that drive accountability, coherence, and influence.

Through hands-on advisory support, the position strengthens the integration of advocacy across strategies, programmes, and evidence systems, enabling National Offices to move from dispersed efforts to high-impact, results-driven policy and systems influence at scale. It promotes stronger strategic discipline through the application of advocacy theories of change, other analytical tools political economy analysis, and effective use of data and evidence, including AIM and child-led insights. By fostering strategic partnerships and improving the consistency of advocacy monitoring and learning, the role contributes to positioning World Vision as a leading, trusted Christian, child-focused humanitarian organisation—recognized for achieving sustainable impact for children through influencing policy, investment, and systems change from local to global levels, including in fragile and protracted contexts.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

Evidence Product Development Using In-House Data:

Curate, analyse, and produce structured evidence products from World Vision's in-house data systems, including:

  • Advocacy Impact Measurement (AIM) data – synthesising field-level advocacy results into evidence narratives.
  • Community Voice and Action (CVA) data – analysing social accountability findings for policy-relevant insights.
  • Programmatic monitoring data – linking programme outcomes to advocacy evidence packages.
  • Produce regular evidence briefs, dashboards, and synthesis reports that package in-house data into actionable formats for internal decision-makers and external policy audiences.

Translation of Evidence into Influencing Products

Transform evidence data into compelling advocacy and influencing products for targeted policy audiences:

  • Policy briefs and position papers drawing on AIM, CVA and programme data
  • Advocacy narratives, fact sheets and talking points tailored to specific decision-maker audiences.
  • Visual and multimedia evidence packages for public campaigns and stakeholder engagement.
  • Collaboration with communications and external engagement teams to amplify evidence-based messaging.

Gathering Intelligence to Identify External Influencing Opportunities

Proactively monitor the external policy environment to identify and prioritise opportunities for World Vision to influence policy outcomes:

  • Track legislative, regulatory, and policy developments at national, regional, and global levels relevant to child well-being.
  • Understand and collaborate with Policy team to identify the decision-makers, policy forums, and advocacy windows (e.g. UN processes, national budget cycles, elections).
  • Analyse political economy and power dynamics to assess feasibility and entry points for WV advocacy engagement.
  • Produce regular intelligence briefs and policy landscape scans to inform advocacy planning at Field, Regional, and Global levels.

Capacity Building of Identified Stakeholders

  • Design and deliver capacity building programmes for National Office staff, partners, and community advocates on evidence-based advocacy, use of AIM/CVA data, and policy engagement skills.
  • Identify capacity gaps among key advocacy stakeholders and develop targeted training and coaching plans
  • Facilitate learning events, workshops, and peer exchange to strengthen advocacy and policy influencing competencies.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE THE ROLE

  • Master's degree in Public Policy, International Development, Political Science, Research Methods, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of demonstrable experience producing policy briefs, evidence reports, and influencing products for policy audiences
  • Strong proficiency in data systems such as AIM, CVA dashboards, or similar monitoring platforms to generate evidence.
  • Experience in stakeholder capacity building, training design, and facilitation.
  • Strong political economy analysis skills and familiarity with policy influencing strategies at national and international levels.

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Fluency/high level of professional and technical spoken and written English. Fluency in another language (French, Spanish, Arabic, Portuguese) is an added advantage.

TRAVEL AND/OR WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENT:

  • This is a remote/homeworking position within a globally distributed team spanning Nepal, Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Kenya.
  • The role may occasionally require flexibility in working hours to accommodate meetings and collaboration across multiple global time zones.
  • The role requires the ability to work effectively across diverse cultures, geographies, faith traditions, and time zones, demonstrating strong emotional intelligence, cultural sensitivity, and adaptability in a global environment.
  • The successful candidate will possess excellent relationship-building and influencing skills, with the ability to engage respectfully and effectively with colleagues, partners, and stakeholders from diverse cultural and contextual backgrounds.
  • The position requires the ability and willingness to travel nationally and/or internationally up to 15% of the time, approximately 2-3 times per year, with trips typically lasting up to one week.

Applicant Types Accepted:

Local Applicants Only

jobs.description:
Overview

Coder Analyst Specialist

Full Time, 80 Hours Per Pay Period, Day Shift

Covenant Medical Group Overview:

Covenant Medical Group is the employed and managed medical practice organization of Covenant Health, providing comprehensive care across East Tennessee. With more than 300 physicians and advanced practice providers in 20 communities, our team delivers expertise across a broad spectrum of specialties from primary care and walk-in clinics to preventive medicine and advanced surgical and subspecialty services. We are committed to offering coordinated, patient-centered care that spans the continuum of health needs, ensuring access to exceptional providers close to home.

Position Summary:

Analyzes documentation in the medical record to obtain information necessary for the appropriate sequencing and assignment of ICD-10-CM and CPT-4 codes. Abstracts and codes procedures in conjunction with the provider to code services rendered with correct coding initiatives. Abstracts and enters data from the medical records in order to maintain a database for statistics and reporting. Assists the Billing Department in timely billing and rebilling of patient information.

Responsibilities

  • Reviews documentation in the medical record to determine ICD-10 CM and CPT-4 coding that is needed to comply with billing and reimbursement guidelines set forth by government entities.
  • Verifies data in the medical record and accurately abstracts pertinent information for charge entry.
  • Appropriately utilizes CPT-4 and ICD-10 current procedural coding standards in assisting the provider with proper selection and assignment of the principal procedure(s) and related diagnosis.
  • Edits unbilled claim transmission reports daily and makes necessary corrections to ensure accuracy and timely billing.
  • Participates in quality coding and audit reviews for each provider.
  • Assists provider with coding questions for all services rendered.
  • Assists other coders with coding questions to determine the most appropriate codes used for billing compliance and refers coding questions to the Operations Manager when additional research is needed.
  • Contacts physicians for clarification and medical necessity.
  • Reviews all encounters for accurate documentation and coding of services rendered.
  • Communicates pending items and questions with office manager, CDI supervisor, and manager.
  • Demonstrates ability to meet or exceed practice quality and quantity standards.
  • Liaison between practice specialty and insurance company for benefit determination and claim rejections.
  • Follows policies, procedures, and safety standards. Completes required education assignments annually. Works toward achieving goals and objectives, and participates in quality improvement initiatives as requested.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Education:

None specified; will accept any combination of formal education and/or prior work experience sufficient to demonstrate possession of the knowledge, skill and ability needed to perform the essential tasks of the job, typically such as would be equivalent to a high school diploma or GED. Professional coding experience is preferred.

Minimum Experience:

Three (3) years of extensive diagnosis and procedural coding experience required.

Licensure Requirement:

Must have and maintain a CPC coding certification through the American Academy of Professional Coders, or be registered as a Health Information Technician (RHIT) through the American Health Information Management Association.

jobs.description:
Tax Specialist – U.S. Tax Preparation & Compliance

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours, with flexibility during tax season and filing deadlines

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Tax Specialist to manage U.S. tax preparation, compliance, filings, and tax planning support for individuals and businesses.

This is a hands-on tax role requiring strong knowledge of U.S. federal and state taxation, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple filings and deadlines accurately.

You’ll prepare and review individual, corporate, and partnership tax returns, monitor regulatory requirements, respond to tax notices, support audits, and identify legitimate opportunities to reduce tax liabilities.

The ideal candidate has 3+ years of U.S. tax experience, hands-on experience with professional tax preparation software, and a strong understanding of IRS filing requirements.

What You’ll Own

U.S. Tax Preparation & Filing

  • Prepare and review U.S. federal and state tax returns.
  • Handle returns including:
    • Form 1040 – Individual Income Tax Returns
    • Form 1120 – Corporate Income Tax Returns
    • Form 1065 – Partnership Returns
  • Prepare quarterly estimated tax payments.
  • Prepare and file extensions when required.
  • Review supporting financial information for completeness and accuracy.
  • Ensure returns are submitted accurately and within applicable deadlines.
  • Maintain supporting schedules and workpapers for completed filings.

Federal, State & Local Tax Compliance

  • Monitor changes to U.S. tax laws, regulations, and IRS guidance.
  • Maintain compliance with federal, state, and local tax requirements.
  • Support multi-state tax compliance and filings.
  • Assist with:
    • Sales tax
    • Payroll tax
    • Property tax
  • Track filing calendars and ensure deadlines are not missed.
  • Maintain accurate documentation supporting tax positions and calculations.

Tax Planning & Advisory Support

  • Identify applicable deductions, credits, and tax-saving opportunities.
  • Support tax planning for individuals and businesses.
  • Analyze financial information to identify potential tax efficiencies.
  • Advise on tax implications of business transactions and financial decisions.
  • Help clients understand tax obligations and planning opportunities.
  • Support tax planning for closely held businesses and high-net-worth individuals where applicable.

Tax Notices & Audit Support

  • Review and respond to IRS and state tax notices.
  • Gather supporting documentation for tax audits and inquiries.
  • Prepare organized schedules and records for auditors and tax authorities.
  • Research discrepancies and assist with resolving tax-related issues.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready tax documentation.

International Tax Support

Where applicable, support international tax matters including:

  • FBAR
  • FATCA
  • Transfer pricing considerations
  • International reporting requirements

International tax experience is preferred but not required.

Accounting & Finance Collaboration

  • Work closely with accounting and finance teams during month-end and year-end close.
  • Review financial records to ensure tax reporting aligns with accounting data.
  • Coordinate with external CPAs, auditors, and tax advisors when required.
  • Identify missing or inconsistent financial information before filing.
  • Communicate tax implications clearly to finance teams and business stakeholders.

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Maintain updated tax compliance SOPs.
  • Document tax positions, assumptions, and filing methodologies.
  • Maintain organized client tax records and supporting documentation.
  • Improve tax preparation and review workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to increase accuracy and efficiency during high-volume filing periods.

Required Experience & Skills

Core Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional U.S. tax preparation and compliance experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal and state tax requirements.
  • Experience preparing individual and business tax returns.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Form 1040
    • Form 1120
    • Form 1065
  • Experience with IRS e-filing systems and state tax portals.
  • Strong understanding of tax deadlines, estimated payments, and extensions.
  • Ability to research and interpret tax regulations.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tax filings and deadlines independently.
  • Comfortable working remotely during U.S. client business hours.

Tax Software

Hands-on experience with one or more professional tax platforms such as:

  • UltraTax
  • Lacerte
  • ProSeries
  • Drake Tax
  • Equivalent professional tax preparation software

Excel & Google Sheets

Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for:

  • Tax reconciliations
  • Supporting schedules
  • Financial analysis
  • Data organization
  • Reporting
  • Tax workpapers

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • CPA designation.
  • Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.
  • Master’s degree in Taxation.
  • Multi-state tax experience.
  • International tax exposure.
  • Experience with FBAR/FATCA or transfer pricing.
  • Experience supporting high-net-worth individuals.
  • Experience working with closely held businesses.
  • Background supporting clients in:
    • Professional services
    • SaaS
    • Real estate
  • Experience working within a CPA, tax, accounting, or professional services firm.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Understand U.S. tax preparation beyond basic data entry.
  • Are highly accurate and detail-oriented.
  • Stay organized when managing multiple clients and deadlines.
  • Can interpret tax rules and explain their practical implications clearly.
  • Proactively identify potential compliance issues.
  • Remain dependable during high-volume tax periods.
  • Maintain organized workpapers and supporting documentation.
  • Take ownership of filings from preparation through submission and follow-up.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing upcoming federal and state filing deadlines.
  • Preparing individual, corporate, or partnership tax returns.
  • Reviewing financial records and supporting schedules.
  • Identifying applicable deductions and credits.
  • Preparing estimated tax payments or extensions.
  • Researching federal or state tax requirements.
  • Responding to IRS or state notices.
  • Reconciling tax schedules against accounting records.
  • Coordinating with accounting teams, CPAs, or clients.
  • Documenting tax positions and maintaining audit-ready records.
  • Reviewing completed returns for accuracy before filing.

In short: you ensure tax filings are accurate, compliant, timely, and supported by organized documentation while helping identify legitimate opportunities for tax efficiency.

Key Metrics for Success

  • 100% of tax filings completed accurately and on time.
  • Zero avoidable compliance penalties or missed deadlines.
  • Accurate and complete tax workpapers.
  • Timely resolution of IRS and state notices.
  • Organized, audit-ready tax documentation.
  • Strong client and leadership satisfaction.
  • Identification of applicable tax-saving opportunities.
  • Consistent execution during high-volume filing periods.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Full ownership across U.S. tax preparation and compliance.
  • Exposure to both individual and business taxation.
  • Opportunity to develop expertise across federal and multi-state tax matters.
  • Direct collaboration with finance, accounting, and tax leadership.
  • Exposure to tax planning and advisory work beyond return preparation.
  • Fully remote environment.
  • Strong potential for growth into:
    • Senior Tax Specialist
    • Tax Manager
    • Tax Advisor
    • Tax Operations Lead

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

  • Your experience preparing U.S. federal and state tax returns.
  • Which returns you have personally prepared, particularly Forms 1040, 1120, and 1065.
  • The tax preparation software you have used, such as UltraTax, Lacerte, ProSeries, or Drake.
  • Your experience managing multiple clients and filing deadlines during tax season.
  • Your exposure to multi-state taxation.
  • An example of a tax issue, discrepancy, or notice you researched and helped resolve.
  • Your experience identifying deductions, credits, or other legitimate tax-saving opportunities.
  • Any experience you have with sales tax, payroll tax, or property tax filings.
  • Any exposure to high-net-worth, closely held business, or international tax matters.
  • How you review your work to ensure accuracy before a return is filed.

Keep your responses clear, concise, and conversational. We’re particularly interested in your hands-on U.S. tax experience, technical knowledge, attention to detail, and ability to communicate tax matters clearly.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Spark Hire Intro Video
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Tax Assessment
  • Client Interview with Finance/Tax Leadership
  • Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you have strong U.S. tax preparation and compliance experience, are comfortable preparing individual and business returns, and take pride in accurate, deadline-driven work, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

  • Improve ad relevance and conversion efficiency.
  • Identify winning campaigns and scaling opportunities.
  • Scale profitable campaigns while maintaining performance.
  • Make data-backed optimization decisions rather than relying on assumptions.

Creative Testing & Funnel Optimization

Develop structured testing programs across:

  • Headlines
  • Ad copy
  • Creatives
  • Audiences
  • Calls-to-action
  • Landing pages

Analyze funnel performance to identify:

  • Conversion bottlenecks
  • Landing-page friction
  • Messaging gaps
  • Audience-quality issues
  • Opportunities to improve conversion rates

Translate performance data into clear recommendations for creative and funnel improvements.

Conversion Tracking, Analytics & Attribution

Implement, maintain, and troubleshoot tracking using:

  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
  • Google Tag Manager
  • Meta Pixel

jobs.description:
Senior Accountant – GAAP/IFRS, Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible, aligned with U.S. client business hours

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Accountant to own critical accounting processes, maintain financial accuracy, support compliance, and provide reliable financial reporting and insights to leadership.

This is not a transactional bookkeeping role.

You’ll take ownership of core accounting functions including:

  • General ledger accounting
  • Month-end and quarter-end close
  • Balance sheet reconciliations
  • Financial reporting and variance analysis
  • Audit and tax support
  • Internal controls
  • Accounting process improvement
  • Junior team mentorship

The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge of GAAP/IFRS with hands-on accounting execution, analytical thinking, and a process-improvement mindset.

What You’ll Own

General Ledger & Account Reconciliations

  • Prepare and post journal entries for:
    • Accruals
    • Prepaid expenses
    • Payroll allocations
    • Depreciation
    • Intercompany transactions
  • Maintain reconciliations across approximately 15–30 key balance sheet accounts.
  • Reconcile cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, deferred revenue, and other accounts.
  • Investigate discrepancies and ensure issues are resolved accurately.
  • Maintain complete and audit-ready accounting records.

Month-End & Quarter-End Close

Own and coordinate monthly and quarterly close activities.

You will:

  • Prepare and review trial balances.
  • Ensure journal entries are complete and accurate.
  • Complete month-end close within approximately 5–7 business days, with a target of five days.
  • Maintain detailed close checklists.
  • Coordinate required cross-functional sign-offs.
  • Identify and resolve issues that could delay reporting.
  • Continuously improve close efficiency and accuracy.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and review:
    • Profit & Loss statements
    • Balance sheets
    • Cash flow statements
    • Supporting schedules
  • Perform budget-to-actual and forecast-to-actual variance analysis.
  • Investigate significant financial variances.
  • Prepare written commentary explaining financial performance.
  • Provide actionable financial insights for leadership.
  • Prepare supporting schedules for board meetings, audits, and other reporting requirements.

Audit, Tax & Compliance Support

  • Prepare PBC (Prepared by Client) schedules and supporting documentation for external auditors.
  • Respond to audit requests accurately and within required timelines.
  • Support timely and accurate filings for:
    • Sales tax
    • Property tax
    • Corporate income tax
  • Maintain accounting policies, controls, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure accounting processes align with applicable GAAP and/or IFRS standards.
  • Identify accounting or control risks and escalate issues appropriately.

Internal Controls & Accounting Accuracy

  • Maintain strong controls across accounting workflows.
  • Review reconciliations and supporting documentation for completeness.
  • Identify unusual transactions, exceptions, and accounting discrepancies.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation and approval processes are followed.
  • Help maintain accurate, consistent, and audit-ready financial records.

Process Improvement & Automation

Identify opportunities to make accounting operations faster, more accurate, and more scalable.

You will:

  • Review existing accounting workflows and identify inefficiencies.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements.
  • Identify opportunities for accounting and reporting automation.
  • Update SOPs and accounting documentation.
  • Standardize recurring accounting processes.
  • Support ERP improvements and finance system optimization initiatives.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Review work completed by staff accountants and bookkeepers.
  • Provide feedback on reconciliations, journal entries, and financial reporting.
  • Mentor junior team members on accounting treatments and best practices.
  • Help improve accuracy and consistency across the accounting function.
  • Support the professional development of junior accounting staff.

Cross-Functional Finance Collaboration

Partner with:

  • FP&A
  • Operations
  • Sales
  • Finance leadership
  • Other business stakeholders

You will:

  • Support budgeting and forecasting processes.
  • Collaborate on variance reviews.
  • Coordinate with operations and sales regarding revenue recognition.
  • Provide financial information needed for business decisions.
  • Translate accounting data into clear insights for non-finance stakeholders.

Required Experience & Skills

Non-Negotiables

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 4–5+ years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Strong understanding of GAAP and/or IFRS.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • General ledger accounting
    • Journal entries
    • Balance sheet reconciliations
    • Month-end close
    • Financial statement preparation
    • Variance analysis
    • Audit support
  • Experience with accounting systems such as:
    • NetSuite
    • QuickBooks
    • Xero
    • SAP
    • Similar ERP/accounting platforms
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Pivot Tables
    • VLOOKUP
    • INDEX/MATCH
    • Conditional formatting
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting certification.
  • NetSuite experience.
  • Multi-entity accounting and consolidations.
  • Foreign currency accounting.
  • Experience in:
    • SaaS
    • Professional services
    • Real estate
  • Experience supporting ERP implementations.
  • Accounting automation or finance transformation experience.
  • Experience working directly with FP&A teams.
  • Experience mentoring junior accountants or bookkeepers.
  • Familiarity with Confluence or similar documentation systems.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Understand accounting principles beyond basic bookkeeping.
  • Take ownership of financial accuracy and reporting deadlines.
  • Can independently manage month-end close responsibilities.
  • Are highly analytical without losing attention to detail.
  • Investigate discrepancies rather than simply recording adjustments.
  • Maintain organized and audit-ready documentation.
  • Can explain financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
  • Look for ways to improve and automate repetitive accounting processes.
  • Are comfortable reviewing and mentoring junior team members.
  • Thrive in structured, deadline-driven environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Morning

  • Review bank activity and reconcile recent transactions.
  • Post accruals for payroll, vendor invoices, and other expenses.
  • Review exception reports and investigate unusual activity.
  • Check progress against the accounting close calendar.

Midday

  • Prepare or review draft financial statements.
  • Analyze expense allocations against budgets and forecasts.
  • Investigate material variances.
  • Meet with Operations or other stakeholders regarding deferred revenue or reporting questions.

Afternoon

  • Review balance sheet reconciliations prepared by junior team members.
  • Provide feedback on accounting treatments and documentation.
  • Resolve outstanding close items.
  • Support audit, tax, or compliance requests.

End of Day

  • Update variance analysis and financial commentary.
  • Review month-end close progress.
  • Update accounting schedules, SOPs, and supporting documentation.
  • Prepare outstanding items for the following day.

In short: you ensure financial operations remain accurate, compliant, efficient, audit-ready, and useful for decision-making.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Month-end close completed within 5 business days.
  • Less than 1% reconciliation error rate.
  • 100% of audit requests delivered on time.
  • Accurate and timely financial statements.
  • Strong quality and consistency of variance analysis.
  • Complete and audit-ready accounting documentation.
  • Improved close and reporting efficiency.
  • Effective mentorship and review of junior accounting staff.
  • Leadership confidence in financial reporting accuracy.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership across core accounting operations.
  • Exposure to both accounting execution and financial analysis.
  • Direct collaboration with leadership and FP&A.
  • Opportunity to improve accounting systems and processes.
  • Exposure to ERP and finance automation initiatives.
  • Fully remote environment with flexibility around U.S. client operations.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Accounting Manager
    • Senior Accounting Manager
    • Controller
    • Finance Operations Manager
    • Director of Accounting

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

  • Your overall accounting experience and the types of companies you’ve supported.
  • Your experience managing month-end and quarter-end close.
  • The number and types of balance sheet accounts you have personally reconciled.
  • Your experience working under GAAP and/or IFRS.
  • Which accounting or ERP platforms you have used, particularly NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or SAP.
  • An example of a reconciliation discrepancy or accounting issue you identified and resolved.
  • Your experience preparing financial statements and variance analysis.
  • Your experience supporting external audits and preparing PBC schedules.
  • An accounting process you improved or automated.
  • Your experience reviewing or mentoring the work of junior accountants or bookkeepers.

Keep your answers clear, concise, and conversational. We want to understand the depth of your accounting experience, technical knowledge, communication skills, and ability to take ownership of financial operations.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Spark Hire Intro Video
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Accounting Task – Reconciliation & Variance Analysis
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you have strong GAAP/IFRS accounting experience, can independently manage close and reconciliations, and take pride in producing accurate, decision-ready financial information, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

Lead Generation & Appointment Setting

Sales Execution

CRM & Reporting

What Makes You a Strong Fit

jobs.description:
Community Manager – Slack Community, Events & Member Engagement

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Community Size: ~160 Members

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly engaging and relationship-driven Community Manager to own the member experience for a private community of approximately 160 entrepreneurs.

This is not a passive moderation role.

You’ll be responsible for creating an active, connected, and valuable community by leading conversations in Slack, building relationships with members, making thoughtful introductions, coordinating premium events, and proactively improving engagement and retention.

You’ll serve as the heartbeat of the community, ensuring members feel welcomed, connected, heard, and consistently receive value from being part of the network.

If you naturally bring people together, enjoy starting conversations, and know how to turn an online group into a genuine community, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Slack Community Management & Daily Engagement

Own the day-to-day experience inside the community’s Slack workspace.

You will:

  • Start thoughtful discussions and keep conversations active.
  • Encourage members to participate and contribute.
  • Respond to questions and facilitate conversations.
  • Welcome and engage new members.
  • Identify inactive members and proactively reconnect with them.
  • Maintain a professional, positive, and welcoming community environment.
  • Ensure questions, conversations, and member needs do not go unnoticed.
  • Create consistent reasons for members to return and participate.

Member Relationships & Strategic Introductions

Get to know members beyond their names and profiles.

Understand their:

  • Businesses
  • Industries
  • Goals
  • Challenges
  • Expertise
  • Interests
  • Current priorities

Use that knowledge to make thoughtful introductions between members who could benefit from knowing one another.

You’ll act as a connector across the community, helping create valuable relationships, collaborations, and conversations.

Member Check-Ins & Retention

Conduct structured member check-ins approximately every 3–6 months.

Use these conversations to:

  • Understand member satisfaction.
  • Gather feedback about the community experience.
  • Identify disengaged or at-risk members.
  • Understand what members want more or less of.
  • Surface opportunities for introductions, programming, or support.
  • Address concerns before they become reasons to leave.

Maintain organized records of member feedback, engagement, and follow-up actions.

Events, Retreats & Member Experiences

Coordinate high-quality community experiences, including:

  • Retreats
  • Dinners
  • Meetups
  • Private gatherings
  • Virtual events
  • Other member experiences

Own event coordination from planning through execution, including:

  • Scheduling
  • Invitations and RSVPs
  • Venue and vendor coordination
  • Member communication
  • Attendance tracking
  • Event logistics
  • Reminders and follow-ups
  • Post-event feedback

The goal is to create organized, premium experiences that strengthen relationships within the community.

Engagement Tracking & Community Reporting

Monitor the overall health of the community by tracking:

  • Slack activity
  • Member participation
  • Event attendance
  • Member check-ins
  • Meaningful introductions
  • Inactive members
  • Engagement trends
  • Retention and churn indicators

Provide clear insights to leadership about what is working, where engagement is dropping, and what can be improved.

Member Feedback & Surveys

Create and manage member surveys using Typeform or similar tools.

You will:

  • Gather structured member feedback.
  • Analyze survey responses.
  • Identify recurring themes and concerns.
  • Share actionable insights with leadership.
  • Turn member feedback into improvements to programming, events, and the overall community experience.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You are:

  • Naturally outgoing and comfortable starting conversations.
  • An excellent relationship builder.
  • Confident communicating through Slack, email, video, and calls.
  • Genuinely interested in learning about other people.
  • Comfortable interacting with entrepreneurs and business owners.
  • Proactive about making introductions and creating connections.
  • Highly organized when coordinating events and follow-ups.
  • Attentive to members who may be disengaging.
  • Customer-focused and motivated by member satisfaction.
  • Comfortable taking ownership without waiting for constant direction.

Most importantly, you know how to create engagement without making it feel forced.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Professional experience in community management, customer success, member experience, relationship management, or a closely related role.
  • Strong spoken English with clear, professional communication.
  • Excellent written English communication.
  • Experience building and maintaining professional relationships.
  • Experience coordinating events, gatherings, or member experiences.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple member conversations and priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working remotely during U.S. business hours.
  • Reliable internet connection and professional remote work setup.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • Direct experience managing a Slack-based community.
  • Experience managing private or paid membership communities.
  • Experience working with entrepreneurs, founders, executives, or business owners.
  • Familiarity with Typeform.
  • Experience coordinating retreats, dinners, meetups, or premium events.
  • Customer Success or Member Experience background.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based members or clients.
  • Experience tracking community engagement and retention metrics.
  • Proven success improving member participation or reducing churn.
  • Based in LATAM or Africa preferred, but not required.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing Slack activity and responding to member conversations.
  • Starting a discussion around a relevant topic.
  • Welcoming and engaging new members.
  • Introducing two members who could benefit from knowing each other.
  • Reaching out to members who have become less active.
  • Conducting member check-ins.
  • Coordinating logistics for an upcoming dinner, meetup, or retreat.
  • Managing invitations, RSVPs, and event communication.
  • Reviewing Typeform survey responses.
  • Updating member engagement records.
  • Identifying members who may be at risk of churning.
  • Sharing community insights and recommendations with leadership.

In short: you keep the community active, connected, valuable, and worth returning to.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Daily and weekly Slack engagement
  • Active member participation
  • Member satisfaction
  • Number and quality of meaningful member introductions
  • Member check-in completion
  • Event attendance and participation
  • Survey participation and feedback quality
  • Re-engagement of inactive members
  • Member retention and reduced churn
  • Accuracy of engagement tracking and reporting

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Full ownership of a high-value private entrepreneur community.
  • Direct relationships with founders, entrepreneurs, and business owners.
  • Meaningful impact on member satisfaction and retention.
  • Combination of community management, relationship building, events, and member experience.
  • Opportunity to shape how the community grows and operates.
  • Fully remote working environment.
  • Strong potential to grow into roles such as:
    • Senior Community Manager
    • Member Experience Lead
    • Community Operations Lead
    • Head of Community

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

  • Your experience managing an online or professional community.
  • The size and type of communities you’ve managed.
  • Your experience using Slack for community engagement.
  • How you would encourage participation in a community where members have become quiet.
  • An example of how you created a valuable connection between two members.
  • Your experience coordinating events, dinners, retreats, or meetups.
  • How you would identify and re-engage a member who may be at risk of leaving.
  • How you measure whether a community is genuinely healthy and valuable.

Keep your answers clear, concise, and conversational. We want to understand your communication style, personality, relationship-building ability, and approach to community engagement.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Spark Hire Intro Video
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Practical Community Scenario
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you thrive on conversations, relationships, and bringing people together, this is an opportunity to take real ownership of a high-value private entrepreneur community.

If you can create genuine engagement, build meaningful member relationships, coordinate excellent experiences, and make sure members consistently see value in the community, we’d love to hear from you.

Job purpose

The Growth Marketing Manager – Financial Solutions leads the marketing strategy for BELAY's Financial Solutions service line, with responsibility for driving pipeline, revenue growth, and marketing efficiency. As the service line's marketing subject matter expert, this role develops a deep understanding of the ideal customer profile (ICP), customer needs, market dynamics, and BELAY's value proposition to inform positioning, campaigns, and growth strategies.

This role partners closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Creative, and other Marketing functions to translate business and customer insights into measurable growth initiatives. The Growth Marketing Manager also leads a team responsible for executing and optimizing marketing strategies across the customer journey, from awareness and acquisition through conversion and ongoing engagement.

Essential Functions

As a BELAY Corporate Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

People Leadership & Planning

  • Lead, coach, and develop team members while establishing clear priorities, expectations, and accountability.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings focused on feedback, development, and performance.
  • Manage internal resources, contractors, and vendors to effectively execute marketing priorities.
  • Partner with the Director of Marketing to establish and execute annual, quarterly, and monthly marketing priorities.
  • Foster strong collaboration across Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and other key business partners.

Growth & Financial Performance

  • Own Marketing's contribution to Financial Solutions pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations to develop growth forecasts, lead projections, and performance targets.
  • Monitor marketing investment against pipeline, revenue, customer acquisition, and ROI, adjusting strategies and spend based on performance.
  • Develop data-driven business cases and recommendations for new marketing investments and growth opportunities.
  • Regularly present business performance, insights, and growth recommendations to senior leadership.

Service Line & Acquisition Strategy

  • Serve as the Marketing subject matter expert for Financial Solutions, developing a deep understanding of the ICP, customer needs, buying behaviors, competitive landscape, and service line value proposition.
  • Use customer insights, market trends, competitive research, and performance data to inform marketing strategy, segmentation, and messaging.
  • Conduct regular competitive analysis, including an annual SWOT analysis, to identify opportunities and potential threats.
  • Own the marketing funnel from awareness through qualified pipeline, partnering with Sales to improve lead quality and conversion.
  • Develop and execute integrated, omnichannel acquisition campaigns across owned, paid, partner, and other relevant channels.
  • Identify opportunities to expand into new audiences, verticals, and channels and develop cross-sell strategies across BELAY service lines.
  • Partner with Content, Creative, Paid Digital, and external vendors to execute ICP-aligned campaigns and support service line growth.

Experimentation & Optimization

  • Develop and maintain a cross-channel experimentation roadmap across paid media, sponsorships, landing pages, messaging, offers, and nurture programs.
  • Design and evaluate A/B and multivariate tests to improve conversion, acquisition efficiency, and customer engagement.
  • Prioritize growth initiatives and experiments based on business impact, resources, data, and strategic alignment.
  • Scale high-performing strategies while optimizing or discontinuing underperforming initiatives.
  • Stay current on marketing trends, technologies, and emerging channels to identify new opportunities for sustainable growth.

Marketing Operations & Sales Enablement

  • Leverage Salesforce, HubSpot, and other marketing technologies to support campaign execution, reporting, funnel visibility, and optimization.
  • Ensure brand consistency and alignment across Financial Solutions campaigns and channels.
  • Provide Sales with messaging, content, tools, and resources that support lead conversion and revenue generation.
  • Support special projects, strategic initiatives, and research as business needs evolve.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, product marketing, or lead generation.
  • 1+ years of people leadership or direct team management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing marketing strategies tied to pipeline, revenue, customer acquisition, or other measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience developing and executing integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and make data-driven recommendations.
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Creative, or similar business functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in financial services, accounting, bookkeeping, fractional finance, or other professional services.
  • Experience with HubSpot and Salesforce or comparable CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience managing paid media, agencies, vendors, contractors, or sponsorships.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic and commercially minded with the ability to connect marketing initiatives to business outcomes.

At TRG, we operate in a global environment where every culture, perspective and personality is valued. We are a team of passionate people working shoulder-to-shoulder to empower our customers in the fight against crime and terror.
