About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a backend role with significant data pipeline work.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture — know when to use wide denormalised tables vs. normalised models, and the trade-offs of each.
  • Familiarity with version control workflows (Git branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and agile development practices.
  • A data quality mindset — you instinctively validate assumptions, add assertions to pipelines, and treat silent data failures as critical incidents.

jobs.excerpt: Deine AufgabenDie Onepage GmbH ist ein AI-first-SaaS-Unternehmen mit 19.
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Die Onepage GmbH ist ein AI-first-SaaS-Unternehmen mit 19.000 zahlenden Kunden und über 250.000 Usern und zählt damit zu den größten Plattformen im Bereich Web-Präsenz im deutschsprachigen Raum. Mit Onepage AI 2.0 entstehen moderne, schnelle und conversionstarke Webseiten und Landingpages per Prompt – und bleiben danach im visuellen Editor vollständig steuerbar.

Onepage ist gründergeführt, eigenfinanziert und profitabel, und wir starten gerade das nächste Kapitel: Aus Onepage wird eine Gruppe. Der Website-Builder bleibt unser Motor. Drumherum bauen wir ein Portfolio aus Software-Brands auf, die für unsere Zielgruppe – kleine und mittlere Unternehmen sowie Agenturen – relevant sind.
Dafür bauen wir eine neue Funktion im Unternehmen auf – und suchen die Person, die sie gemeinsam mit uns aufbaut. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem CEO und dem Finance-Team, baust die Pipeline auf, bewertest Deals und pflegst den Kontakt zu Eigentümern potenzieller Targets.

Du willst nicht nur Deals begleiten, sondern mitdenken, mitverhandeln und mitentscheiden? Komm als M&A Manager (m/w/d) an Bord!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Marktscreening & Target Identifikation: Du identifizierst potenzielle Übernahmekandidaten (Targets) und wertest diese gemeinsam mit unserem CEO und Finance-Team nach strategischen Kriterien aus.
  • Deal-Flow & Pipeline: Du baust unseren Deal-Flow systematisch auf – über Direktansprache, Broker, Netzwerke und unser Ökosystem aus Kunden und Agenturpartnern – und hältst die Pipeline strukturiert nach.
  • Austausch mit Targets: Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit Eigentümern und Management potenzieller Zielunternehmen und baust eine erste Gesprächsbasis auf.
  • Deal-Analyse & Bewertung: Du erstellst gemeinsam mit dem Finance-Team Unternehmensbewertungen (u. a. DCF, Multiplikatorverfahren) und Business Cases für mögliche Transaktionen.
  • Due Diligence: Du unterstützt bei der kaufmännischen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Prüfung von Zielunternehmen – in Abstimmung mit CEO, Finance-Team und externen Beratern (Anwälte, Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer).
  • Verhandlung & Strukturierung: Du bereitest Verhandlungen von Term Sheets, LOIs und Kaufverträgen mit vor und begleitest diese gemeinsam mit dem CEO.
  • Transaktionsbegleitung: Du begleitest Transaktionen von der Anbahnung bis zum Signing/Closing in enger Abstimmung mit CEO und Finance.
  • Post-Merger-Integration: Du unterstützt bei der Integrationsplanung nach erfolgtem Zukauf und entwickelst mit uns ein Integrations-Playbook, das wir Deal für Deal wiederverwenden.

Dein Profil

  • Berufserfahrung: Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in M&A, Investment Banking, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance oder Strategieberatung.
  • Ausbildung: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
  • Know-how: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Unternehmensbewertung und Finanzmodellierung.
  • SaaS-Verständnis: Du verstehst, wie Software-Unternehmen ticken – ARR, Net Revenue Retention, Churn, CAC – und kannst daraus eine Bewertungslogik ableiten. Erfahrung mit Buy-&-Build-Modellen oder Software-Deals ist ein großes Plus.
  • Due Diligence: Du hast Erfahrung in der Durchführung oder Begleitung von Due-Diligence-Prozessen.
  • Kommunikation: Du überzeugst durch verhandlungssicheres Auftreten und Kommunikationsstärke im Umgang mit Geschäftsführern und Eigentümern.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und mit hoher Eigeninitiative bei der aktiven Ansprache von Targets.
  • Netzwerk: Idealerweise bringst du Kontakte in die Software-, Hosting- oder Agenturszene mit – oder die Fähigkeit, sie schnell aufzubauen.
  • Sprachen: Du sprichst sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch.

Worauf du dich freuen kannst:

  • Aufbau-Rolle: Du bist die erste Person, die bei Onepage ausschließlich M&A macht. Prozesse, Tools und Playbook entstehen mit dir – nicht vor dir.
  • Direkter Draht: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem CEO und dem Finance-Team, Entscheidungen fallen schnell.
  • Sichtbarkeit: Deine Arbeit prägt, wie die Onepage-Gruppe in drei Jahren aussieht.
  • Remote-First: Arbeite zu 100% remote und genieße maximale Flexibilität in deinem Arbeitsalltag.
  • Gesundheit: Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen – wir unterstützen dich mit einer Zusatzkrankenversicherung sowie einem Zuschuss zu dem Gesundheitsprogramm von Wellhub.
  • Nachhaltige Benefits: Erhalte attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte in vielen Kategorien über FutureBens.
  • Mitgestaltung & Entwicklung: Bringe deine Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse mit und erweitere deine Fähigkeiten durch kontinuierliche Weiterbildung.

Company Description


Penguin Random House is the leading adult and children's publishing house in North America, the United Kingdom and many other regions around the world. Job Description


Delacorte Press, an imprint of Random House Children’s Books, is seeking an Associate Editor to join its editorial team and support our growing licensed publishing program.

Home to a long history of bestselling and award-winning books, Delacorte is a close-knit, highly collaborative team that believes the best publishing comes from working together. We are passionate about our books and authors, generous with ideas, and invested in one another’s success and we’re looking for a colleague who is excited to contribute to that team culture.

Delacorte’s young adult licensed publishing list includes an exciting and expanding range of properties and publishing partnerships, including Disney, Marvel, Lucas, 20th Century Studios, and Warner Brothers. The program encompasses both licensor-driven publishing and original, in-house developed projects, such as Once Upon a Snowfall by Lydia Gregovic and MJ Loves Spider-Man by Emma Lord.

The Associate Editor will manage a selection of licensed publishing projects, identifying viable licensor-developed titles and working with our team and the licensor to tailor them for our list. They will also identify and develop new publishing opportunities and acquire select projects. Working closely with authors, agents, licensors, and colleagues across Design, Production, Marketing, Publicity, and Sales, this role combines hands-on editorial work, acquisitions, creative development, and project management.

The ideal candidate is a creative and highly organized editor with strong commercial instincts who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. They should be excited by the challenge of finding fresh ways to translate established characters, worlds, and franchises into compelling books for young readers while managing multiple projects, stakeholders, approvals, and evolving schedules.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned licensed publishing projects from manuscript development through publication, providing thoughtful editorial feedback and creative direction while ensuring projects meet both Delacorte’s editorial standards and licensor requirements.
  • Identify, develop, and acquire select new projects with an eye toward commercial opportunities, emerging trends, and properties with strong potential in the MG and YA marketplace.
  • Develop original publishing concepts within licensed worlds, including identifying formats, story opportunities, and potential authors and creators.
  • Evaluate proposals and manuscripts and participate in acquisitions discussions.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with authors, agents, licensors, creators, and other external partners, serving as a key liaison throughout the publishing process.
  • Manage licensor submissions, feedback, and approvals while maintaining detailed project schedules and navigating evolving deadlines.
  • Partner closely with Design, Production, Marketing, Publicity, and Sales on positioning and publication plans.
  • Manage retail-exclusive editions and paperback conversions, including the development and approval of new editorial content and design elements.
  • Identify opportunities within the backlist for refreshed, repackaged, or updated editions tied to cultural moments, franchise activity, or renewed consumer interest.
  • Contribute to the strategic growth of Delacorte’s licensed publishing program, identifying opportunities to expand and strengthen the list.

Qualifications


  • 3+ years editorial experience in trade publishing, with experience independently managing books or comparable publishing projects through the editorial and production process.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to provide substantive and line-level editorial feedback.
  • Excellent organizational and project-management skills, with demonstrated ability to manage a large and shifting workload and multiple simultaneous deadlines.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with creative teams, internal stakeholders, and external partners.
  • A strong interest in children’s and young adult publishing, popular culture, entertainment properties, and franchise storytelling.
  • Experience with licensed publishing and/or working with licensors and approval processes is a plus.

This is an exciting opportunity for an editor who enjoys both the creative and operational sides of publishing and wants to help shape a dynamic and growing program that brings beloved characters and worlds to readers in new ways.

Company Description


Alliant University is a professional practice University committed to excellence in four areas: Education for Professional Practice, Scholarship, Multicultural and International Competence and Community Engagement. The University provides students with the highest quality of education through excellence and innovation in academic scholarship, applied training and research, and community service, particularly to underserved populations. Core competencies of the University's training programs include cultural diversity, which is infused in courses and field placements and is manifest in the diversity of its students, faculty.

Our Mission:
Alliant University prepares students for professional careers of service and leadership, and promotes the discovery and application of knowledge to improve the lives of people in diverse cultures and communities around the world.

Our Vision:
An inclusive world empowered by Alliant alumni.

Our IMPACT Values:

  • Inclusion: We value and engage the rich diversity of the Alliant community.
  • Mentoring: We provide guidance and create enabling environments for success.
  • Passion: We bring enthusiasm, creativity, and authenticity to our work.
  • Accountability: We act with integrity and responsibility in all we do.
  • Communication: We are responsive, transparent, and respectful in our interactions.
  • Teamwork: We collaborate to develop innovative solutions for our community.

Job Description


The School of Education at Alliant University offers a variety of degrees, certificates, and credentials in education that prepare students to make a lasting impact through teaching, counseling, leadership, advocacy, administration, management, and community work. Whether a student looking for an online degree program or an in-person learning experience, Alliant will be there to guide them every step of the way. The student’s path into the classroom — either online or on-ground — is one paved with comprehensive academic excellence through:

The Master of Science in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) is an 12-month full time program designed for working adults. The ABA Program mission is to prepare students to be professionally competent, compassionate, and ethical practitioners of applied behavior analysis who work with individuals diagnosed with disabilities and their families.

Application Description:
Applicants to this position will be considered for a candidate pool encompassing one or more of the subject areas outlined in the job description. This pool will be used to identify qualified candidates for potential appointments during the 2026–2027 academic year.

Salary Range: $26 - $31 hourly (based on course requirements & level of education). This is a temporary, non-benefits eligible role.


Qualifications


Minimum Qualifications:

Education:

  • Doctoral or Master degree in Psychology, Special Education, ABA, or a related field from an accredited college or university.

  • Board certified behavior analyst (BCBA)[

Experience:

  • Appropriate experience with teaching graduate courses in applied behavior analysis

Certifications, Licenses, etc.:

  • Board Certified Behavior Analyst

Additional Information


We are hiring adjunct professors to design the following courses:

ABA60000: Theory & Philosophy of Behavior Analysis
Description: This course examines the historical, theoretical, and philosophical foundations of behaviorism and behavior analysis. Students will develop a conceptual understanding of key theories used to explain human behavior, with emphasis on the principles underlying behavior analytic practice. The course also provides an overview of the historical evolution of behavior analysis and its impact on contemporary applications.

ABA60010: Basic Principles of Behavior
Description: This course explores basic principles of behavior. Students will gain competence in using behavior analytic terminology and an understanding of how these principles can be applied to reduce unsafe behaviors, promote skill acquisition, foster self-determination, and improve quality of life within diverse cultural contexts.

ABA60020: Behavior Measurement and Research Methods in Applied Behavior Analysis
Description: In this course students will learn about basic behavior measurement and research methodologies used in applied behavior analysis with an emphasis on single-case research designs. Students will develop competence in measurement, graphic representation, and data-based decision making. They will learn about single case research designs (e.g., multiple baseline, ABAB) by analyzing and critiquing data from SCRD studies. The course will place a strong emphasis on socially valid research and the protection of human subjects.

ABA60030: Ethics & Professionalism in Applied Behavior Analysis

Description: This course covers the ethical and professional practice of applied behavior analysis. Students will learn about the ethical principles and professional codes upheld in the Ethics Code for Behavior Analysts®. They will learn how to use these ethical principles, codes, and other cultural, legal, and professional considerations to guide their ethical decision making. The course will also provide opportunities for students to practice engaging in difficult, but common, professional conversations.

ABA60040: Behavioral Skill Assessments & Evidence-Based Instruction
Description: This course introduces common behavior analytic skill assessments and instructional strategies for individuals with disabilities. Students will learn how to assess individuals’ areas of strength and needs, and deliver evidence-based instructional strategies based on assessment results and other considerations. Students will gain competence in applying evidence-based instructional strategies to the development of communication, adaptive, academic, leisure, social, and vocational skills.

ABA60050: Functional Behavior Assessments & Interventions for Safety-Related Behaviors
Description: This course provides information about functional behavior assessment and intervention strategies to reduce behaviors related to safety (e.g., aggression, self-harm, elopement) and increase positive behavioral repertoires. Students will gain competence in selecting, applying, and recommending interventions that are functionally equivalent to behaviors of concern across multiple settings.

jobs.description:
About Us

Thrive delivers upon the promise of technology by enabling our clients’ digital transformation journeys with best practices on an AI, cybersecurity and cloud focused NextGen managed services platform.

Thrive’s culture is powered by diverse talent, big ideas, and a customer-first mindset—and it’s what truly sets us apart. Thrive is built for people who want more than a weekday routine. If you’re hungry to grow, eager to tackle new challenges and ready to drive real impact in a rapidly expanding environment, then welcome to THRIVE!

Position Overview

Thrive is seeking a client-facing Senior AI Security Architect to help organizations adopt AI safely, securely, and responsibly through technically validated security, compliance, governance, and data protection controls.

This role serves as Thrive’s technical authority for AI security architecture, technical risk validation, Microsoft Purview implementation, and governance-control design within AI Services. A successful candidate should be highly knowledgeable of technologies like Microsoft Purview, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI ChatGPT, and other AI security and governance tools. You will work directly with client stakeholders and Thrive’s Microsoft Advisory team to assess technical AI security readiness, identify security and compliance risks, evaluate data exposure, design practical governance controls, and support architecture decisions that enable organizations to scale AI with confidence.

As AI adoption accelerates, organizations must understand what data AI can access, who has access to that data, what compliance risks exist, and how technical governance controls should be implemented and validated before deployment. You will lead the technical security and control conversations while partnering with Microsoft Advisory on Microsoft-focused strategy, Copilot and AI readiness, licensing and capability alignment, adoption, optimization, governance operating models, and executive roadmaps.

This role sits within the AI Services organization and works closely with Microsoft Advisory, the AI Governance team, Security Operations, Cloud Security, Microsoft Engineering Services, and other technical teams to ensure clients have a secure technical foundation for AI adoption.

Requirements

What You'll Do

Lead Microsoft Purview Technical Assessment & Implementation Engagements

  • Serve as Thrive’s technical subject matter expert for Microsoft Purview architecture, implementation, testing, and validation within AI Services.
  • Assess client compliance, governance-control, data protection, and information protection requirements from a technical security perspective.
  • Design, configure, implement, and validate Microsoft Purview solutions including Information Protection, Sensitivity Labels, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Lifecycle Management, AI-DSPM, Records Management, eDiscovery, Communication Compliance, Insider Risk Management, and Compliance Manager.
  • Contribute technical control recommendations to governance roadmaps and compliance strategies led in partnership with Microsoft Advisory.
  • Lead Purview technical workshops, architecture reviews, implementation planning sessions, and technical findings readouts.

Conduct AI Security & Technical Readiness Assessments

Evaluate technical security readiness for AI deployments, in coordination with Microsoft Advisory where Microsoft business readiness, adoption, licensing, and roadmap alignment are in scope. Platforms may include:

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot
  • Microsoft Copilot Chat
  • Copilot Studio
  • ChatGPT Business and Enterprise
  • Claude Business and Enterprise
  • Snowflake Cortex
  • Third-party AI platforms and AI agents
  • Emerging enterprise AI technologies

Responsibilities include

  • AI security assessments
  • Technical governance-control maturity reviews
  • Data exposure analysis
  • Privacy and compliance reviews
  • AI risk assessments
  • Vendor security evaluations
  • Policy and control recommendations

Perform Microsoft 365 AI Security Environment Reviews

Lead technical discovery and assessment engagements focused on Microsoft 365 security posture, data exposure, permissions, identity controls, and AI-related risk validation.

Activities include

  • Microsoft 365 tenant security assessments
  • SharePoint permissions reviews
  • OneDrive data exposure analysis
  • Teams governance reviews
  • Microsoft Entra ID security assessments
  • Conditional Access reviews
  • Sensitive data discovery
  • Identity and access management reviews
  • External sharing assessments
  • Security control gap analysis

Deliver technical findings and remediation recommendations that support Microsoft Advisory’s broader Copilot readiness, adoption, governance, and executive roadmap deliverables.

Support AI Governance Strategy Through Technical Security and Control Expertise

Partner with Microsoft Advisory and client leadership teams to contribute technical security, risk, privacy, and governance-control expertise to AI governance strategies and roadmaps.

Responsibilities include

  • Technical governance-control workshops
  • AI policy control input and technical validation
  • Technical risk and remediation planning
  • Security, privacy, and data protection control design
  • Compliance control mapping and implementation planning
  • Technical findings that inform executive briefings and roadmap recommendations led with Microsoft Advisory

Help clients balance innovation with security, compliance, responsible AI practices, and technically validated governance controls.

Lead Client Engagements

Act as the primary technical security and governance-control architect during AI Services engagements, while partnering with Microsoft Advisory on broader Microsoft strategy, adoption, licensing, readiness, optimization, operating model, and executive roadmap discussions.

You will regularly engage with:

  • CIOs
  • CISOs
  • IT Directors
  • Compliance Officers
  • Risk Leaders
  • Legal Teams
  • Security Teams
  • Executive Leadership

You must be comfortable facilitating workshops, conducting stakeholder interviews, presenting findings, and managing complex client discussions.

Collaborate Across Technical Teams

Work closely with:

Microsoft Advisory

  • Microsoft-focused strategy, Copilot and AI readiness, licensing and capability alignment, adoption, optimization, governance operating models, and executive roadmaps
  • Joint development of client recommendations where technical security and governance controls support broader Microsoft advisory outcomes

AI Governance Team

  • Governance monitoring and managed governance services
  • Compliance reporting and control oversight
  • Coordination of operational SOC support for AI-related security monitoring, investigations, escalation, and response workflows

Cloud Security Teams

  • Identity and access management
  • Security architecture reviews
  • Zero Trust initiatives

Security Operations Center (SOC)

  • Operational SOC support will be coordinated through the AI Governance team for AI-related monitoring, investigations, incident response coordination, and threat escalation needs.

AI Services Team

  • Copilot deployment security and control validation
  • AI solution security architecture
  • Technical AI security and governance-control services
  • Client technical risk reduction and secure AI enablement initiatives

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of cybersecurity, governance, compliance, Microsoft Purview, or Microsoft security consulting experience.
  • Experience leading customer-facing technical security, compliance, or implementation engagements.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview assessment, architecture, configuration, implementation, testing, and validation.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 security, compliance, identity, access, information protection, and data governance capabilities.
  • Experience assessing identity, access management, permissions, data exposure, and AI-related security controls.
  • Excellent executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate technical findings into business-focused risk, control, and remediation recommendations.
  • Experience creating technical assessment reports, control recommendations, implementation plans, and remediation plans.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Purview certifications.
  • Microsoft Security certifications.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot deployments.
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender technologies.
  • Understanding of AI governance frameworks and responsible AI principles.
  • Knowledge of NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF).
  • Experience supporting regulated industries including healthcare, financial services, and legal organizations.
  • Familiarity with ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Business, Snowflake Cortex, and other enterprise AI platforms.
  • Experience developing AI usage policies and governance standards.

Key Deliverables

This role is accountable for producing:

  • AI Security and Technical Readiness Assessments
  • Microsoft 365 AI Security and Data Exposure Findings
  • Microsoft Purview Technical Assessments
  • Purview Architecture, Configuration, Implementation, Testing, and Validation Plans
  • Security and Privacy Control Reviews
  • Data Exposure Reports
  • Technical Risk Registers
  • Security and Governance-Control Recommendations that support Microsoft Advisory-led roadmaps
  • AI Policy Control Recommendations
  • Purview Implementation Plans
  • Technical Findings Readouts and Remediation Recommendations

Success Measures

Success in this role is measured by:

  • Client satisfaction and engagement outcomes
  • Successful Microsoft Purview deployments
  • Quality of governance and security recommendations
  • Reduction of AI-related risk exposures
  • Expansion of AI Services, adjacent Thrive opportunities, and cross-team collaboration
  • Adoption of governance controls and best practices
  • Executive stakeholder confidence and trust

Why This Role Matters

This role is a foundational position within Thrive AI Services and will help establish Thrive as a trusted partner for secure and responsible AI adoption.

You will be at the forefront of helping organizations understand their data exposure, manage technical AI risk, implement governance controls, and safely deploy the next generation of AI technologies. Your work will directly support secure adoption of Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, and emerging enterprise AI platforms while complementing Microsoft Advisory’s leadership in Microsoft strategy, readiness, adoption, optimization, operating models, and executive roadmaps.

Independent Contractor: Digital Asset Specialist Consultant

Location: Remote/Virtual

Project Lead: Associate Director National Programs

Position Type: Independent Contractor, up to 25 hours per week

Hourly range: $25-$35 per hour

About Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families (BSF) is a national nonprofit dedicated to supporting military families by providing programming and resources while strengthening their connections to their local communities. We partner with businesses, government agencies, and local organizations to create impactful programs that empower and uplift military families.

Independent Contractor Engagement Terms:

This independent contractor will be retained solely for project-based, outcome-driven services and will not be an employee, agent, or representative of Blue Star Families. The independent contractor:

  • Retains full autonomy over the method, schedule, and tools used to perform services.
  • Is not assigned work hours, or internal recurring meetings.
  • Shall not use a BSF job title, business card, or name tag.
  • Will not represent themselves as a BSF employee or agent to external stakeholders.

Scope of Work & Key Responsibilities

The Contractor shall perform digital asset management services across the following core functional areas:

3.1 Canto Platform Governance & Administration

  • Maintain overall organization and structure of the Canto library
  • Ensure consistent metadata, tagging conventions, and folder hierarchy

3.2 Portal Architecture & Intake Workflows

  • Build and manage upload links and portals for national and chapter-level use
  • Customize portals to ensure ease of use and alignment with submission guidelines
  • Provide guidance or documentation to internal users on proper upload procedures
  • Upload assets as needed

3.3 Quality Assurance & Asset Review

  • Review incoming photo submissions for quality, relevance, and compliance
  • Approve or reject assets based on established criteria
  • Ensure all images meet brand and privacy standards

3.4 Compliance, Privacy & Content Scrubbing

  • Review images for sensitive or restricted information, including visible nametapes or identifying details
  • Edit, flag, or route assets as needed to ensure compliance with organizational and military guidelines

3.5 Legacy Asset Audit & System Normalization

  • Work backward through existing asset libraries to:
    • Tag and categorize legacy content
    • Eliminate duplicates or outdated files
    • Reorganize assets into a standardized, searchable system
  • Prioritize high-value or frequently used content for faster accessibility

3.6 Continuous Improvement & Advisory

  • Recommend best practices for digital asset management
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, searchability, and user experience
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align asset organization with programmatic needs
  1. Deliverables & Milestones
  • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Documentation of Canto tagging, taxonomy rules, and upload workflows for internal staff.
  • Custom Intake Portals: Fully configured upload links/portals tailored for national and chapter-level content submissions.
  • Legacy Library Migration Plan: Audit report and completed cleanup of historical media files, including deduplication and re-tagging.
  • Monthly Asset Governance Reports: Regular updates summarizing asset intake volume, approval metrics, and platform optimization efforts.

Location: Remote (U.S.-based) (San Francisco Bay Area preferred)

About UpMetrics

At UpMetrics, we're building a world where impact organizations have the knowledge, tools, and connections to achieve their missions. Our mission is to help organizations accelerate impact through innovative technology and community, connecting funders and mission-driven organizations with the capital, insights, and relationships they need to succeed.

To deliver on this mission, we provide an impact reporting platform in combination with expert services. Together, these products empower organizations to collect, analyze, and learn from their data—gaining insights and sharing their stories to inspire change.

As a Sr. Product Designer, you will lead end-to-end design across our core platform, from research through implementation. You’ll evolve existing features and shape brand-new, 0-to-1 features and product lines, with work that touches the entire platform. Your research will directly shape product strategy through a deep understanding of our market, user needs, and behaviors. Throughout the development cycle, you will partner closely with a product manager and engineering lead as a true peer, delivering work as part of a nimble development pod. We are looking for a highly engaged, self-organizing, high-autonomy designer who wants to take genuine ownership of their work and see it through.

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to get more visibility into the business of product development and form product design ideas before the product development lifecycle begins, while remaining focused on product design and knowing your work will have an impact on the world.

Responsibilities

    • Conduct user research, usability testing, and synthesis to inform product decisions

    • Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs

    • Define and implement UX/UI patterns and design systems

    • Collaborate with PM and the design team on product strategy and execution

    • Collaborate with the engineering team on product development, building and maintaining design artifacts

    • Drive user research, design sprints, and workshops to solve complex problems

    • Drive the use of personas in product development

    • Develop and maintain a deep domain knowledge of our market and its personas

About You

    Required qualifications:

    • A degree in Design or related field (Cognitive Science or Psychology, Computer science/Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) / Human Factors, Information Science / Information Design.)

    • 6+ years of product design experience

    • Experience designing B2B or enterprise SaaS products

    • Comfortable owning the full arc, from discovery and research through to shipped execution, including running research yourself across a range of methodologies

    • Strong visual design skills, typography, color, and hierarchy, at a level that raises the bar for the whole product rather than matching what's already there

      • Experience designing AI features with attention to explainability, confidence signals, and graceful failure.

      • You follow your nose: when a design decision or research finding catches your attention, you ask why, work backwards to the real problem, and look for a better answer.

UpMetrics Values

jobs.excerpt: The Senior Specialist, Product Safety Risk Management is responsible for supporting the safety of regulated and non-regulated medical imaging software devices through ownership and application of ISO 14971-compliant risk management processes.
jobs.description:
The Senior Specialist, Product Safety Risk Management is responsible for supporting the safety of regulated and non-regulated medical imaging software devices through ownership and application of ISO 14971-compliant risk management processes. This role provides subject matter expertise in product safety risk management across the full product lifecycle, from concept and design through post-market surveillance. The Sr Specialist Product Safety Risk Management works closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineering, clinical, cybersecurity, human factors, and regulatory affairs, to proactively identify, evaluate, control, and monitor safety-related risks and continuously improve safety practices.

Essential Job Duties

  • Owns and maintains the safety risk management process in conformance with applicable regulations, standards, and guidance, including ISO14971, ensuring consistent implementation across the product lifecycle.
  • Ensures effective execution of safety risk management activities throughout the product lifecycle, including hazard identification, risk analysis, risk evaluation, risk control, and residual risk assessment, in accordance with defined processes.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional development teams to integrate safety risk management into design controls, architecture decisions, and development processes.
  • Provides expert guidance on the interpretation and application of safety-related regulations, standards, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) procedures.
  • Develops, maintains, and approves risk management files and associated documentation (e.g., hazard analyses, FMEAs, fault tree analyses, benefit-risk analyses).
  • Partners with clinical, human factors/usability, and cybersecurity teams to ensure comprehensive identification and control of safety risks, including use-related and security-related hazards.
  • Evaluates the effectiveness of risk control measures and ensures traceability and linkage to verification, validation, and usability evidence.
  • Supports post-market safety activities, including Health Hazard Evaluations (HHEs), complaint investigations, field safety corrective actions, and post-market surveillance trending.
  • Identifies emerging safety risks and proactively drives corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Develops and tracks safety and risk-related quality metrics to support management review and contributes to continuous improvement.
  • Contributes safety risk management content to regulatory submissions and change assessments, ensuring alignment with applicable regulatory expectations.
  • Applies systematic problem-solving methodologies to assess safety issues, prioritize actions, and clearly communicate risk-based decisions.
  • Promotes a culture of patient safety, risk awareness, collaboration and continuous improvement across the organization.
  • Participates in and supports internal and external audits and inspections as a safety risk management subject matter expert, providing objective evidence and regulatory justification as required.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in safety risk management within healthcare technology, medical devices, or other regulated industries, preferably involving Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).
  • Demonstrated practical experience applying ISO14971 to software-based medical devices across pre-market and post-market phases, including post‑market feedback and risk management file updates.
  • Strong understanding of design controls and their integration with safety risk management activities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and risk-based decision-making skills.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and influence without authority.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly document and justify risk-related decisions.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a collaborative team environment.

Technical Skills

  • In-depth knowledge of ISO 14971 and its application to medical device software.
  • Working knowledge of related standards, including ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and IEC 62366-1.
  • Knowledge of applicable regulatory frameworks, including:

o 21 CFR Part 820 Quality System Regulation

o Canada Medical Devices Regulations (SOR/98-282)

o EU Medical Device Regulation (EU) 2017/745

  • Familiarity with software development lifecycles, including agile methods, and technology applications such as Jira, Xray Test Management, and Microsoft 365.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, life sciences, or another technical or scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Advanced training or certification in medical device safety risk management preferred.
  • Experience with agile development environments and cloud-based solutions preferred.

Work Environment

  • Office environment, hybrid, or remote work-from-home depending on location.
  • Travel: ~10%

This range may also be subject to change as market conditions evolve. We encourage open communication throughout the interview process to discuss compensation expectations. TECHNICAL SUPPORT SPECIALIST

You will be the first line of defense for clients experiencing technical issues with our products, the Mogli SMS & WhatsApp application. You'll also have the opportunity to deepen your knowledge of Salesforce administration, configuration, and other products on the AppExchange. This role is a great fit for someone who is curious, a quick learner, and solution-focused when it comes to client needs.

What we hold sacred around here:

Empathy: A powerful characteristic that’s about being in tune, seeing, knowing, and understanding others while also relating as a human in a tech-minded world. Listen. Ask questions. Offer tactful solutions. Instead of serving our own interests, we are wired to serve others.

Hustle & Tenacity: We are action-oriented and happiest in motion. We take pride in delivering exceptional experiences for our clients & partners. In the midst of adversity or challenges, we don't quit, but hold to a vision and eliminate barriers to find resolution & make things happen.

Twinkle in your Eye: It’s that hidden energy, emotion, or humor – the excitement of having a particular idea before putting it into action. You know something about something and you are excited to share that knowledge.

Proactive: We aim for a no-surprises policy that builds trust by outlining next steps early and often, identifying patterns, and courageously communicating. A little extra effort up front saves a big effort later on. Proactivity is a generous and conscientious act.

Growth Minded: We are continually evolving, creating, beautifully curious, and willing to step outside our comfort zones. Unwilling to settle for how things are, we are always looking for ways to engage more effectively and efficiently. Navigating a growing and dynamic business is easiest with a growth mindset.

What we’re looking for:

  • Client-Centric: A passion for understanding client needs and a commitment to providing exceptional technical support.
  • Technical Aptitude: Experience with Salesforce as a power user or administrator (we'll help you grow!).
  • Problem-Solving Prowess: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve technical issues.
  • Effective Communicator: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to explain technical concepts clearly to clients.
  • Quick Learner: A willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to changing environments.
  • Team Player: Thrives in a collaborative environment and is eager to contribute to team success.
  • Growth Mindset: A desire to continuously learn and develop your technical expertise.

What your day-to-day looks like:

Technical Support

  • Provide first-line technical support for the Mogli SMS & WhatsApp application via email, text, virtual meeting, phone, or chat, ensuring client success with Mogli products and services.
  • In our collaborative remote environment, actively contribute to team success by sharing knowledge, participating in team training, and working closely with the team on troubleshooting. Contribute to team meetings by identifying internal issues, proposing process improvements, and actively participating in discussions.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues, working with senior support team members to diagnose and identify bugs when necessary, and escalate unresolved issues to the Technical Support Manager promptly and efficiently.
  • Leverage your Salesforce and Mogli products knowledge to assess client needs and craft appropriate solutions.
  • Advocate for client priorities internally within the Mogli team.
  • Maintain accurate client information in Salesforce Cases to track progress toward KPIs and ensure seamless cross-department communication.
  • Develop and update our internal knowledge base and blog posts, contributing content to the Mogli support community.
  • Configure Mogli and implement basic, pre-packaged automations. For complex or custom automation requirements (such as advanced Flows), manage the handoff process to the Solutions Engineering team, ensuring a seamless experience for the client.
  • Actively participate in the product release cycle by testing new package versions in demo environments, confirming bug resolutions, and documenting changes to feature functionality or naming conventions; closely monitor and follow new patch releases.
  • Recognize and understand new features/releases in our products and Salesforce; communicate changes in Salesforce that create a potential need for changes in our product.

What you bring to the table (along with traits noted above):

  • 2+ years of experience in a software support role, with demonstrable expertise using Salesforce as a power user or administrator (a baseline understanding is required, and we will support your continued growth).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, prioritize tasks effectively, and communicate clearly across various channels (e.g., email, phone, video conferencing, chat) in a remote work setting.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and build strong client relationships.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and escalate client issues to the appropriate internal teams (e.g., Product, Senior Support, Solutions Engineers, Account Management, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt to rapidly changing environments and client requirements.
  • Fluency in foreign languages and/or experience in the nonprofit or international development sector is a plus.

Salary and Benefits

  • Bonus incentives for productivity milestones set by management
  • Complete Medical, Vision, Dental Insurance, Short-term/Long-term Disability, and Life Insurance fully covered by Mogli

jobs.description:
ASURION

Vice President, Automation & Robotics Engineering

SCM | Reports to: SVP, SCM

Travel: Regular travel to Asurion's global operations and other production sites required

Position Summary

Asurion's Supply Chain is executing a three-year vision: an intelligent, automated device lifecycle in which AI and robotics run as one closed loop for every individual unit. Delivering the robotics and physical-automation half of that loop is what this role exists to do. This newly created Vice President role owns the automation, robotics, and applied-AI roadmap across Asurion's Supply Chain global production network. The role leads Asurion's existing automation engineering team on day one and is accountable for building a real automation presence at every site where production happens today, and at new sites as the network grows. This role owns automation end-to-end — the full hardware and software stack behind every solution — and runs it as an R&D-through-delivery function: researching and solutioning new automation capability, owning its implementation into production, and formally handing off steady-state operation to site Operations once a solution is stable.

Responsibilities

  • Own the automation, robotics, and applied-AI roadmap and execution across the global Supply Chain sites.
  • Lead and grow the automation engineering team of engineers, technicians, and project managers, expanding its footprint to match where production actually happens.
  • Own end-to-end technical accountability for both the hardware and software behind every automation solution, from initial R&D through implementation and handoff to steady-state Operations.
  • Own vendor contracts and SLAs for automation solutions — uptime, throughput, and reporting — holding vendors to committed service levels and zero-defect execution.
  • Own technical escalation for automation issues beyond standard maintenance and troubleshooting, and coordinate how automation interacts with IT, Operations, Maintenance, and external vendors/integrators.
  • Stand up automation capability at new production facilities as they come online, rather than retrofitting it after a site is already running.
  • Hold the line on process readiness: partner with Operations and Continuous Improvement to question, delete, simplify, and accelerate a process before automating it, and qualify projects only once that work is complete.
  • Apply AI-enabled capability — AI grading at intake, machine-vision quality control, predictive maintenance, robotic sort and repair, robotic process control — to remanufacturing and repair lines, and support maximizing at the unit level.
  • Partner with site operations and equipment maintenance teams on reliability and uptime standards for automated systems.
  • Partner with Planning, Procurement, Data, and Technology to close the loop — ensuring robotic execution feeds unit-level outcome data back into forecasting, grading, and routing models so the system self-corrects and accuracy compounds.
  • Ensure automated systems are built on the shared demand, inventory, and returns data platform, so solutions run in production rather than as standalone pilots.
  • Build and defend the multi-year investment case for automation and robotics capital, tied to cost, throughput, quality, and client-commitment outcomes.
  • Manage vendor relationships for automation hardware, robotics, and software across a multi-site, international footprint.
  • Build the robotics and automation talent bench — including external pipeline partnerships and reskilling floor teams as roles shift from execution to exception handling.
  • Position automation capability for eventual externalization, so the solutions built for Asurion's own network can be offered to clients and partners as a service.
  • Report roadmap progress, exit-criteria attainment, and site-level performance to senior Asurion leadership.

Skills and Qualifications

Experience

  • 10+ years in automation, robotics, or process engineering leadership.
  • Experience running or scaling multi-site or global manufacturing/production automation programs.
  • Hands-on experience deploying automation and robotics in a high-volume operational environment — manufacturing, electronics repair/refurbishment, or distribution.
  • Experience owning vendor contracts, SLAs, and performance management for outsourced or vendor-supported automation solutions.
  • Experience running the full lifecycle of a technical solution from R&D through implementation and handoff to a steady-state operations team.
  • Experience applying process improvement or Lean discipline ahead of automation — simplifying and stabilizing a process before deploying technology onto it, and turning down or deferring projects that aren't ready.
  • Experience leading technical teams across multiple international sites, not just a single location.
  • A track record of standing up new technical capability at a new site from the ground up.
  • Experience securing and defending capital that is justified on strategic capability and market position, not solely on labor payback.
  • Experience taking AI or machine-learning capability from pilot into sustained production operation, including the data foundations it depends on.

Technical Skills

  • Robotics and industrial automation controls.
  • Computer vision / machine vision inspection systems, including AI-based grading and automated quality verification.
  • Working literacy in the data and AI stack automation depends on — demand forecasting, unit-level decisioning and routing logic, and the platforms that host them.
  • Predictive maintenance and equipment reliability practices.
  • Robotic process control and workflow/conveyance automation.
  • Capital equipment planning, hardware/software integration, and vendor management.
  • Vendor contract and SLA management, including uptime, throughput, and performance reporting.

Soft Skills

  • Strong financial and business-case acumen; able to build and defend multi-year capital investment cases — including cases where the return is capability and competitive position rather than near-term labor payback.
  • Cross-site, cross-cultural leadership; comfortable operating across geographies and time zones.
  • Stakeholder management across operations, quality, engineering, IT, and external vendor/integrator partners.
  • Comfortable building capability from the ground up in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments.
  • Clear, credible communicator who can translate complex technical and automation concepts for executive, operational, and site-level audiences alike.
  • Proven people leadership — able to hire, coach, and retain a technical team through a period of rapid growth and organizational change.
  • Skilled at leading organizational and process change, including standing up new reporting lines, new sites, and new ways of working, with minimal disruption to ongoing operations.
  • Executive presence; comfortable presenting roadmap, investment cases, and performance results directly to senior leadership.
  • Able to influence and align peer leaders and cross-functional partners without direct authority over them.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Service Consultant - Network Automation (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: deine aufgaben Deine RolleDer Maschinenraum ist das Herzstück für die Serviceerbringung für unsere Kunden.
jobs.description:
deine aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Der Maschinenraum ist das Herzstück für die Serviceerbringung für unsere Kunden. Du übernimmst mit Deinen Teamkolleg:innen die Verantwortung für den stabilen, effizienten und zukunftsfähigen Betrieb der IT-Services für unsere Kunden. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt dabei auf Netzwerk und Firewall.
Du musst diesen Bereich noch nicht in voller Tiefe beherrschen. Wir suchen ausdrücklich auch Kolleg:innen aus der internen IT, die Netzwerk bisher nebenbei gemacht haben und daraus ihren Schwerpunkt machen wollen. Wir haben das Wissen im Team, um Dich dahin zu bringen.

Das bedeutet im Detail:

  • Betrieb der Netzwerk- und Firewall-Services unserer Kunden (Routing, Switching, VPN, Regelwerke)
  • Bearbeitung von Tickets (Anfragen der Kunden) in unserer ITSM-Lösung
  • Aktualisierung der Betriebsdokumentation
  • Mitarbeit an den Betriebskonzepten und deren Automatisierung

Service-Verantwortung

Nach der Einarbeitung gibt es die Möglichkeit zur verantwortlichen Weiterentwicklung des Betriebskonzepts für einen der folgenden Services:
  • Netzwerk-Services (z. B. Routing, Switching, VPN, Firewall)
  • Anbindungs- und Integrationsservices (z. B. Standortanbindungen, Cloud-Networking)
  • Netzwerkautomatisierung (z. B. Provisionierung, Konfigurationsmanagement, Compliance Checks)
  • ggf. weitere
In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du folgende Verantwortung für den betreffenden Service:
  • Weiterentwicklung der Leistungserbringung pro Service auf Basis der dazugehörigen Leistungsbeschreibung
    • Dokumentation des „Wie“ pro Service in unserem Wiki
    • Definition sowie Erstellung einer Checkliste pro Service für die Übergabe in den Betrieb
  • Weiterentwicklung der Leistungsbeschreibung unserer Network Services
  • Weiterentwicklung und Multiplikation des Wissensstandes der Kolleg:innen im Maschinenraum
    • Planung und Durchführung interner Schulungen
    • Planung externer Schulungen in Absprache mit dem Team
Was wir mit dieser Rolle nicht meinen:
  • Die Person, die den jeweiligen Service bei allen Kunden betreibt
  • Die einzige Person, die Services in den Betrieb übernimmt
  • Die Person, die das Monitoring für einen Service einrichtet
  • Die Person, die alle Tickets für einen Service bearbeitet
  • Die Person, die vom ersten Tag an alles können muss

Erste Arbeitspakete

1. Einarbeitung in die Kundenumgebungen
Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen lernst Du unsere Kunden, deren Netzwerke und unsere Betriebsabläufe kennen. Wir arbeiten in langfristigen Betriebsaufträgen, Du hast also die Zeit, die Umgebungen wirklich zu verstehen.

2. Einarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung eines bestehenden Network-Automation-Konzepts
Danach arbeitest Du Dich in ein bestehendes Automationsprojekt zur Verwaltung von Switch- und Routerkonfigurationen ein. Ziel ist es, das vorhandene Konzept zu verstehen, fachlich weiterzuentwickeln und die laufende Umsetzung zu begleiten.
NetBox dient dabei als zentrale Source of Truth und Visualisierung der Netzwerkinfrastruktur. Änderungen an den Daten in NetBox bilden die Grundlage für automatisierte Konfigurationsänderungen, die mittels Ansible in der Infrastruktur ausgerollt werden.

dein profil

Das solltest Du mitbringen:

  • Erfahrung im IT-Betrieb, gerne aus der internen IT eines Unternehmens
  • Praxis mit Netzwerk und Firewall (z. B. VLANs, Routing, VPN, Regelwerke). Auf welchem Niveau, klären wir in Ruhe im Gespräch
  • Lust, Dich fachlich zu vertiefen, statt überall ein bisschen zuständig zu sein
  • Arbeitsfähigkeit im Homeoffice
  • Du kannst Dich selbst organisieren
  • Fähigkeit zur strukturierten Dokumentation
  • Teamfähigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke
Das brauchst Du noch nicht mitzubringen, das lernst Du bei uns (ausdrücklich kein muss):
  • Erweiterte Kenntnisse der Protokolle MPLS, BGP, OSPF und LDP
  • Netzwerkautomation und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. NetBox, Ansible, Python, REST-APIs)
  • Grundverständnis von Source-of-Truth-Konzepten
  • Erfahrung mit ITSM-Prozessen
  • Cloud-Networking (z. B. Azure)
  • Herstellerspezifisches Wissen zu Aruba, HPE und Fortinet
  • Konzeptentwicklung und Durchführung von Schulungen

Entwicklungsperspektiven

  • Übernahme der Verantwortung für das Betriebskonzept eines Services
  • Mitgestaltung der Betriebsmodelle neuer Services
  • Vertiefung in Automatisierung und DevOps-Praktiken
  • Weiterbildung und Zertifizierung
    • Netzwerk-Zertifizierungen (herstellerneutral oder -spezifisch)
    • Cloud Networking (z. B. Azure Network Engineer)
    • Automatisierung und IaC
    • u. v. m.

arbeiten bei der worksimple

In dem Team, für das wir diese Stelle besetzen möchten, wird eine Service-Zeit von Montag bis Freitag im Zeitraum von 07:00 bis 18:00 Uhr abgedeckt. Außerhalb dieser Zeit erwarten wir keine ständige Erreichbarkeit von Dir. Die Einteilung Deiner Arbeitszeit kannst Du in Abstimmung mit den anderen Teammitgliedern vornehmen. Du wirst am firmenweiten Announcement um 11:45 Uhr und am Daily des Maschinenraums um 09:45 Uhr teilnehmen.
Technisch arbeiten wir im Maschinenraum strukturiert: mit Betriebskonzepten, Dokumentation im Wiki und klaren Abläufen. Organisatorisch sind wir bewusst flexibler unterwegs, siehe unten.

jobs.description:
The role delivers growth to Red Hat through developing, proposing, negotiating and closing complex financial contracts in excess of $80M+ in Total Contract Value. These solutions solve our customers' commercial and fiscal challenges and transform our businesses' business relationships through mitigation of risk and quantifying and visualizing the application of creative solutions and their impact to the total customer buying relationship. The Dealmaker represents Red Hat in must win customer negotiations and owns deal results, leveraging Fiscal/Risk Scenario Analysis, modeling and proposals to gain customer trust and deliver outcomes (Revenue Growth, Margin, and Cash Flow).
We will consider candidates located in any EU country where Red Hat is registered to employ Associates.
What You Will Do:

  • Partner with customers to create new, innovative fiscal and commercial contractual solutions that deliver revenue and margin growth leveraging existing and new customer budgets and expanding the total Red Hat share of wallet.
  • Support, develop and deliver on ACV and ARR goals through one off engagements and coordination with local Sales, Finance, deal desk, BU and Sales Operations on a case-by-case basis.
  • Design, evaluate and advise FLT on IBM/Red Hat cross brand commercial revenue opportunities that leverage joint capabilities and maximize customer and commercial outcomes.
  • Negotiate intercompany IBM/Red Hat on commercial revenue share and executing strategy of high-profile joint pursuits.
  • Develop recommendations that accelerate sales, including analysis of build, partner and buy opportunities and other strategic investment proposals that inspire senior leaders to grow Red Hat in new ways.
  • Work directly/indirectly with the largest Red Hat customers to assist in determining and approving optimal commercial solutions that meet the customers’ needs while optimizing the IBM / Red Hat offer while maximizing the revenue opportunity. Empowerment and decision making, broad legal and financial authority, with extensive understanding of concession risks and cost of sales implications.
  • Accountable for making decisions regarding concessions to drive deals to closure while minimizing risk to Red Hat and closing good, profitable business.

What You Will Bring:

  • 10+ years Direct Sales experience with commercial enterprise customers
  • Extensive experience with contracts and negotiations of committed spend and/or other ELA style contracts with hands-on experience and demonstrated success with customers with $25M+ annual spend.
  • Experience with RFP and/ or Software negotiation on opportunities > $100M+ contract value at senior customer level (CxO).
  • Knowledge of the marketplace, competition and specific challenges of major industry sectors driving negotiation behaviors that present risk for the customer and Red Hat with the ability to quantify and model to customer and stakeholders.
  • Must be able to navigate a frequently changing environment, incomplete information and complex stakeholder structures.
  • Strong analytical, mathematical, scenario analysis and software tool skills (ex. Excel, Powerpoint, Pivot tables, data manipulation, transformation, expected value) and how to use these to present compelling financial business cases to customers.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills with knowledge of ZOPA, BATNA, etc. and how to use these in conjunction with excellent presentation skills (internally and customer-facing).
  • Proven capabilities of exemplary impact through cross-group collaboration and partnerships.
  • Experience in pricing and economics along with strong understanding of GAAP and Non-GAAP accounting.

Nice To Have:

  • Knowledge of Enterprise Platform and successful implementation of transformation utilizing enterprise platforms, with the ability to map relevant technologies to customers’ IT and business needs and priorities/adoption over time and transform into visional collaborative scenario models using customer collaboration and assumption that build alignment and trust.
  • Understanding of Partner Ecosystem business models (including Tier 1s, ISVs, SIs) and the ability to identify asymmetries that provide unique joint value creation opportunities for relevant repeatable solutions or domain practices and apply these to create commercial value.
  • Strong understanding of financing and SaaS/subscription revenue recognition.
  • Deep understanding of the industry competitive landscape with the ability to translate Red Hat’s value proposition to drive globally compete strategies that present Red Hat’s unique competitive advantage.
The salary range for this position is $247,780.00 - $409,000.00 (inclusive of base pay + target incentive compensation). Actual offer will be based on your qualifications.

Pay Transparency

Red Hat determines compensation based on several factors including but not limited to job location, experience, applicable skills and training, external market value, and internal pay equity. Annual salary is one component of Red Hat’s compensation package. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, and/or equity. For positions with Remote-US locations, the actual salary range for the position may differ based on location but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience.

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterpriseopen source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

    ● Additional benefits including employee stock purchase plan, family planning reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, transportation expense account, employee assistance program, and more!

Note: These benefits are only applicable to full time, permanent associates at Red Hat located in the United States.

Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

“We know the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.”

Our Summer Internship Program:

Our Summer Internship Program (PLOT) offers an opportunity to gain meaningful experience in Information Technology while building the foundation for a successful career. During this 12-week program, you'll learn from experienced technology professionals, tackle real-world projects, and develop working knowledge of IT operations, business technology solutions, cybersecurity, infrastructure, data management, and digital innovation within a leading agribusiness organization. You'll have the opportunity to present your internship learnings directly to leadership. This is more than just an internship. It's your chance to make a real impact, build professional knowledge, and sharpen your abilities in a dynamic, results-driven environment. Successful completion of the PLOT program can also earn you a scholarship between $1,000 and $3,000.


Role Overview:

As a Wilbur-Ellis IT Intern, you'll gain experience across a variety of technology functions, including business applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data analytics, technical support, and digital transformation initiatives. You'll work alongside technology professionals to support projects that help improve business processes, enhance user experiences, and enable organizational success.

Responsibilities may include assisting with technology implementations, supporting business systems and applications, analyzing data and system performance, conducting technology research, participating in process improvement initiatives, supporting end users, documenting procedures, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve business challenges through technology.

You'll have the opportunity to share your ideas, contribute innovative solutions, and gain firsthand exposure to how technology supports and drives business performance. At the conclusion of your internship, you'll prepare and present a final PowerPoint presentation highlighting your project work, key learnings, and overall experience.


What You Bring to the Role:

As an intern, we understand you may not already have extensive professional experience. We are seeking a college student pursuing a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Business Technology, Information Systems, or a related field with an interest in technology and business innovation.

Overall, we are looking for someone with strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills; attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy; the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively; intellectual curiosity and a willingness to learn; a self-starter who is eager to contribute ideas and collaborate with others; and someone who brings their full self to work each day.   • Exposure to enterprise applications, data analytics, cybersecurity practices, and IT best practices
  • Mentorship from experienced Information Technology professionals and business leaders
  • A deeper understanding of how technology enables business operations, drives innovation, and supports organizational growth
  • Real-world experience contributing to projects that improve efficiency, security, collaboration, and business performance across the organization

Compensation and Benefits:

  • In compliance with all states and cities requiring transparency of pay, the base compensation for this position ranges from $17.00 to $24.00 per hour. Note that wages may vary based on location, skills, and experience.

Please note that salary ranges provided for this role on external job boards are salary estimates made by outside parties and may not be accurate.

Diversity of people, cultures, opinions, and ideas makes us all stronger. From leadership commitment to employee buy-in, we know that creating an inclusive environment and providing opportunities for all employees to reach their full potential is a shared responsibility.

Wilbur-Ellis is a company you can be proud to call your employer

Wilbur-Ellis markets and distributes agricultural products, animal feed specialty chemicals, and food ingredients. A privately held and consistently profitable company, we employ more than 4,000 people throughout North America and Asia-Pacific.

Please note, this listing is not for an immediate open position but for our Talent Pool 3D Generalists.

We are experiencing exciting growth and as such we are seeking a 3D Generalist with a minimum of 5-7 years of experience and an extensive background specifically in product advertising only to join Grip. The ideal candidate should demonstrate significant expertise in shading and lighting using 3ds Max and Vray, and be capable of rendering hyper-realistic products.

What’s Grip?

As INDG's software branch, Grip is an end-to-end content automation platform that generates infinite ad variations by combining CGI, rule-based generative AI, and post-production into an easy-to-use automated content generation platform that transforms master ad creatives into endless variations—empowering brands to scale content production globally without compromising on quality or brand consistency.

Grip works by taking master content supplied by brands or their agencies and converting it into a deeply modular configurator. This allows marketers to create their own visual adaptations and variations effortlessly, saving millions in production costs while maintaining brand consistency.

What will you be doing?

  • Work on all facets of 3D pipeline on multiple projects with tight deadlines, includes modeling, texturing, lighting, liquid simulation, render management and basic compositing.

  • Quality control of tracking and matching moving files.

  • Integrate 3D elements in real live footage.

  • Communicate effectively with team members, VFX supervisors and Project Managers.

  • Troubleshoot and problem-solve any technical issues that may arise.

  • Meet project deadlines and milestones.

  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies.

Requirements

Would be amazing if you are/have:

  • Phoenix fd or similar simulation software, Tyflow or similar, After Effects or Nuke, and Photoshop.

  • Proven experience as a 3D generalist with a robust portfolio.

  • Strong knowledge of shading, lighting and rendering, with a good knowledge in liquid simulation.

  • Familiar with the process of integrating 3D elements in live-action footage.

  • At least one working example that shows a strong sense of 3D (shading and lighting).

  • Must be able to balance quality with the project's time frame.

  • Effective planning and prioritization of multiple tasks, with problem-solving skills.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and a critical eye for visual quality.

  • Effective at taking direction, asking questions, and learning through observation.

  • Quick learning ability for new processes and technology.

  • Excellent (English) communication skills.

Working at Grip

At Grip, we believe whatever you give your full attention becomes worthwhile. We choose to focus our attention on developing and utilizing technology to create beautiful images and videos. Because we’re doing something we care about, working here isn’t merely a means to an end; it’s our life.

Our team comprises learners and doers from over 50 countries, representing a wide range of backgrounds, identities, experiences, and perspectives. We don’t just allow remote work; we fully embrace it. We’re committed to excellence, and we’re always looking for more people who want to focus their care and attention on making beauty scalable through technology.

The procedure

If you’re ready to bring your powers to a role where you can make a difference, we want to hear from you. Send your resume and portfolio in English via the link provided. If you have questions, contact our Recruitment Department at .

After reviewing your application, if there’s a potential fit, a member of our recruitment team will be in touch with you.
