jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryCriterion Edge is seeking an experienced Senior Director to lead its Pharmaceutical Writing Services group, with substantial hands-on pharmaceutical and biologic regulatory medical writing expertise and the ability to independently author and lead complex medical device clinical evaluations as needed.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Criterion Edge is seeking an experienced Senior Director to lead its Pharmaceutical Writing Services group, with substantial hands-on pharmaceutical and biologic regulatory medical writing expertise and the ability to independently author and lead complex medical device clinical evaluations as needed.
The Senior Director will provide scientific, technical, and operational leadership for pharmaceutical writing engagements, including oversight of complex clinical submission programs, client relationships, writer development, resourcing, and quality. The successful candidate must also be capable of independently leading end-to-end Clinical Evaluation Report (CER) projects under the EU MDR, including responses to Notified Body questions.
This is a hands-on writing leadership role, not solely a people-management, regulatory affairs, or review position. The Senior Director must be able to personally author and critically review complex pharmaceutical and medical device documents and serve as a technical authority for writers, project teams, and clients.

Required Pharmaceutical Writing Experience

Candidates must have:
  1. At least 8 years of direct pharmaceutical and/or biologic regulatory medical writing experience, with substantial recent hands-on authorship of complex clinical and regulatory submission documents.
  2. Demonstrated end-to-end leadership of pharmaceutical writing programs or major submission workstreams, including planning, authoring, review coordination, issue resolution, and delivery of submission-ready documents, rather than experience limited to discrete sections, editing, quality control, or project management.
  3. Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate pharmaceutical and biologic clinical regulatory writing strategies, coordinating across clinical, regulatory, biostatistics, safety, and other functions.
  4. Demonstrated ability to advise clients on pharmaceutical regulatory guidance, submission expectations, and implications for clinical and regulatory documents.
Relevant pharmaceutical and biologic regulatory writing experience may include:
  1. Regulatory submissions: INDs, NDAs, BLAs, and global regulatory dossiers.
  2. CTD clinical documentation: Clinical Overviews, Clinical Summaries, Integrated Summaries of Safety (ISS), and Integrated Summaries of Efficacy (ISE).
  3. Clinical development documents: Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), clinical study protocols, and Investigator's Brochures (IBs).
  4. Regulatory authority interactions: Regulatory briefing documents and responses to regulatory authority questions.
  5. Safety and benefit-risk documentation: Integrated safety evaluations, benefit-risk assessments, and related regulatory documentation.
  6. Regulatory strategy and advisory services: Development of regulatory writing strategies and advising clients on evolving regulatory requirements and submission expectations.
Experience planning and coordinating clinical submission documents across eCTD Modules 2 through 5, including integrated clinical summaries and major marketing application workstreams, is strongly preferred.
Candidates must demonstrate the ability to lead pharmaceutical writing engagements independently, including development of the writing strategy, coordination of cross-functional reviews, resolution of conflicting reviewer comments, and direct communication with sponsors and regulatory stakeholders.

Required Medical Device Experience

Candidates must have:
  1. At least 5 years of direct medical device regulatory or clinical writing experience, with substantial end-to-end EU MDR CER leadership experience.
  2. Demonstrated ability to independently scope, author, lead, and finalize regulator-ready CERs, including resolving complex clinical evidence issues and addressing Notified Body questions without day-to-day supervision. Experience limited to editing, quality control, review, project management, or authorship of individual CER sections is insufficient.
  3. Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate regulatory strategies for medical device programs.
  4. Demonstrated ability to guide clients on regulatory updates, changing requirements, and the potential impact of those changes on clinical and regulatory documentation.
Independent CER leadership must include the ability to direct and perform the following activities, as applicable:
  1. Clinical evaluation planning and strategy: Clinical Evaluation Plan (CEP) development, project scoping, and clinical evaluation strategy.
  2. Literature review and clinical evidence assessment: State-of-the-art development, systematic literature review strategy, literature screening, clinical data appraisal, and evidence synthesis.
  3. Clinical evaluation and benefit-risk assessment: Evaluation of device safety, performance, clinical benefits, equivalence (where applicable), and benefit-risk conclusions.
  4. PMS and PMCF integration: Evaluation and integration of post-market surveillance (PMS) and post-market clinical follow-up (PMCF) data into clinical evaluations.
  5. CER development and regulatory support: Authoring and finalization of regulator-ready CERs, lifecycle updates, and responses to Notified Body questions and deficiencies.
  6. Regulatory strategy and client advisory: Interpretation of evolving EU MDR, MEDDEV, MDCG, and related regulatory requirements and advising clients on their implications for clinical evaluation.
Candidates must demonstrate current working knowledge of EU MDR clinical evaluation requirements, MEDDEV 2.7/1 Rev. 4, and applicable MDCG guidance.

Preferred U.S. Medical Device Submission Experience

Candidates should also have experience authoring, leading, or substantially contributing to U.S. medical device regulatory documentation; direct 510(k) authorship is preferred.
Relevant experience may include:
  1. FDA regulatory submissions: 510(k), De Novo, and Premarket Approval (PMA) submissions.
  2. Regulatory and scientific documentation: Predicate device comparisons, substantial equivalence assessments, clinical and performance evidence summaries, and supporting technical documentation.
  3. FDA interactions: Preparation of responses to FDA questions, requests for additional information, and regulatory deficiencies.
  4. Regulatory strategy and client advisory: Development of U.S. market access strategies and advising clients on evolving FDA requirements and submission expectations.
Leadership Responsibilities
The Senior Director will:
  1. Lead Criterion Edge’s Pharmaceutical Writing Services group, with accountability for technical quality, delivery, staff development, and the successful execution of pharmaceutical and biologic regulatory writing engagements.
  2. Establish consistent pharmaceutical writing processes, quality expectations, and technical review standards while maintaining direct authorship capacity for priority or high-complexity deliverables.
  3. Serve as the senior pharmaceutical regulatory medical writing expert for complex clinical submission programs, while providing independent technical leadership for CER projects when needed.
  4. Lead pharmaceutical client scoping discussions, proposal input, kickoffs, and ongoing senior-level client communications.
  5. Develop and communicate regulatory and medical writing strategies appropriate to each project.
  6. Guide clients on regulatory updates, changing requirements, emerging guidance, and their potential impact on regulatory strategy and documentation.
  7. Plan pharmaceutical writing deliverables, budgets, timelines, resource requirements, and cross-functional review cycles; oversee execution and address delivery risks.
  8. Independently author or lead pharmaceutical regulatory documents and major submission workstreams, and lead complex EU MDR CER projects from planning through finalization, including Notified Body deficiency responses.
  9. Review complex scientific and regulatory documents for scientific accuracy, regulatory compliance, consistency, and overall quality.
  10. Lead, mentor, and provide substantive scientific and regulatory oversight to Principal and Senior Medical Writers; assign work appropriate to writer expertise and provide actionable feedback.
  11. Provide technical direction when project teams encounter complex scientific, regulatory, or writing issues.
  12. Serve as an escalation point for high-risk or technically complex projects.
  13. Work directly with client regulatory, clinical, biostatistics, safety, quality, and medical teams.
  14. Lead client discussions involving regulatory strategy, document development, review resolution, regulatory updates, and submission readiness.
  15. Translate regulatory changes into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and internal project teams.
  16. Support development and improvement of writing procedures, templates, training materials, and quality standards.
  17. Support business development activities by providing technical expertise during proposals, capability discussions, and prospective client meetings.
  18. Own or actively support writer allocation, capacity planning, project estimates, and identification of appropriate resources for pharmaceutical and medical device engagements.
  19. Maintain awareness of evolving medical device and pharmaceutical regulatory requirements and communicate relevant changes to clients and internal teams.

Minimum Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:
  1. Bachelor's degree or higher in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, biomedical sciences, engineering, or another relevant scientific discipline.
  2. 5+ years of medical device regulatory or clinical writing experience, including substantive CER authorship.
  3. 5+ years independently leading end-to-end CER projects, including substantial EU MDR CER work from 2019 to the present and direct experience resolving Notified Body questions.
  4. 8+ years of pharmaceutical or biologic regulatory medical writing experience, including substantial hands-on authorship and leadership of complex submission documents.
  5. Demonstrated end-to-end leadership of a significant pharmaceutical submission program or major clinical submission workstream, with personal authorship of major regulatory documents.
  6. Demonstrated experience working with eCTD-based pharmaceutical submissions.
  7. Experience substantially contributing to U.S. medical device regulatory submissions; direct 510(k) authorship is strongly preferred.
  8. Demonstrated experience developing regulatory strategies for medical device and/or pharmaceutical programs.
  9. Demonstrated ability to interpret regulatory updates and provide clear guidance to clients regarding resulting actions or documentation requirements.
  10. Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex pharmaceutical medical writing projects and manage multidisciplinary review teams.
  11. Experience interacting directly with clients and senior stakeholders.
  12. Demonstrated ability to review and provide substantive scientific and regulatory feedback on the work of other senior medical writers.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 12+ years of total pharmaceutical, biologic, and medical device regulatory medical writing experience.
  2. Previous Director, Associate Director, Senior Manager, Principal Medical Writer, Regulatory Writing Lead, or comparable senior-level experience.
  3. Advanced scientific degree such as MS, PharmD, PhD, MD, or equivalent.
  4. Experience across both U.S. and EU regulatory environments.
  5. Experience with EU MDR remediation or transition projects.
  6. Experience responding directly to Notified Body questions.
  7. Experience leading NDA/BLA submission programs and integrated clinical submission workstreams.
  8. Experience with eCTD Modules 2 through 5.
  9. Experience leading multidisciplinary submission teams.
  10. Experience advising clients on evolving FDA, EU MDR, MDCG, ICH, or other regulatory requirements.
  11. Leadership experience in a medical writing consultancy or CRO supporting multiple external pharmaceutical clients.

General Summary

jobs.description:
Embedded Software Engineer BLE over CAN Integration for RV-Screen

About the Project

We are upgrading the communication system of a new TFT touchscreen (RV-Screen) this is a user interface to control recreational vehicles such as caravans and motorhomes. The current system uses Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to communicate between a user-facing Android tablet and an embedded electronics control unit (Node), with certain features managed via a physical interface over a CAN Bus network. To improve reliability and resolve intermittent BLE connectivity issues, we're moving to the new RV-Screen with native CAN support. The new solution will reroute existing BLE communication through the CAN Bus network using the Recreational Vehicle CAN Bus (RV-C) protocol.

Role Overview

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will be crucial in redesigning the communication architecture for the new system. Your role will involve splitting BLE packets (up to 21 bytes) to fit the 8-byte capacity of RVC frames, managing packet transmission and reassembly, and ensuring that BLE-specific events (e.g., connections, disconnections, characteristic discovery) are correctly communicated over RVC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop mechanisms for BLE packet fragmentation, transmission, and reassembly over the RVC network.
  • Integrate necessary metadata (message type, size, handle) within RVC frames for reliable message reconstruction.
  • Implement protocols to communicate BLE events over RVC, ensuring seamless integration.
  • Test and validate the new communication system, focusing on eliminating previous BLE connectivity issues.

Who We're Looking For

We need a skilled Embedded Software Engineer with experience in:

  • Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) communication protocols.
  • CAN Bus especially in embedded automotive or recreational vehicle systems.
  • Data packet fragmentation and reassembly.
  • Designing and implementing robust communication protocols for embedded systems.
  • Coding in C language on the (Node) and C++ on the (RV-Screen)

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to work on a high-impact project that enhances the functionality of a leading-edge RV product, solving real-world problems while pushing the limits of embedded software and systems integration. If you enjoy tackling complex challenges and have a passion for embedded technology, we want to hear from you!

Position Title: Business Development Representative

Location: United Kingdom or Europe

Employment Type: Full-Time

Onsite, Remote or Hybrid: Remote/Flexible

Department: Marketing

Hiring Manager: Manager of Business Development

Travel: Minimal

COMPANY SUMMARY:

Here at Aprimo, our mission is to empower the marketing organisations of today to build the brands of tomorrow. Aprimo is a pioneer of the marketing resource and digital asset management space, and we deliver an innovative, industry-leading SaaS solution that changes the way companies like AT&T, National Park Foundation, Laborie, and Bank of America work, create, collaborate, and learn in order to deliver exceptional brand experiences at scale.

Aprimo helps enterprises unleash the power of their content by providing a marketing automation software and digital asset management software that manages the behind-the-scenes activities involved in marketing. Our product allows companies to manage content planning, creation and distribution all in one place, store content and media in a shared repository, and receive in-depth insights into how content performs.

Founded in 1998, Aprimo has five offices internationally, including Chicago headquarters, and offers a flexible work-from-home/remote-work policy.

Named a Leader in Digital Asset Management (DAM) and Marketing Resource Management by Forrester and winner of the 2021 Tech Cares Award for our work with Aprimo HELPS, we build on the power of our people to make an impact both in our industry and in our communities.

POSITION SUMMARY:

At Aprimo, the Business Development Representative (BDR) will work with Demand Generation to assist Account Executives (AE) to drive new business revenue. You will be required to utilise leading sales technology to meet activity and opportunity quotas per month.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

  • Work with Demand Generation to identify target prospects/stakeholders to engage with
  • Work with marketing and Account Executives to create and drive a nurture program to support pipeline development
  • Build targeted lists for your outreach using ZoomInfo , Cognism and Salesforce
  • Work with prospects to identify business challenges through structured discovery conversations, with a ‘solution first’ mindset to align their challenges with the values and outcomes Aprimo can provide
  • Generate high-quality first-time appointments per month for your Account Executive to attend
  • Continue development and maintain a qualified opportunity pipeline that exceeds 3x of the team annual quota
  • Identify any gaps in KPI’s against strategic territory plan
  • Utilise existing networks and relationships to build new business
  • Accurately document information on each opportunity through Aprimo’s SFDC CRM tool while always recording/maintaining next steps/actions
  • Share inputs and collaborate with other departments in preparing sales materials, presentations, and driving new initiatives
  • Develop and maintain market knowledge and competitor positioning to be a credible advisor in this space
  • Identify and attend relevant industry events that support pipeline creation
  • Additional responsibilities and duties may be assigned as required

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS & WHY YOU’RE A GREAT FIT FOR THE ROLE:

  • The Essentials
    • A minimum of 1-year experience in a similar role within a software provider, SaaS, digital or technical sales environment
    • 1-2 years of related experience (marketing, sales, consulting, business process)
    • Fluency in English is required
    • Previous history meeting target goals
    • Proven track record of generating opportunities in a purely new business BDR/MDR role – strong performance against target
  • Additional Successful Qualities
    • Self-starter mentality with the ability to work independently
    • The ability to focus on identifying and selling to business challenges, not just the technology
    • The ability to demonstrate understanding of digital landscape and importance of multi-channel communications
    • An agile mind and a person who thrives in a fast moving sales environment
    • Aptitude to manage numerous requests and time demands concurrently, while achieving goals from assigned territory
    • Proven business development success through effective use of core sales tools: Salesforce, Intent, LinkedIn SalesNav, ZoomInfo, Microsoft Office etc
    • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with a distributed sales team
    • Capability of understanding customer pain points, requirements and correlating potential business to value that can be provided
    • Promotes a strong sense of urgency for reaching goals and key deliverables. Acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company

APRIMO CULTURE & WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:

  • Aprimo offers a forward-thinking, progressive and employee-first culture that is based in both collaboration and flexibility with team members who are friendly, intelligent and enthusiastic people that are committed to the product and mission here at Aprimo.
    • With 5 offices worldwide and teams spread throughout the US, EMEA and Philippines, our multicultural teams work cross-departmentally and across continents and cultures towards a shared goal.
    • We offer a diverse environment that promotes DEI efforts, values multiple perspectives and fresh thinking and which includes Aprimo HELPS, an employee resource group (ERG) that is dedicated to giving back to our local communities
  • Through its relaxed environment, Aprimo embodies a more casual “Silicon Valley” atmosphere.
    • We have a casual dress code that allows employees to express themselves as individuals and which fosters a creative and free-thinking approach to problem solving and business solutions. And it also allows us to wear hoodies and shorts during internal meetings.
  • Flexible work schedules and all positions allowing for either entirely remote or hybrid working arrangements create a deeply rewarding work-life balance.
    • With flexible work schedules, employees can attend to personal matters, such as stepping away to pick up their children from school or to get a much-needed haircut.
    • In a recent internal survey, 89% of staff cited work-life balance as being one of the most rewarding aspects of working at Aprimo!
  • Part of the key to our success is that team members are not only successful at collaboration and open communication, but that they are also given a great deal of autonomy and freedom in their own individual roles.
    • Our culture is not a micro-managing environment – rather, employees are encouraged to be self-starters, to voice new ideas, and to exercise ownership in their individual roles.
    • As such, individual team members can leave a lasting impact and footprint within the organization – in fact, our average employee tenure is 7.7 years.
  • Aprimo employs a “choose your own adventure” approach to career advancement.
    • Staff members are not siloed into roles and for many of our teams there is no set ladder that one needs to climb to achieve growth and promotion.
    • Rather, we emphasize an organic approach to career development in which employees can and do frequently transition into newly created roles within their own teams or transition into other departments based on their interests in exploring new skills and responsibilities.
    • For additional learning and development, we recently rolled out Udemy, which is an online learning platform that employees have access to and which features over 200,000 courses on a wide variety of business topics.
  • Ranked #1 in AI Metadata & Search by Forrester, Aprimo sits on the cutting-edge of technology and is paving new paths forward by incorporating AI (artificial intelligence) into our product offerings.
    • We offer generative AI in a secure environment built for brand safety and governance. Our AI-powered content operations platform, with industry leading digital asset management (DAM) software at its core, helps to optimize the creative process and improve the user experience with better search, recommendations, categorization and summarization.
    • Our AI empowers marketing teams to automate tasks, analyze data, and personalize content, ensuring scalability without sacrificing productivity.
    • AI automatically identifies asset characteristics and transforms them into words a human would search for. Translation, image alterations, personalization, and more are all streamlined by AI.
    • With our platform, marketers can efficiently produce a larger volume of content, engage customers on a personalized level, curate relevant materials, and make data-driven decisions to drive their content strategies forward.
    • Our AI offers up to 72% increase in discoverability and productivity, up to 61% reduction in production time, and up to 66% faster time to market.

APRIMO BENEFITS WE OFFER:

  • Target Compensation: Annual base salary target of the euro or British pound equivalent of $55,000 USD and commissions target of $30,000 USD, depending on job related knowledge, skills, and level of experience. This is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, or other law.
  • Competitive benefits coverage that begins on the first day of employment

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be able to remain in stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods and performing sedentary work that primarily involves sitting/standing
  • Must be able to move about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another
  • Must be able to perform light physical work that includes lifting or moving objects up to 20 lbs. or medium work that includes moving objects up to 50 pounds on occasion
  • Must be able to communicate with others to exchange information, including conveying detailed or important spoken instructions to others accurately, loudly, or quickly
  • Must possess the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication at normal speaking levels
  • Must be able to repeat motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers (i.e., repeated typing, etc.)
  • The worker is required to have close visual awareness to perform an activity and to assess the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned, such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.
  • This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.

jobs.excerpt: About SANSFounded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization.
jobs.description:
About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You'll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking a Curriculum Marketing Operations Coordinator to join our Central Marketing - Product Marketing team. This role plays a key part in supporting the development, launch, promotion, and analytics of SAN Institute short and long course training. This position will play a pivotal role in the successful release of ongoing updates to existing courses and launch of new courses. This position will also identify and implement operational processes to improve the efficiency and accuracy with which tasks are completed.

You'll thrive in this role if you are detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills, and the ability to master operational platforms quickly. You are a self-starter and organizer who enjoys multi-tasking and bringing many disparate operational tasks to completion simultaneously and on-time.

The person in this role will work with a cross-functional team of internal stakeholders and external partners throughout the course development and launch process to track, coordinate, and implement deliverables and tactics on multiple projects at a time. This person will schedule cross-departmental team meetings, working closely with the marketing and curriculum teams to ensure alignment on project goals.

The ideal candidate should also have strong reading, writing, editing, and attention to detail skills to serve as a point of quality and consistency control for all curriculum marketing content. They must engage in hands-on execution of marketing tasks, maintain a “can-do” attitude, and be willing to complete entire efforts without detailed oversight.

This position requires the Marketing Coordinator to be available and working during standard business hours, Monday through Friday from 8AM–5PM EST. You will work from home and must have an appropriate space and environment to execute work during these time periods. SANS supplies at-home workers with appropriate information technology and telecommunications support for their home offices. This position requires travel approximately every two to three months.

As a Curriculum Marketing Operations Coordinator, you will:

  • Review and continually update course and instructor content in all print, web, and digital marketing materials to ensure that current, accurate information is published.
  • Update course descriptions and instructor biographies in our document management system and provide output to the web team, Sales, Marketing, Business Unit teams, Leadership, etc.
  • Project manage course launch/updates scheduling project checkpoints and deliverable reviews to ensure the appropriate team members are involved.
  • Work with our internal teams to schedule, publish, and host instructor webcasts and livestreams.
  • Coordinate with the Curriculum Product Marketing Managers all weekly curriculum community communications including content, featured training, key resources, etc.
  • Publish blog articles written by our course authors and test different related “call-to-action content to grow our list and increase course and content engagement.
  • Support the execution of social media campaigns, working with the design team to produce the appropriate graphics, post the content across different platforms, and help manage the marketing programs calendar.
  • Ensure a measure of consistency across different curricula on items such as sales enablement materials, instructor biographies, social media graphics and newsletters.
  • Engage with the tradeshow team to fulfill curriculum marketing requirements at various events.
  • Proactively manage project delivery and approval process with little supervision, resolving action items, issues, and risks, including the instructor payment and purchase order process.
  • Communicate with stakeholders regarding new and ongoing requests, project needs and changes.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Curriculum Directors/Leads, Product Marketing, content creators, design, campaign managers, digital strategist, and more to ensure alignment and successful campaign execution, and delivery of annual projects.
  • Track and analyze relevant metrics and data across our channels creating reports and recommendations to optimize content.
  • Manage asset storage and organization across multiple platforms.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:

  • 2+ years of marketing and/or program management experience
  • Project management certificate a plus
  • Understanding of SEO
  • Detail oriented, excellent communicator, and ability to multitask within a team setting
  • Able to be resilient when dealing with high-pressure situations
  • Has a positive "can do" approach for all projects
  • Must be a problem solver and adapt to changing priorities
  • Strong project management skills in a fast-paced creative environment
  • Ability to manage time appropriately and meet deadlines
  • Ability to identify subtle issues that could result in major conflicts
  • A team player that can provide creative ideas and cultivate productive relationships
  • Working knowledge of analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Tableau
  • Strong service orientation, project management, and organizational skills
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is $55,000 - $60,000, depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Flexibility and Balance at SANS

We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in-person presence depending on role-specific or business needs.

SANS is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

SANS is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact SANS Human Resources.

US Job Seekers: Click here to view the “Know Your Rights” poster.

SANS complies with all applicable state and local laws regarding the consideration of applicants with arrest or conviction records. For positions governed by federal and/or state banking regulations, SANS will adhere to relevant requirements when evaluating candidates with criminal histories.

Employment eligibility in the United States is required. SANS does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

This is a senior, hands-on founding engineering role with ownership of architecture, infrastructure, and engineering execution. You will strengthen and extend an established production platform, leading the existing engineering team.

You will take full ownership of technical decisions, implementation quality, and production operation. Josh leads product priorities and brings deep infrastructure-finance expertise; you translate those priorities into sound engineering decisions and dependable software. You will work with Josh and our financial modeling team to understand complex workflows and build reusable platform capabilities. 1. Product and Application Engineering

Build the product end to end on the existing stack of Next.js, React, TypeScript, and a .net C# excel control layer. Design robust financial data models, reliable calculation orchestration, source-system integrations, and scenario and version controls. Make outputs traceable and reproducible, with reconciliation and review where required. Deliver clear, responsive interfaces for complex financial workflows.

2. Infrastructure and Architecture

Own and evolve the existing architecture, services, data layer, infrastructure as code, deployment environments, observability, and CI/CD. Make build-versus-buy decisions and lead technical planning and execution. Strengthen testing, performance, recovery, and release practices as deployments and usage grow. Own the engineering controls that protect confidential customer financial data: authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, encryption, access control, and audit trails. Maintain reliable production operation through monitoring, backups, incident response, and controlled deployment and rollback. You are accountable for implementation and operation.

4. Product Collaboration and Team Leadership

Partner with the CEO and financial modelers to translate customer requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, and software with clear acceptance criteria. Own engineering delivery and production readiness, with customer communication led by the CEO. There is potential for this role to participate directly in and own parts of that discovery and workflow over time once domain fluency is proven. Guide and mentor the engineering team, maintain code-review and delivery standards, and help assess future engineering hires.

Some marketers create content. The strong ones turn ideas into visibility, consistency, and measurable momentum.

At Whitecollars, we are looking for the second kind. We are hiring a Digital Marketing & Content Specialist to join our team, someone who can combine content execution, digital marketing discipline, strong taste, and smart use of AI tools to move work forward at a high standard.

This is not a role for someone who only wants to post content and follow instructions. It is for someone who can take an idea, shape it properly, execute it well, and help turn marketing direction into real output across channels. If you are the kind of person who enjoys building, refining, publishing, improving, and keeping marketing work moving with quality and consistency, this role may be a strong fit.

Why this role matters:

At Whitecollars, marketing execution matters because visibility, trust, and brand quality are not built by ideas alone. They are built by disciplined, high-quality output. As a Digital Marketing & Content Specialist, you will help transform marketing direction into polished content, a stronger digital presence, and better day-to-day execution across website, social media, and marketing initiatives.

Success in this role is not just about producing more content. It is about producing better content, keeping execution under control, and helping marketing work move with consistency and quality.

In practical terms, success looks like:

  • content that is well written, well structured, and ready to publish
  • website and social media execution that is organized and reliable
  • stronger use of AI and digital tools to improve speed and quality
  • marketing ideas that get turned into finished output, not left as unfinished concepts
  • a visible improvement in consistency, responsiveness, and execution quality across marketing work

Requirements

  • Strong writing, editing, and written communication skills in Arabic and English
  • Strong research, organisational, and project coordination skills
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • High attention to detail and a strong standard for quality
  • A proactive, self-driven mindset and the ability to work with limited supervision

Preferred background

  • Experience publishing blog content, landing pages, and website content
  • Familiarity with Canva or similar design and content creation tools
  • Experience in recruitment, education, consulting, or service-based businesses
  • Strong interest in AI, automation, and productivity tools

What we are looking for beyond the CV

  • A proactive problem-solver who takes ownership of work
  • Someone who enjoys learning, experimenting, and improving how things are done
  • Strong execution skills and a real get-things-done mindset
  • A team player with strong communication and organisational discipline
  • Genuine interest in content, digital marketing, AI tools, and emerging technologies

Benefits

  • Whitecollars is a remote-first company: we are built around modern work, not office presence
  • You get flexibility with accountability: people are trusted to manage their work professionally and deliver at a high standard
  • You get real ownership: this is not a narrow execution role, strong contributors are trusted with meaningful responsibility
  • The environment is built for growth: if you perform well, there is room to grow fast and take on bigger scope

C’est simple : en tant que chauffeur indépendant, vous conduisez un véhicule d’un point A vers un point B. Voici comment ça fonctionne :

Company Presentation

Backed by experienced investors from the iGaming industry and an established game development capability with approximately two decades of experience delivering games and gaming technology for international clients, a new B2B real-money gaming provider is being launched.

The venture combines a strong production foundation, an experienced game development team, an initial portfolio of 10 slot and crash games, and access to investment resources.

The company's ambition is to become a significant international B2B gaming provider, building a commercially competitive game portfolio and securing strong distribution across multiple markets.

The business is at an early stage, offering an opportunity to shape its market positioning, commercial strategy, and long-term growth from the ground up.

The company is looking for a commercially driven CEO / Co-Founder with deep game provider experience, an established industry network, and the entrepreneurial mindset to build a scalable business.

Role Overview

The CEO will take ownership of the company's strategic vision, market-entry strategy, commercial development, and international distribution.

The primary challenge is not building a game development operation from scratch. The production and operational foundations are already in place.

The CEO's mission is to transform these assets into a rapidly growing B2B gaming business.

The successful candidate will understand how to position games across different markets, establish strong commercial relationships, negotiate competitive distribution agreements, and generate meaningful GGR.

The role requires a highly entrepreneurial leader with a strong commercial background, ideally a former CCO, CBDO, or CEO of a game provider.

The CEO will work closely with the existing COO, who will support operational management, financial planning, budgets, KPI frameworks, and production execution.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Business Growth

  • Define the company's strategic vision, commercial positioning, and international growth strategy.

  • Identify priority GEOs and develop market-entry strategies based on player preferences, competitive dynamics, and commercial opportunities.

  • Build a scalable distribution strategy through casino operators, aggregators, and platform partners.

  • Leverage an established personal network to accelerate negotiations and secure high-value partnerships.

  • Negotiate competitive commercial terms, including revenue-sharing structures, lobby placement, and promotional commitments.

  • Drive the commercial funnel from initial partnership discussions to signed agreements, integrations, go-live, game visibility, and revenue generation.

  • Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers across the global iGaming industry.

Market Entry & Distribution

  • Develop a phased international expansion strategy, initially targeting commercially accessible markets in line with applicable regulatory requirements while preparing for entry into regulated markets.

  • Identify the most commercially attractive opportunities for the initial portfolio of slot and crash games.

  • Determine the optimal balance between aggregator-led and direct-to-operator distribution.

  • Secure meaningful lobby positioning, featured placements, and promotional support.

  • Build strong market coverage and sustainable GGR growth.

  • Prioritise early commercial traction and product-market fit before accelerating investment and expansion.

Product & Commercial Performance

  • Collaborate with the COO and product team to align the game portfolio with market demand.

  • Translate knowledge of GEO-specific player preferences, game mechanics, and competitor performance into commercial opportunities.

  • Influence portfolio priorities based on market intelligence and distribution potential.

  • Assess the commercial performance of games using GGR, NGR, turnover, player engagement, retention, and operator-level results.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the commercial performance of existing and future games.

  • Distinguish between game performance issues and challenges caused by distribution, visibility, or promotional positioning.

Leadership & Business Development

  • Build and lead the commercial organisation, including distribution, business development, marketing, account management, and commercial analytics.

  • Define strategic priorities and collaborate with the COO on financial planning and execution.

  • Develop a scalable business model aligned with long-term commercial targets.

  • Present growth strategies, investment requirements, and business cases to shareholders.

  • Represent the company at major industry events, conferences, and strategic partner meetings.

  • Act as an entrepreneurial business leader with a long-term ownership mindset.

Requirements

  • Direct senior leadership experience within a B2B real-money game provider, preferably in slots, crash, or instant games.

  • Proven commercial success in scaling a game provider, its distribution network, or its international revenue.

  • Strong experience in C-level commercial leadership, ideally as CCO, CBDO, CEO, or Co-Founder.

  • A well-established personal network of casino operators, aggregators, platforms, and senior industry decision-makers.

  • Demonstrated ability to turn commercial relationships into signed agreements, live integrations, and measurable revenue.

  • Deep understanding of the global iGaming provider market, including GEO-specific dynamics, game mechanics, and player preferences.

  • Strong knowledge of revenue-sharing models, B2B commercial negotiations, distribution economics, and promotional opportunities.

  • Experience building and scaling commercial teams or business units.

  • Strong strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and genuine motivation to build a business as a long-term partner and shareholder.

  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally on a regular basis.

Experience solely with casino operators, platforms, aggregators, or other adjacent industries without direct game provider experience will not be considered sufficient.

Company Offers

  • The opportunity to become CEO / Co-Founder of a new international B2B iGaming provider.

  • Investment backing from shareholders with substantial iGaming industry experience.

jobs.title: Creative Director - Brand Narrative
jobs.excerpt: In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront.
jobs.description:
In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together.

That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable.

We’re looking for a Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative, a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work.

Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting. What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling.

You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing. Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off.

You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.

What you’ll do

In your first year, your focus will be roughly 70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.

  • Originate and lead big creative ideas. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. Develop ideas that can take distinctive forms across film, social, out-of-home, digital, experiences, and partnerships.
  • Bring ambitious concepts to life with your creative peers and the full studio. Work side by side with the Brand Design and Writing leads and their teams from the earliest explorations through delivery. Develop ideas together, exchange thoughtful critique, and make creative choices that draw on each discipline’s expertise. Stay hands-on, contribute through your own craft, and partner closely with Motion and Production throughout. For film, remain closely involved through scripts, visual development, production, and the final edit.
  • Build audience and distribution thinking into the idea. Shape concepts around how people will discover, watch, and share the work. Work with marketing partners to consider channels and viewing contexts from the beginning, so the work belongs where people encounter it rather than simply being resized to fit.
  • Push beyond the first good answer, and learn quickly. Lead thoughtful concept development and critique. Use rough scripts, prototypes, and AI tools to test ideas quickly, learn, and move the strongest work forward. Know when to keep exploring and when to commit, then protect what makes an idea interesting through feedback and production.
  • Find opportunities before a brief arrives. Bring curiosity about Mercury’s products, customers, and the wider world. Develop proactive ideas and cultural opportunities that give the brand something meaningful to say or do.
  • Help decide where creative ambition matters most. Partner early with Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Product Design, Comms, and Insights. Help identify which moments deserve our largest creative investment, present recommendations to senior leadership, and use results from marketing and insights partners to inform what comes next.
  • Build and lead Brand Narrative. Define the team’s purpose, priorities, creative standards, and ways of working. Help hire and develop the team, shaping its structure and capabilities. Set clear expectations, and coach people to grow their judgment and conceptual strength.
  • Create a culture where the best idea wins. Make room for experimentation, honest feedback, and contributions across disciplines. Lead with generosity and conviction, share ownership of the work, and help people challenge one another without making creativity a competition for credit.
  • Build practices that strengthen the work. Establish a clear path from insight and an agreed brief to concept and execution, with useful critique and close collaboration throughout. Develop relationships with external creatives and agencies who can add a distinctive perspective or capability when needed.

What you’ll bring

  • A strong creative foundation in art direction, design, or copywriting. Your portfolio shows original concepts developed into ambitious, well-crafted work across multiple formats. You can explain what you contributed, how the idea evolved, and how collaboration made it better.
  • Deep film experience. You’ve developed film-led ideas from concept through production, with strong instincts for story, scripts, performance, pacing, and sound. You understand how these choices work together to make an audience feel something, not just make a film look good.
  • A track record of deep creative collaboration with design and writing peers. You’ve led ambitious multidisciplinary work from concept through production by building trusted partnerships. You bring a clear point of view, listen closely, work through creative disagreements constructively, and recognize when someone else’s approach makes the work stronger. You can show how your collaborators shaped the outcome, not just what you personally originated.
  • Strong taste, cultural awareness, and product curiosity. You can get close to a complex business or product, find the human truth within it, and turn that understanding into something clear, surprising, and memorable.
  • Experience developing creative people and shaping how a team works. You give specific, useful feedback, set a high bar with care, and create an environment where people can take creative risks. You’re excited to build a new function, including the everyday practices that give it a culture.
  • Clear communication and sound judgment. You can rally people around an ambitious concept, explain why it deserves investment, and navigate competing perspectives without losing the idea. You take ownership in ambiguous situations and balance creative ambition with the need to move work forward.

What success looks like

A year in, you’ll have led major launches and film-led campaigns from original concept through finished work, with Brand Design and Writing as creative partners from the beginning. The studio’s disciplines will have shaped the work together, with audience and distribution informing the creative approach.

Brand Narrative will have a clear identity, shared creative standards, and working practices that help people test and develop stronger ideas together. Alongside planned launches, you’ll have established a pipeline of proactive opportunities that gives Mercury more ways to express its product ambition with originality and cultural relevance.

Please include a portfolio featuring film-led work and broader campaign concepts. We’d love to understand your role in developing the ideas, the choices you made through production, and how you brought the work to life with others.

Deazy es una plataforma/marketplace de UK que conecta empresas que necesitan desarrollo de software con agencias de desarrollo en todo el mundo. Deazy factura al cliente final a su propia tarifa (en este caso están hablando de EUR 47/h, aunque todavía hay que confirmar si ese es el rate al cliente o lo que pagan al proveedor). Nosotros le facturamos a Deazy a un rate más bajo, y la diferencia es su margen.

El volumen potencial es importante si nos posicionamos bien con ellos.

WSP is seeking a Power Delivery Project Manager for our Power & Energy Power Delivery Management team.

The Project Manager (PM) is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities of project execution of engineering teams, promoting quality deliverables and provide strategic and technical leadership in the development and execution of project controls systems across major infrastructure programs and portfolios. The PM will oversee cost, schedule, and performance management processes, ensuring accurate forecasting, compliance, and reporting that support delivery of complex, multidisciplinary projects. The PM will partner with business leaders, clients, and project executives to implement high-quality controls practices that drive accountability, risk mitigation, and operational excellence. This role also advances innovation in controls methodology, tools, and analytics to continuously enhance performance monitoring and decision support.

The successful candidate may work from a mutually acceptable location within the United States and will be based out of any WSP local office with the ability to work remotely in a hybrid office arrangement. You must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic in-person meetings.

This Opportunity

The PM provides technical, administrative, and commercial project management leadership for the development, execution, delivery, management, control and monitoring of Substation, Transmission and Distribution Line projects throughout the US in support of company, regional, and national business line goals. This position will focus on managing engineering projects for Engineer, Procure, Construction (EPC) clients. Ensures all responsibilities throughout the full project lifecycle including proposal phase, planning and project startup, project execution, procurement, construction support, schedule, cost control, reporting, and project closeout are executed, adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds corporate and client project excellence and delivery standards. Provides practical leadership, process improvement, and innovative solutions to address schedule, cost, risk, quality, and stakeholder management challenges within a dynamic, regulated, and evolving Power Delivery and energy infrastructure environment. Provide engineering team guidance on providing engineering solutions that not only meet codes and standards but also provide total installed value to the client and ultimate owner/operator of the facility.

Your Impact

  • Provide project management leadership for small/medium/large‑scale/more complex high voltage and EHV projects throughout the US, including initiation, planning, execution, controlling, and closing ensuring support for preparing and overseeing project detailed design, budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs, monitoring external events and risk contingencies, ensuring satisfactory performance, and managing the contractual obligations to deliver the project or assigned portfolio of assigned project(s) as defined in the contract and client’s expectations.

  • Actively lead and enforce appropriate technical and constructability reviews, ensuring selection of qualified engineering and discipline leads, adherence to QA/QC programs, and compliance with utility standards and WSP project quality plans.
  • Provide written and verbal technical input to multi‑disciplinary project teams and contribute strategic, risk‑informed advisory guidance to clients on schedule, cost, constructability, and execution strategy.
  • Ensure timely updates and governance compliance for project management systems and documentation, including Risk Registers (REF/RMP), Project Management Plans (PMP), Quality Plans (QP), Project Safety Plans (PSP), and Communications Plans

  • Coordinate with area managers, technical leads, and resource managers to address staffing, subcontracting, and specialty support needs in a timely manner
  • Maintain regular client communications, including monthly progress reporting, safety performance, major risks/issues, and scope or budget impacts, reinforcing WSP’s role as a trusted advisor.
  • Ensure consistent project reporting and governance updates to clients, technical leadership, and business unit managers, proactively identifying emerging scope, schedule, cost, or risk issues
  • Monitor and manage accounts receivable (AR), unbilled revenue, cash flow, and invoicing, coordinating with project accounting and finance teams to resolve issues and maintain financial health of projects.
  • Complete formal project closeout activities, including financial closeout, documentation archiving, client acceptance, and lessons‑learned workshops to support continuous improvement
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Ensure EPC clients and ultimate owner/operators of the facility expectations are met and/or exceeded.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's in Engineering, Construction Management or other related field within the Power & Energy Market, or equivalent experience in a technical or engineering firm. Candidates with PMP certification will be considered.
  • 10+ years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within the Power Delivery/Utility Industry.
  • Minimum of 3 years applicable industry experience working and/or providing services for IOUs, IPPs, Co-Ops, Munis, EPCs, etc.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience leading engineering and/or construction teams on medium to large electrical utility scale clients for high voltage and/or extra high voltage transmission line type projects.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in managing engineering projects with an Engineer, Procure, Construction (EPC) delivery model.
  • Knowledge and experience with project management processes and tools required, including:

    • External and Internal Team Meeting Management
    • Earned Value Management
    • Change Management
    • Risk Management
    • Schedule Management (this includes experience with CPM project schedules such as Primavera P6 or equivalent
    • Financial Management
  • Highly proficient understanding of project delivery process, specifically EPC delivery model, within the Power Delivery/Utility industry and strong background and experience in project management.
  • Advanced analytical and organizational skills with demonstrated business and commercial acumen, enabling effective integration of project controls, financial performance, risk management, and client objectives.
  • Advanced proficiency with critical thinking, risk-based decision making, and problem-solving skills to make assessments and calculations involving the application of project management principles, with a sound understanding of intent, impact, and optimal outcomes.
  • Advanced proficiency with interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, clients, subcontractors, consultants, and internal teams.

While teamwork is expected, the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment is crucial.

Job Description

The Director of Field & Partner Marketing will lead The Redesign Group’s integrated field, experiential, and partner marketing strategy, bringing together regional programs, corporate events, partner initiatives, MDF, sponsorships, and merchandise into a cohesive, measurable marketing portfolio.

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, this leader will oversee a team of Field & Experiential Marketing and Partner Marketing Managers. The role is responsible for aligning investments to Sales, Alliances, OEM, and company priorities; maximizing pipeline and partner impact; and building the strategy, systems, and accountability needed for managers to independently own planning, budgets, execution, and measurement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and lead an integrated annual and quarterly Field, Experiential & Partner Marketing strategy aligned to company growth, regional Sales priorities, and partner objectives.
  • Guide regional field marketing plans, ensuring programs and investments are prioritized against pipeline opportunity, customer engagement, and measurable business impact.
  • Provide strategic oversight of corporate events, trade shows, flagship experiences, webinars, and regional programs while empowering managers to own end-to-end execution.
  • Lead partner marketing strategy across key OEM and alliance relationships, creating integrated plans that align partner priorities, Redesign solutions, campaigns, and field programs.
  • Lead the strategy and governance for MDF, sponsorships, and partner-funded initiatives, including allocation, utilization, compliance, and measurement.
  • Manage the consolidated portfolio and budget across field marketing, corporate events, merchandise, partner marketing, MDF, and sponsorships, making investment decisions based on expected impact and ROI.
  • Establish consistent measurement and reporting across the portfolio, including pipeline influence, engagement, partner contribution, cost efficiency, and ROI.
  • Build scalable operating systems for planning, budgeting, intake, prioritization, execution, and post-program reporting that create consistency and accountability across the team.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Field & Experiential and Partner Marketing Managers, setting clear expectations and enabling strong independent ownership.

Qualifications

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Sales, Alliances, OEMs, executives, and Marketing teams.

Senior Frontend Engineer (m/f/x)

If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation.

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Frontend Engineers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you!

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.

The role:

  • Angular Ownership: Take ownership of the Angular codebase, driving its ongoing development, maintenance and technical direction.

  • Frontend Architecture & Standards: Lead frontend architectural decisions and establish scalable patterns, reusable components and consistent development practices.

  • Design Systems & Component Libraries: Develop and maintain shared UI components and design systems to improve consistency, accessibility and development efficiency across the platform.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve development workflows, technical practices and the overall quality and scalability of the platform.

  • Frontend Architecture: Experience making frontend architectural decisions, establishing coding standards and maintaining scalable, maintainable applications.

  • Component Libraries & Design Systems: Experience building and maintaining design systems and reusable component libraries, including applying smart/dumb component patterns.

  • Automated Testing: Experience writing and maintaining unit, integration and end-to-end tests, including hands-on experience with Playwright.

  • Product Engineering: Ability to translate product requirements and domain logic into effective user experiences and reliable functionality.

  • Independent Delivery: Self-directed and delivery-focused, able to manage workload independently and take ownership of features from implementation through to release.

  • Problem-Solving & Quality: Strong debugging skills, attention to detail and the ability to resolve bugs, improve performance and maintain code quality.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Clear communicator who works effectively with product owners, engineers and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Legally permitted to work within the EU or UK.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Enterprise SaaS: Experience building B2B enterprise applications, including complex forms, data grids, role-based access and multi-tenant environments.

  • Product Team Experience: Experience working in small, autonomous engineering teams within a fast-paced scale-up environment.

The Experience:

At GE HealthCare, we’re building a healthier world by delivering innovative medical technologies and digital solutions that matter. As a Clinical Application Specialist (CAS), you’ll play a critical role in transforming clinical workflows and enhancing patient care by supporting the adoption and optimization of our peri-operative & digital solutions.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in the Peri-Operative care areas
  • Support clinical end user adoption to GEHC Patient Care products including : Anesthesia & Respiratory Care, Centricity High Acuity clinical information system & Peri-Operative Patient Monitoring solutions.

  • Coordinate, schedule, and execute clinical system training, monitor, and report on training outcomes. Training may be conducted onsite at customer facility and / or virtually.
  • Work in close collaboration with Product Marketing Team, identify customer satisfaction opportunities, issues, assist in escalations, problem determination and specialty training requests.
  • Develop meaningful relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs)
  • Participate in install base upgrade programs, proactive strategic customer touchpoints.
  • Drive sales process by conducting clinical product demonstrations and onsite evaluations.

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree or equivalent with 3+ years of Anesthesia technical/clinical industry experience
  • Must be a Registered Respiratory Therapist (CSRT, Provincial body) with Anesthesia Assistant as a Preferred qualifications.
  • Deep understanding of clinical education training and associated process implementation.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering complex information and modifying messaging based on audience.
  • Willingness to travel extensively 60+% within a region (including overnights and some weekends) within the US and Canada via multiple modes of transportation (car, air travel, & train, etc.).
  • Willingness to submit to a check of your driving record (given that you are applying for a position that requires you to operate a GE HealthCare owned/leased, privately owned/leased or rental vehicle for company business).
  • Comply to GEHC Quality Manual, Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy, Quality Goals, and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position.
  • It is a condition of hire that any new employee or contract worker that will provide products or services to a GE HealthCare customer facility are fully vaccinated and provide proof of vaccinations. All offers of employment are conditional upon the satisfaction of this requirement.

  • The ideal candidate will live in Central Quebec * Greater Montreal Area
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.
  • Strong presentation skills (public speaking and lecture experience desired)
  • Willingness to adopts new technologies such as virtual facilitator skills.
  • A team player with a strong work ethic. Demonstrating willingness to do more to achieve shared outcomes.

jobs.description:
Suralink® is the agentic automation platform for accounting professionals and their clients, leading the global charge in AI-driven accounting technology. As the leading AI platform for accounting firms, Suralink serves more than 50% of the top 100 enterprise accounting firms in the United States and has over 800,000 users globally.

Our mission is to empower the people we serve to redefine the meaning of efficiency in the accounting technology industry. Our award-winning SaaS platform was built for CPA firms, providing a simple, secure way to manage audit, tax, and advisory engagements.

Recognized for growth, innovation, and culture, we foster a highly collaborative, remote-first environment where exceptional, motivated professionals can make a meaningful impact. If you're passionate about building relationships and driving growth at a fast-growing SaaS company, we'd love to talk with you

Who we are looking for:

As our Senior Security Engineer, you will own our entire security posture. We are a growing company and we need someone who can plan our security roadmap and execute the technical work to back it up. You will bridge the gap between high-level risk management and hands-on engineering, ensuring our infrastructure, applications, and corporate data remain secure.

Key Responsibilities:

Security Architecture & Planning

  • Define the roadmap: Build and maintain our annual security strategy, compliance goals, and risk management frameworks.

  • Vendor & tool management: Evaluate, select, and budget for security tooling without over-engineering our stack.

  • Compliance & audits: Own or prepare the company for relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2 Type II, or GDPR).

  • Incident response planning: Create, test, and maintain our Incident Response (IR) and Disaster Recovery (DR) playbooks.

Hands-on Execution & Engineering

  • Cloud & infrastructure security: Harden our cloud environments (AWS/GCP), manage IAM policies, and configure network security.

  • AppSec & CI/CD: Integrate automated security scanning (SAST/DAST) into our deployment pipelines and conduct code reviews.

  • Endpoint & corporate security: Deploy and manage our MDM, MDR solutions, and identity providers.

  • Monitoring & triage: Utilize,Set up log aggregation and investigate security alerts and anomalies.

  • Vulnerability and patch management programs, including risk-based prioritization

Culture & Enablement

  • Security awareness: Run phishing simulations and train a remote workforce on security best practices.

  • Trust & sales enablement: Unblock sales by answering security questionnaires and ensure that we follow up what we promised our customers.

Experience and Professional Qualifications:

  • 4+ years in dedicated cybersecurity roles, ideally with experience as a "Security Team of One" or at a scaling startup (50–500 employees).

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Security Tooling: Experience with modern stack tools (e.g., Wiz, Datadog, Elastic, SentinelOne).

  • Code/Scripting: Ability to write scripts (Python, Bash, Go, Javascript, or similar) to automate security tasks and integrate APIs.

  • Compliance: Direct experience leading or heavily contributing to a SOC 2 audit.

  • Autonomy: Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with GRC automation platforms (Vanta, Drata) and with additional frameworks such as ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, or GDPR

  • Infrastructure-as-code and container security (Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker), including policy-as-code and guardrails

  • Endpoint and device management (Jamf, Kandji, Intune) and corporate IT security fundamentals

  • Relevant certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CISSP, OSCP, GCIH, or similar). Familiarity with securing AI/LLM-enabled products and internal AI tool usage

Competencies:

  • Can explain risk to executives and engineering teams alike

  • Ability to recognize existing gaps and make remediation recommendations

  • Pragmatic Mindset: Ability to balance strict security practices with business agility and developer velocity.

  • Proven track record of building security programs from scratch, not just maintaining existing ones.


At Suralink, our values guide everything we do:

  • Customer Obsessed: We seek to understand those we serve deeply and are committed to serving them better than anyone else.

  • Passionately Motivated: We care about what we do, which drives us to work hard, show grit, and go above and beyond to achieve great outcomes.

  • Constantly Improving: We are eager to learn and grow. Challenges are opportunities to innovate and enhance our solutions.

  • Team Focused: We know that our success is built together. We support one another and celebrate team achievements.

  • Highly Reliable: We demonstrate good judgment, honor our commitments, and are accountable for our results.

Why Suralink?

There’s a lot to love about working at Suralink! Here are a few of the benefits you can expect:

  • Remote-friendly policy

  • Medical/vision/dental insurance

  • Flexible PTO policy and ten paid holidays

  • Parental leave

  • Professional development allowance

  • Community involvement
