jobs.excerpt: About Legence Legence (Nasdaq: LGN) is a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings.
jobs.description:
About Legence Legence (Nasdaq: LGN) is a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. The company specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing complex HVAC, process piping, and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems—enhancing energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in new and existing facilities. Legence also delivers long-term performance through strategic upgrades and holistic solutions. Serving some of the world’s most technically demanding sectors, Legence counts over 60% of the Nasdaq-100 Index among its clients.

Job Summary We are seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Compensation Analyst to support the design, analysis, and ongoing evaluation of our compensation programs. This role will serve as a primary resource for market pricing and benchmarking, job architecture, compensation structures, compensation analysis and reporting, and pay equity support. Working closely with the Director, Compensation & Benefits, the Compensation Analyst will translate market and internal data into clear, well-supported recommendations that advance fair, competitive, compliant, and scalable pay practices. The role partners with HR Centers of Excellence, Finance, Legal, and business leaders across the organization. Central Time Zone preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

Market Pricing & Benchmarking

  • Lead job evaluations and market pricing using third-party compensation surveys, benchmarking tools, and internal comparison data.
  • Analyze external market data and internal pay positioning to recommend salary ranges, hiring targets, geographic differentials, and other pay considerations.
  • Develop well-supported pricing recommendations for new roles, releveling, reorganizations, promotions, and other organizational changes, with clear documentation of methodology and assumptions.
  • Maintain benchmark job matches and coordinate annual compensation survey participation, including job matching, submissions, data review, and quality validation.

Job Architecture & Compensation Structure

  • Support the development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of job architecture, including job families, career tracks, levels, and titling conventions.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners and leaders to evaluate jobs, recommend appropriate levels, and promote consistent application of the job architecture across the organization.
  • Review and consult on job descriptions to improve clarity, consistency, and alignment with job families, career levels, and market benchmarks.
  • Analyze, build, and maintain compensation structures, including salary ranges, grade assignments, geographic differentials, and related guidelines.
  • Support modeling and recommendations for structure adjustments to address market movement, internal equity, compression, scalability, and business needs.

Compensation Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze internal compensation data, including range penetration, compa-ratio, compression, progression, pay relationships, and other workforce trends.
  • Build and maintain compensation reports, dashboards, and decision-support tools for Compensation, HR, and leadership.
  • Ensure data accuracy through disciplined validation, reconciliation, documentation, and thoughtful review of assumptions.

Pay Equity & Compliance

  • Conduct and support pay equity analyses, identify potential areas for review, and assist with remediation modeling and planning in partnership with HR and Legal.
  • Support compensation audit requests, documentation, data validation, and control activities to maintain process integrity and audit readiness.
  • Apply consistent compensation practices and document recommendations to support defensible and equitable pay decisions.

Stakeholder Partnership & Program Support

  • Work closely with the Director, Compensation & Benefits and other stakeholders on compensation analysis, program design, job architecture, and compensation structure initiatives.
  • Coordinate and drive day-to-day analytical and operational support for annual compensation cycles, including planning, system setup, administration, modeling, analysis, and validation.
  • Provide data-backed compensation guidance to HR and business leaders for hiring, promotions, internal mobility, and organizational changes; escalate complex cases and policy exceptions as appropriate.
  • Prepare clear analyses, summaries, and recommendations for leadership review.
  • Provide backup support for broader compensation and equity-related activities as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of compensation experience, with direct exposure to market pricing, compensation survey analysis, job architecture, compensation structures, and/or compensation analytics.
  • Experience supporting job evaluation, job leveling, job architecture frameworks, and compensation structures.
  • Strong analytical and advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, modeling, data validation, and clear presentation of findings.
  • Ability to manage detailed work with a high degree of accuracy, judgment, organization, and confidentiality.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain compensation analyses and recommendations clearly to HR and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel occasionally for business needs, meetings, and onsite collaboration, as required.

Preferred Qualifications:

About Perceptive Space

Perceptive Space is an AI and aerospace company building space environment intelligence for commercial, civil, and defence operators.

We are building AI-powered space weather forecasting and decision intelligence systems for satellite operators, launch providers, defence and national security customers, and other space infrastructure teams. Our goal is to help customers respond to space environment conditions that affect satellite operations, mission design, launch planning, orbital performance, and mission resilience.

About the Role

  • This is an early-stage startup role. Priorities will change, we move quickly, and urgency matters. We are looking for someone who is energized by high ownership, high expectations, and the pace required to be part of an ambitious company.
  • This role sits at the intersection of research, engineering, and product. One day, you may be reading papers and helping develop foundational AI models for the space environment. The next day, you may be optimizing a production ML pipeline to ensure customers receive accurate, reliable, and operationally useful forecasts.
  • The position is fully remote (in Canada only).

What You’ll Do

  • Build, improve, and ship AI models for space environment forecasting and operational decision support.
  • Improve existing models, develop new ones where needed, and move promising experiments into production.
  • Apply modern deep learning techniques to sequential, temporal, scientific, and sensor datasets.
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools, automation, and modern development workflows to move faster, debug faster, test better, and accelerate experimentation.
  • Turn new research ideas into working systems quickly.
  • Improve ML pipelines so models are easier to train, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and maintain.
  • Define practical evaluation strategies, validation workflows, and performance metrics for operational AI systems.
  • Communicate decisions, results, tradeoffs, risks, and next steps clearly and often.

What We’re Looking For

  • A startup mindset with high ownership and high-velocity, hands-on execution..
  • High leverage with AI-assisted coding tools: you know how to use LLMs and modern development tools to ship faster, debug faster, write better tests, and accelerate experimentation without compromising code quality.
  • Minimum 2+ years of industry experience with modern deep learning architectures for sequential, temporal, or multimodal data, including attention-based models, transformers, representation learning, and model pretraining or fine-tuning workflows.
  • Experience with ML infrastructure tools such as cloud platforms, Airflow, Docker, and related production systems.
  • Advanced degree in engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain technical decisions, experimental results, tradeoffs, and risks.
  • Ability to operate with ownership, urgency, and independence required in a startup environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in early-stage startups.
  • Experience with C, Rust, or other performance-oriented languages.
  • Experience working on aerospace and defence applications.

Why Join Us

  • You will have meaningful ownership in an early-stage company building critical infrastructure for the space economy.
  • You will help build a category-defining product for the operators and missions that depend on space, from commercial aerospace to defence.
  • Your work will directly shape how satellites, launch vehicles, and other space infrastructure are designed, operated, and protected, with real impact for life on Earth and humanity’s progress in space.
  • We are a fully remote team solving technically deep problems with urgent, real-world relevance
  • Ample opportunity for growth

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed to help both sides assess fit for the role, the team, and the way we work.

  • Initial Interview
    A conversation with someone from our team to discuss your work experience, working style, interest in the role, and to share more about Perceptive Space.
  • Technical Panel
    A discussion with a few members of our team to understand the breadth and depth of your ML, engineering, and problem-solving experience, especially in production and deployment settings.
  • Founder Interview
    A conversation with our Founder about the company, role expectations, and what success looks like in this position.
  • Paid Working Session
    Later-stage candidates may be invited to spend a day with us completing a working session on a realistic problem related to the role. You will be compensated for your time. This session is designed to help both sides assess mutual fit.
  • Offer Call
    A final conversation to discuss compensation, benefits, stock options, start date, and next steps.
  • Compensation Base salary will be determined based on seniority, primary work location, and relevant work experience. This role is also eligible for dental, vision and healthcare benefits and stock options.

jobs.description:
Software Engineering Internship Program

Location: Remote (US)*

Duration: 4 months (start in late February 2027)

Hours: 40 hrs/week paid experience

Application Deadline: All interested applicants must apply by November 20, 2026.

The Wikimedia Foundation is the non-profit organization that operates Wikipedia – one of the most popular websites in the world, accessed by over 1.8 billion unique devices every month. It is the only non-profit in the top 50 websites, supported by a community of millions of individual donors around the world.

We are looking for graduates, non-graduates, or those seeking a career change who are interested in developing software engineering skills through an immersive “learn on the job” internship program. As an intern, you will be embedded into an engineering team within our Product and Technology departments and assigned a primary project with clear deliverables. Alongside your manager and dedicated mentor, you will learn the inner workings of our open source code that helps to create “a world in which everyone can freely share in the sum of all knowledge”. You will work with software that serves over half a billion page views per day through Wikipedia (and other Wikimedia projects). The outcome of your work will impact how all people everywhere discover, share, and contribute to free knowledge.

Additionally, you will have the opportunity to learn about various departments at the Foundation and connect with the wider volunteer movement and community.

Applicants who identify from a group that is underrepresented in the global conversation of technology advancement are encouraged to apply. We’re also welcoming applicants from communities where access to free knowledge and Wikimedia projects are just emerging.

PROGRAM DETAILS

Successful candidates must be able to commit to a four month, 40hr/week internship which will fall between late February to late June 2027. We will provide laptops and necessary software installed for the duration of the program. This role is 100% remote, and in some cases there may be potential opportunities to participate in in-person events to meet other fellow interns and teams.

POTENTIAL TEAM OPPORTUNITIES

Mobile Apps Engineering TeamThe Mobile Apps team's primary objective lies in constructing native Android and iOS applications for the Wikimedia Foundation.

EditingThe Editing team is part of the Contributors group. They work on tools for editing across MediaWiki, principally VisualEditor, DiscussionTools, and Edit check. The team is currently working on Suggestion Mode, a feature for the VisualEditor that proactively suggests actions that people can consider taking to improve Wikipedia articles.

Data Platform EngineeringThe Mission of the Data Platform Engineering team is to empower Wiki Communities and the Wikimedia Foundation to gain insights, conduct research, and build compelling user experiences, through access to privacy-aware data and data platform services. The Data Platform is a collection of systems and services providing end-to-end capabilities for our data producers and consumers to collect, discover, and use data.

Release EngineeringThe Release Engineering team enables developers to confidently build, test, and deploy code changes across Wikimedia projects, including Wikipedia, by creating the tools, infrastructure, and automation that keep software delivery fast and reliable.

Connection team

The Connection team is part of the Contributors group. They aim to improve how contributors connect and understand their impact. The team was formed in 2021 to focus on the needs of campaign and event organizers and participants and hopefully improve the experience of Wikimedia campaigns.

Tools Infrastructure (with Observability)

The mission of the Tools Infrastructure team is to provide a free, reliable, secure and scalable Cloud hosting platform to support Wikimedia contributors and developers to run tools, bots, data pipelines, and services that support Wikipedia and its sister projects.

The Observability team’s mission is to provide insight into the health, performance and behaviour of production code and systems for teams within the Wikimedia Foundation and for volunteers at large.

As we form our internship cohort, we are looking for candidates who possess:

  • Basic experience with at least one back end or front end programming language (e.g PHP, Javascript, Python) OR a mobile app language (Kotlin, Swift), OR a demonstrated interest in cybersecurity and/or privacy.
  • Basic experience with databases.
  • Basic experience with at least one scripting language.
  • For some roles:
    • Basic querying and data manipulation with SQL or other query languages
    • Linux/command-line knowledge
    • Understanding of networking, operating systems, or distributed systems concepts (latency, throughput, error rates).
  • Ability to work independently and be resourceful in solving problems.
  • Ability to stay accountable to deliverable requirements deadlines.
  • Effective and inclusive communication skills with diverse cultural and language communities.
  • Willingness and hunger to learn, a positive attitude, empathy, and a sense of curiosity.
  • The ability to flourish in a highly transparent and collaborative environment.
  • A desire to make meaningful contributions to knowledge equity, free culture, and open access to global education.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based in 40+ countries*. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$34.32 to $42.13 per hour with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.

*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following US States for these internship roles: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.

All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.

If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at or +1 (415) 839-6885.

¡Hola! Somos Cashea y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocios BNPL. Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy día tenemos más de 11 millones de usuarios activos, tanto para consumidores como para comercios, y nos convertimos en una marca de confianza en Venezuela.

Resumen del rol

Buscamos un Lead Analytics Engineer para ser el referente técnico del equipo de Analytics Engineering. Tu misión principal será diseñar y mantener la Single Source of Truth (SSoT) del negocio, estructurando modelos de datos escalables, gestionando el catálogo de datos y construyendo la capa semántica que habilitará el autoservicio de los Business Analysts (BAs). Trabajarás en la intersección entre tecnología y negocio, definiendo estándares de desarrollo y optimizando el contexto de nuestros datos para herramientas de IA.

Responsablidades

  • Modelado y SSoT: Diseñar, construir y mantener modelos de datos limpios, testeados y transformados dentro del Data Warehouse (usando dbt/Dataform) como la única fuente de verdad para el negocio.

  • Capa Semántica y Autoservicio: Crear la capa semántica y mantener actualizado el Catálogo de Datos para garantizar que los BAs puedan construir dashboards y análisis operativos sin fricción ni ambigüedad.

  • Contexto para IA: Enriquecer esquemas, metadatos y documentación en el repositorio para alimentar modelos de código/IA (como Claude Code o Copilots) y maximizar el autoservicio técnico del equipo.

  • Calidad y Calidad de Datos: Definir e implementar frameworks de pruebas (dbt tests), monitoreo de alertas y observabilidad para asegurar la consistencia del dato en toda la organización.

  • Liderazgo Técnico: Establecer buenas prácticas de desarrollo (DataOps, revisión de PRs, control de versiones) y mentorear a otros Analytics Engineers del equipo.

  • Colaboración Cruzada: Coordinar con Data Platform e Ingeniería la integración de pipelines y definición de contratos de datos (Data Contracts).

Requisitos

  • Experiencia 6+ años trabajando en entornos de datos, con al menos 3 años especializados en Analytics Engineering.

  • Experiencia 2+ liderando equipos especializados en Analytics engineering .

  • Stack Core: Dominio avanzado de SQL y experiencia sólida con dbt (o Dataform) en entornos cloud (GCP BigQuery, Snowflake o Redshift).

  • Modelado de Datos: Experiencia práctica en metodologías de modelado analítico (Kimball, Star Schema, Data Vault).

  • Ingeniería de Software: Control de versiones con Git, flujos de CI/CD para datos (DataOps) y conocimientos intermedios de Python.

  • Gobernanza: Experiencia implementando y manteniendo Catálogos de Datos (Datahub, Atlan, dbt Docs, etc.) y capas semánticas.

  • Habilidades Blandas: Capacidad comprobada para traducir requerimientos de negocio complejos en modelos técnicos escalables y guiar a otros ingenieros.

Porque te encantará trabajar en Cashea

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si necesitas una pista de por qué somos una buena opción, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

  • No trabajamos en piloto automático. Todo lo que hacemos es intencional. Nos encanta elaborar ideas plenamente conscientes del impacto que pueden tener en nuestros usuarios.

  • Tu creatividad y curiosidad son el activo más Importante.

  • Tu voz importa. Escuchamos y damos espacio a las ideas y al feedback. Todos pertenecen y lo que es importante para ti, también lo es para nosotros.

  • Valoramos la transparencia. La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.

  • Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real.

Si quieres trabajar con nosotros, llena la aplicación. ¡Nos encantaría conocerte!

jobs.description:
Werden Sie selbstständiger Überführungsfahrermit DriiveMe Partner

Erhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.

👉Registrieren Sie sich hier, um auf die Aufträge zuzugreifen:

DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.

Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe, um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar und viele weitere.

In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.

Worin besteht ein DriiveMe-Auftrag?

Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

  1. Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

  2. Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

  3. Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

  4. Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

  5. Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

  6. Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

  • Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

  • Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

  • Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

  • Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

  • Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

Wie viel verdiene ich?

Ihr Umsatz hängt davon ab, wie viele Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

Jeder Auftrag hat eine eigene Vergütung, die sich nach der Strecke, der Anzahl der Kilometer und der Komplexität des Transports richtet.

Bevor Sie einen Auftrag buchen, kennen Sie alle wichtigen Informationen: Abholort, Zielort, Vergütung und Bedingungen. Sie entscheiden frei, welche Aufträge Sie annehmen möchten.

Gesuchtes Profil

Um DriiveMe Partner beizutreten, sollten Sie idealerweise:

  • über eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis verfügen;

  • selbstständig sein oder bereit sein, selbstständig tätig zu werden;

  • zuverlässig, pünktlich und sorgfältig sein;

  • die Verfahren zur Abholung und Übergabe der Fahrzeuge einhalten;

  • verfügbar sein, um gelegentliche Aufträge in Ihrer Region oder in anderen Teilen Deutschlands durchzuführen.

Jetzt registrieren

Die Registrierung der Fahrer erfolgt zentral über die offizielle DriiveMe-Seite.

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join their team as a high-ownership, product-minded contributor. In this role, you will take end-to-end responsibility for key features and platform components within their full-stack ecosystem: Ruby on Rails (backend), React (web), and Flutter (mobile).

Become a self-employed driver with DriiveMe Partner

Access paid vehicle delivery assignments across the United Kingdom, with flexible organisation and road expenses covered.

👉Sign up here to access available jobs:

DriiveMe is Europe’s leading platform for vehicle deliveries. Every month, more than 20,000 paid assignments are offered to our community of self-employed drivers across the United Kingdom.

Major automotive companies trust DriiveMe to move their vehicles, including Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Europcar, and many more.

Across the United Kingdom, hundreds of businesses need vehicles moved from point A to point B. They publish their requirements on DriiveMe every day, making these paid assignments available to the DriiveMe Partner community.

What does a DriiveMe assignment involve?

It is simple: as a self-employed driver, you drive a vehicle from a collection point to a delivery point. Here is how it works:

  1. You create your account ondriiveme.com.

  2. You access the available assignments in your area.

  3. You review the route, payment and conditions for each assignment.

  4. You book the assignments you want to complete in just a few clicks.

  5. On the day of the assignment, you go to the collection point, collect the vehicle and deliver it to the destination.

  6. Once the assignment has been completed and validated, you receive your payment automatically within 10 days.

Why become a self-employed driver with DriiveMe Partner?

  • Additional income: every assignment is paid, with the price known in advance.

  • Flexible organisation: you choose the assignments you want to complete.

  • Road expenses covered: fuel and tolls are reimbursed according to the conditions of the assignment.

  • Simple and intuitive platform: view, book and manage assignments online.

  • Assignments across the UK: new opportunities are published every day.

How much will I earn?

Your turnover depends on the number of assignments you choose to complete.

Each assignment has its own payment, based on the route, the number of miles and the complexity of the transport.

Before booking an assignment, you know all the essential information: collection point, delivery point, payment and conditions. You are free to book only the assignments that suit you.

Profile required

To join DriiveMe Partner, you should ideally:

  • hold a valid driving licence;

  • be self-employed or willing to become self-employed;

  • be reliable, punctual and thorough;

  • follow the vehicle collection and delivery procedures;

  • be available to complete occasional assignments in your area or elsewhere in the United Kingdom.

Sign up now

Driver registrations are centralised on the official DriiveMe page.

jobs.excerpt: Why join Safeguard Global?  👀 We want to help you “work in any way” — that means making time for family, commitments, and life outside of work so that you can have the best of both worlds.
jobs.description:
Why join Safeguard Global? 👀

We want to help you “work in any way” — that means making time for family, commitments, and life outside of work so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work. 🚀

Our roles aren’t just remote and hybrid first—they break free from the traditional ways of doing things, paving a way for a job that works for you. ✅


The role in a nutshell:

The Client Success Advisor plays a critical role in building and sustaining strong, long‑term relationships across a portfolio of small to mid‑sized clients who currently leverage a limited set of Safeguard Global services but demonstrate meaningful near‑term growth potential. As the client’s primary point of contact, the Advisor develops a deep understanding of each client’s business, translating their goals into actionable plans that drive satisfaction, retention, product adoption, and expansion. Managing a portfolio of 20–50 clients utilizing 1–2 services, the Client Success Advisor partners cross‑functionally to ensure successful service delivery, mitigate risks, and identify opportunities that support both client success and Safeguard Global’s revenue growth.


How you will make a difference:

  • Establish client relationships with operating and senior level contacts (CHRO/CFO, VPs, Directors, Global Mobility, etc.) for each account within assigned client portfolio.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client’s business model, priorities, and long‑term goals, and translate that insight into success plans that drive meaningful outcomes. This includes defining desired results, identifying risks, establishing governance, and guiding adoption—ultimately turning client needs into actionable initiatives that strengthen partnership value and support revenue growth.
  • Provide timely and accurate response to client queries using all appropriate communication methods and ensuring documentation in customer service tool while maintaining CRM activities in Salesforce to provide visibility of client KPIs.
  • Develop and demonstrate a holistic understanding of Safeguard Global’s service suite to educate clients on advanced product capabilities, roadmap items, and best practices to maximize adoption and value.
  • Support clients in scoping exercises, ensuring a high probability of converting opportunities into revenue. Provide structured analysis for commercial teams, supporting renewal conversations, forecasting, and upsell/cross sell readiness.
  • Identify retention risks by analyzing patterns across countries, service lines, and stakeholders; then execute client “save” motions (early warning flags, intervention plans, service recovery, executive sponsor engagement, and escalation governance) to protect renewals and restore confidence through cross‑functional corrective actions.
  • Oversee end-to-end governance of portfolio delivery, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and service standards.
  • Lead business reviews, and multi stakeholder planning sessions.

What will give you an advantage:

  • Strong relationship‑building and client partnership skills; able to establish trust with operating‑level client stakeholders.
  • Solid communication skills (written, verbal, and virtual) with ability to simplify complex information for clients.
  • Effective prioritization and time‑management across a dynamic client portfolio.
  • Foundational account governance skills, including documenting client goals, risks, and success drivers.
  • Ability to interpret operational data and apply insights to improve client outcomes.
  • Problem‑solving capability and comfort working cross‑functionally to resolve issues.
  • Growth‑oriented mindset; able to identify opportunities that support product adoption and client value.
  • High attention to detail, CRM discipline, and consistency in documentation.
  • Experience in a service delivery and/or account management role with focus on client relationship and growth (customer support, operations, HR/payroll admin, or related fields preferred).
  • Familiar with upselling techniques for products or services
  • Demonstrated use of data in building account plans.
  • History of customer growth/satisfaction, and operational KPIs.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills.
  • Global client exposure, experience working in multinational environments a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Experience with human resource, payroll or accounting solutions experience strongly preferred.

Who we are and what we do: 

Safeguard Global is…global! We enable global expansion without the risk by helping 1,500+ customers recruit, hire, manage, and pay employees in nearly 190 countries. Join us to meet diverse talent, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe. 🌎


Our Global Benefits 

  • 👨‍💻 Autonomy and Flexibility (work in any way): Remote first, with the flexibility to include life needs like school runs and gym breaks in your schedule, all while maintaining a high standard of work.
  • 🌴 Generous leave: Enjoy a competitive leave package including paid bonding leaves for new additions to your family   
  • 🎁 Make a difference: Get 2 paid charitable days off to contribute to causes you believe in
  • 💰 Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan. 
  • ✈️ International environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.  
  • ⭐ Human centered culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.
  • 📚 Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace. 

 

Next Steps: 

To apply, please click on the following link. We wish you the best with your application. Our Guardian promise to you is to keep in touch to arrange the next stage should your application meet the position's requirements, and or a gentle update if you have been unsuccessful at this time.

jobs.description:
Diventa conducente professionale con DriiveMe Partner

Accedi a incarichi retribuiti di trasferimento veicoli in tutta Italia, con un’organizzazione flessibile e spese vive rimborsate.

👉Iscriviti qui per accedere agli incarichi:

DriiveMe è la piattaforma leader europea nel trasferimento di veicoli. Ogni mese vengono proposti più di 20.000 incarichi retribuiti alla nostra community di autisti con partita iva in tutta Italia.

I grandi operatori del settore automobilistico si affidano a DriiveMe per spostare i loro veicoli: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar e molti altri.

In tutta Italia, centinaia di aziende hanno bisogno di spostare veicoli da un punto A a un punto B. Ogni giorno pubblicano le loro richieste su DriiveMe per proporre questi incarichi alla community DriiveMe Partner.

In cosa consiste un incarico DriiveMe?

È semplice: come autosta con partita iva, guidi un veicolo da un punto A a un punto B. Ecco come funziona:

  1. Crei il tuo account sudriiveme.com.

  2. Accedi agli incarichi disponibili nella tua zona.

  3. Consulti il tragitto, il compenso e le condizioni di ogni incarico.

  4. Prenoti in pochi clic gli incarichi che desideri svolgere.

  5. Il giorno dell’incarico, ti presenti al punto di partenza, ritiri il veicolo e lo consegni al punto di arrivo.

  6. Una volta convalidato l'incarico, ricevi automaticamente il pagamento nel primo periodo utile tra le tre scadenze mensili previste ogni 10 giorni

Perché diventare autista con partita iva con DriiveMe Partner?

  • Entrate aggiuntive: ogni incarico è retribuito, con un compenso noto in anticipo.

  • Organizzazione flessibile: scegli liberamente gli incarichi che desideri svolgere.

  • Spese di viaggio rimborsate: carburante e pedaggi sono rimborsati secondo le condizioni dell’incarico.

  • Piattaforma semplice e intuitiva: consultazione, prenotazione e gestione degli incarichi online.

  • Incarichi in tutta Italia: ogni giorno vengono pubblicate nuove opportunità.

Quanto posso guadagnare?

Il tuo fatturato dipende dal numero di incarichi che decidi di svolgere.

Ogni incarico prevede un compenso specifico, definito in base al tragitto, al numero di chilometri e alla complessità del trasporto.

Prima di prenotare un incarico, conosci tutte le informazioni essenziali: luogo di partenza, luogo di arrivo, compenso e condizioni di presa in carico. Sei libero di prenotare solo gli incarichi che ti interessano.

Profilo ricercato

Per entrare a far parte di DriiveMe Partner, idealmente devi:

  • avere una patente di guida valida;

  • disporre di partita iva o essere disposto ad aprirla;

  • essere serio, puntuale e preciso;

  • rispettare le procedure di ritiro e consegna dei veicoli;

  • essere disponibile a svolgere incarichi occasionali nella tua zona o in altre parti d’Italia.

Iscriviti ora

Le iscrizioni degli autisti sono centralizzate sulla pagina ufficiale DriiveMe.

jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You'll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit—an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor's degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company recognized as one of the best big companies to work for, as well as one of the best places to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

This position works within the Abbott Cancer Diagnostics business.

We're empowering smarter medical and economic decision-making to help transform the way people manage their health at all stages of life. Every day, diagnostic solutions help clinicians and care teams make informed decisions for patients across a broad range of health conditions, including cancer.

As a Revenue Cycle Coverage and Claims Associate II, you'll support accurate and timely insurance reimbursement by independently resolving complex eligibility, claim, denial, and payment issues. You'll use Epic, payer portals, clearinghouse tools, and other systems to manage escalations, maintain accurate account information, and help move claims toward resolution. Working hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. CST.


What You'll Work On

  • Independently verify patient insurance eligibility and coverage, research discrepancies, and update demographics, financial information, and guarantor details.
  • Review, edit, and submit claims and appeals; correct rejected claims from claim scrubbers, clearinghouses, or payers; and provide supporting documentation as needed.
  • Analyze denials, underpayments, unpaid aging claims, and reimbursement issues using federal, state, payer, and internal guidelines to determine appropriate next steps.
  • Manage complex claim escalations, bulk projects, claim edit and follow-up work queues, CRM support, and workflow validation related to new products or process changes.
  • Document actions accurately, maintain HIPAA confidentiality, meet quality and turnaround standards, and partner with internal teams and payers to drive timely claim resolution.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED).
  • One (1) or more years of experience in a revenue cycle role and three (3) or more years of experience in medical billing, claims, and/or insurance processing.
  • Extensive and current knowledge of government, managed care, and commercial insurance claim submission requirements, reimbursement guidelines, and denial reason codes.
  • Knowledge of medical terminology, health insurance terminology, and electronic health record (EHR) systems.
  • Proficiency with computer systems and keyboarding, with strong attention to detail, organization, problem-solving, and quality output.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a changing environment while communicating professionally with payers, clients, and internal teams.
  • Ability to work Monday through Friday during normal business hours aligned to 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. CST
  • Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Related Associate's degree or medical billing certification.
  • Five (5) or more years of experience in the medical or insurance billing field.
  • Experience with Epic or another electronic health record (EHR) application.

jobs.excerpt: Are you early in your Project Management career and looking for a role with a runway for growth?
jobs.description:
Are you early in your Project Management career and looking for a role with a runway for growth? Do you thrive in fast-paced, complex environments where no two days are the same?

We are looking for an ambitious, highly organised, and proactive Associate/Junior Project Manager to join our Product & Technology PMO team.

Working alongside experienced PMs, you’ll balance core PMO governance with hands-on ownership of your own lightweight projects.

You won't just sit on the sidelines. You'll learn directly from senior practitioners. With plenty of room to take on bigger initiatives, expand your technical scope, and grow your PM skills.

What the role involves

  • Lead Lightweight Projects: Manage small initiatives end-to-end keeping scope, timelines, and quality aligned using agile, right-sized PM practices.
  • Drive Governance & Accountability: Maintain decision, action, risk, and issue logs. You’ll proactively follow up with team members across the business to ensure commitments stay on schedule.
  • Craft Clear Stakeholder Reporting: Help paint the picture of portfolio health by gathering updates and maintaining clear dashboards for business leads and senior executives.
  • Run Effective Meetings: Facilitate regular project huddles, document key decisions, and ensure our PMO tools remain the single source of truth.
  • Support PMO Operations: Help refine team administration, manage intake requests, and keep our digital workspaces pristine.
  • 1+ Year of Experience: Hands-on exposure within a project management, PMO, or operations role (preferably within a technology-led environment or software function).
  • Remote Pro: Comfortable managing your time independently, prioritising tasks in a busy environment, and collaborating virtually across multiple channels.
  • Confident Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the confidence to deal with stakeholders at all levels of the business.
  • Detail & Organisation: Exceptional organisational habits, high standards for data accuracy, and a proactive mindset; you flag risks before they become roadblocks.
  • Tech & Tool Savvy: Practical experience with project management software familiarity with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides), and a foundational understanding of the Software Delivery Lifecycle (SDLC).
  • PM Certifications (Bonus!): CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation, or equivalent formal project management training is a plus!

How we'll look after you

We take good care of our people - and that means more than just a pay packet. Whatever your role, you'll get a range of benefits, including:

  • 25 days' holiday (plus bank holidays), as well as an extra day after you've been with us for three, five and 10 years. We also have a scheme to help you buy extra holiday if you want to.
  • An extra day's paid leave each year to volunteer for a cause close to your community or your heart.
  • Big moment day - an extra day’s paid leave for a moment that matters to you - like getting married, moving house or welcoming a new addition to the family (human or furry!)
  • Bonus scheme - you'll get a stake in our success and a chance to add to your annual earnings.
  • Help saving for your retirement - we'll match your company pension contributions up to 6% and you can contribute through salary sacrifice.
  • Supportive and progressive people policies - we’re proud to have a range of policies to support people in their lives in and outside work, including enhanced family leave and policies to promote flexibility, inclusion and progression. We believe you shouldn’t have to wait to join us to know what to expect from us, which is why we share this overview of the policies we have in place to support families and carers. If there's something you want to understand more about, just ask - it won’t make a difference to your application.
  • A healthcare cash plan - giving you money back for a range of medical expenses and fast access to doctor's appointments.
  • Car lease scheme - you can buy a brand new electric or hybrid car through our leasing partner, and pay for it through salary sacrifice.
  • Wellbeing support - including a 24/7 assistance programme for you and your family.
  • Financial Wellbeing – Access Stream, our app for managing your finances, pay, rewards and benefits all in one place
  • Access to lots of discounts - including 15% off with Reach's very own online marketplace, Yimbly, where you can buy everything from homewares to beauty products.

jobs.excerpt: About SpokeoSpokeo is a people intelligence platform that helps over 18 million monthly visitors reconnect with friends, reunite with families, and build trust in new relationships.
jobs.description:
About Spokeo

Spokeo is a people intelligence platform that helps over 18 million monthly visitors reconnect with friends, reunite with families, and build trust in new relationships. Thousands of companies also trust Spokeo's 60 billion public records to improve customer research, help verify information, and prevent fraud.

Founded in 2006, Spokeo has built a dedicated, remote-first team with an average tenure of 6.9 years. Comparably has recognized it as a Best Company for Compensation, Employee Happiness, Perks and Benefits, Support for Women, Work-Life Balance, and CEO Leadership.

About This Opportunity

Every Spokeo search result depends on one decision: do these records describe the same person, and how sure are we? You will build the models that make that call, on messy data from many vendors and public sources, where there is no answer key to check against.

You will own a modeling problem from the first question to the production release, and you will see your work change what customers see. The Data Science team is small, so you work directly with the Director of Data Science and the product owners. If you like designing the test as much as building the model, and you want to mentor teammates as the team grows, this is the place to do it.

What You'll Do:

Rough share of your time, subject to change.

  • 35%: Build and improve the models that match records and score how confident we are in each result. You will choose the approach, train it, test it honestly on held-out data, and ship it.

  • 20%: Design the labels and the measurement. Decide what to hand-check, build the evaluation sets, and estimate how often we are right when a full answer key does not exist. This includes using AI models to help label at scale, and checking them against human judgment.

  • 15%: Take models to production on AWS, with ML engineering and DevOps. That covers the retrain schedule, the model registry, and a record of where every model and its data came from.

  • 10%: Review each data build before it ships. Find what changed, catch regressions, and explain it in plain language to product and sales partners.

  • 10%: Work with the Product Owner to turn findings into stories with clear targets, and defend the priority of the next research spike.

  • 10%: Document your methods, review teammates' code, and take part in the DS/ML working group.

Tools. What you will work with: Python, SQL, Spark, AWS SageMaker, Databricks, and MLflow.

Challenges. Noisy and incomplete records, no large hand-labeled set to lean on, and opt-out and retention rules that every model must respect.

People. The Director of Data Science, product owners, ML engineers, DevOps, and the DS/ML working group.

Who You Are:

What you have done matters more than the tools you have touched. Equivalent experience counts.

  • Required: 6+ years of applied data science, though what you have shipped matters more than the count.

  • Required: A Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field is expected, and a master’s is preferred, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Taken a model from idea to production in a cloud setting (AWS SageMaker, Databricks, MLflow, or similar), monitored it, and measured how it performed after launch.

  • Worked with very large datasets (100 million rows or more) using Spark or a similar tool, with Python and SQL.

  • Judged whether a model is good when no clean answer key exists, for example by sampling and hand-checking results, and said how confident you are in the number.

  • Told a real improvement from noise, and explained the result, its limits, and the tradeoffs in plain language to engineers and product owners alike.

  • Kept a model healthy as its data changed: knowing when labels and models have gone out of date and need refreshing, and writing the process down so a teammate can pick it up.

  • Handled personal data responsibly, following opt-out, retention, and lineage rules without being reminded.

  • Experience matching or de-duplicating records, using AI to help label data, graph methods, or turning a raw model score into a confidence a product team can act on, is a plus.

Working at Spokeo

Our mission is to advance transparency, and to achieve that goal, we rally around six core values: listening with empathy, understanding the why, clarifying with data, innovating to learn, collaborating to achieve, and insisting on quality.

As a remote-first company, we can hire team members in the following US states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, KY, MD, MI, MO, NJ, NV, NC, PA, SC, SD, TX, VA, WA, or WY.

In addition to a highly competitive base salary, our generous benefits include:

  • annual bonus program

  • stock options

  • 401K matching

  • 100% medical/dental/vision coverage

  • unlimited PTO

  • mental health resources

  • paid home office equipment

  • fitness reimbursements

  • support paying for courses

  • and more

We extend written offers to candidates who successfully complete their selection process. Offers will depend on several factors, including, but not limited to, marketplace competition, job leveling, experience, and skills.

Privacy Notice for Candidates:

Spokeo is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status. Spokeo fosters a business culture where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best products, and be relevant in a rapidly changing world.

Recruiters or staffing agencies: Spokeo is not obligated to compensate any external recruiter or search firm who presents a candidate or their resume or profile to a Spokeo employee without 1) a current, fully executed agreement on file, and 2) being assigned to the open position (as a search) via our applicant tracking solution.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Our Hiring Process

Spokeo may use artificial intelligence-enabled tools to support portions of the recruiting process. These tools may help our recruiting team organize, review, and summarize application materials, candidate experience, and interview information. They may also identify potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials for further human review.

AI-enabled tools assist our recruiting team but do not replace human judgment. Employment decisions are made by people based on a candidate's qualifications and the role's requirements.

In this role, you will support a U.S. personal injury law firm while working remotely within a structured, outcomes-focused environment.

About the Role

As a Case Manager – Personal Injury (Pre-Litigation), you will take ownership of an assigned caseload from intake through settlement or transfer to litigation. You will be the central point of coordination between injured clients, medical providers, insurance adjusters, demand writers, and supervising attorneys.

Your work will directly influence how efficiently cases progress and how supported clients feel throughout what can be a stressful process. This is a strong fit for someone who already understands U.S. plaintiff-side personal injury work and can independently manage priorities while knowing when attorney involvement is needed.

The working schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time.

Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned portfolio of personal injury cases from intake through demand, settlement, or transfer to litigation.
  • Keep clients consistently informed about case status, medical treatment, upcoming steps, and outstanding requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage pre-litigation matters from intake through medical treatment, demand preparation, and settlement.
  • Experience communicating directly with injured clients, medical providers, and insurance adjusters.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to communicate with clients professionally and empathetically.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple active cases, deadlines, documentation requirements, and competing priorities.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting a California-based personal injury law firm, including familiarity with California claims, liability investigations, and settlement workflows.
  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in Legal Studies, Paralegal Studies, or a related field.
  • Experience preparing files for demand writers, including organizing medical records, bills, medical summaries, and supporting documentation.
  • Experience managing a high-volume personal injury caseload.

About the Role

We are seeking an AI-fluent Customer Reference Program Manager to build and run Bonterra’s AI-first customer reference program within Commercial AI. You will own live reference requests, Champion HQ, and Peerbound, helping sellers advance active opportunities, especially New Logo / New Sale deals, through relevant customer conversations, contextualized one-pagers, and case studies.

You will shape how Bonterra combines customer insight, commercial judgment, and AI to deliver the right proof at the right moment in a sales cycle. This means designing repeatable processes and using AI agents and automation to triage requests, surface relevant matches, draft proof packages, and reduce manual work, with human oversight of customer relationships, consent, and approvals. You will also help shape the program’s 2027 operating model, evaluating where Champion HQ, Peerbound, and internally built capabilities deliver the greatest seller impact and return.

Reporting into Commercial AI, this is a hands-on individual contributor role with program ownership and no direct reports. You own the reference layer; broader advocacy remains with Customer Advocacy. Success means timely fulfillment, relevant matches, seller adoption, and measurable contribution to deal outcomes, while protecting customer relationships.


What You’ll Do


  • Own live deal support. Manage reference requests from intake and qualification through matching, customer outreach, scheduling, briefing, and follow-up. Maintain coverage through the transition, clarify the buyer’s question and deal deadline, and close the loop with sellers on what helped the opportunity progress.
  • Build a repeatable operating process. Define request types, priorities, required information, service-level agreements, escalation paths, and ownership. Establish a baseline for demand and fulfillment effort, document the workflow, and remove recurring bottlenecks before automating it.
  • Make matching relevant to social good. Match on nonprofit mission and NTEE code/category, segment, products in use, competitor displaced, AI and technology stack (including Built With data), buyer persona, and geography. Identify coverage gaps with Sales and Customer Success, and qualify reference customers against real deal needs.
  • Run Champion HQ. Maintain the roster, profiles, matching rules, request workflow, and Salesforce-connected ROI reporting; resolve automation and data gaps with the appropriate system owners. Validate the agreed reporting population: Opportunity Type = New Logo and Opportunity Subtype = New Sale.
  • Turn Peerbound insights into deal-ready proof. Mine available customer voice sources to surface relevant evidence and potential references. Maintain source traceability, approvals, and freshness, and deliver approved proof where sellers can find and use it.
  • Own the AI-first reference workflow. Design, test, and run AI-assisted triage, matching shortlists, first-draft assets, and proof assembly, partnering with Commercial AI to turn repeatable processes into reliable workflows. Define source requirements, review checkpoints, exception handling, and quality checks, then measure time saved, rework, and seller impact to continuously improve performance.
  • Protect customer trust. Personally manage customer asks and coordinate with relationship owners on consent, availability, and participation limits. Track usage and fatigue, respect restrictions on quotes and logos, and keep customer commitments and legal approvals under human control.
  • Connect operations to commercial outcomes. Track fill rate, time-to-fulfill, seller utilization and adoption, reference utilization and fatigue, and influenced pipeline and ARR. Partner with RevOps to assess win-rate and sales-cycle differences on referenced deals as volume permits, distinguishing observed influence from proven lift.
  • Recommend the right stack and 2027 operating model. Evaluate Champion HQ and Peerbound using actual usage, seller impact, fulfillment effort, cost, and ROI. Recommend whether to retain, reshape, replace, or bring capabilities in-house, accounting for contract timing, integration and maintenance effort, migration risk, and the level of support each segment needs.
  • Build adoption with your partners. Work with Sales, Customer Advocacy, Customer Success, Product Marketing, RevOps, Legal, and Commercial AI to maintain clear handoffs and a shared view of reference readiness. Enable sellers on the request path and reusable proof, and use their feedback to improve coverage and fulfillment.

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of relevant B2B SaaS experience in customer references, advocacy operations, sales enablement, or commercial programs, including direct ownership of reference requests supporting active sales opportunities.
  • Hands-on experience operating a reference platform such as Champion HQ or ReferenceEdge and a customer-proof platform such as Peerbound or a close equivalent, including profiles, workflows, permissions, and seller delivery.
  • Fluent in Salesforce opportunity fields, report filters, and data validation, with the ability to connect reference activity to opportunities and recognize gaps in reporting.
  • A proven process builder who has turned an inconsistent request workflow into clear intake rules, matching criteria, service levels, documentation, and reporting.
  • AI-first and fluent in applying generative AI, knowledge bases, and workflow automation to day-to-day program operations. You can demonstrate workflows you have designed or improved, explain how you validate outputs, and measure quality, time saved, and business impact.
  • Strong customer judgment and relationship skills, including making thoughtful requests, managing expectations, and balancing sales urgency with customer readiness and consent.
  • Clear, concise writing skills and the ability to turn customer evidence into useful seller briefs and one-pagers without overstating results.
  • Able to own priorities independently, work through incomplete data and evolving processes, and bring cross-functional partners with you as the program changes.


Bonus Points For

  • Experience in nonprofit or social-good markets, including mission-based segmentation and NTEE taxonomies.
  • Experience with Gong or other call intelligence tools, content repositories, and review-site content as sources of customer proof.
  • Experience building reference ROI reporting or evaluating software vendors against an in-house operating model.
  • Experience connecting AI workflows to CRM, call intelligence, or content systems through no-code tools or integration requirements.

DysrupIT is a consulting-led technology firm. Company Culture

At DysrupIT, success isn’t measured in headcount placed or hours billed, it’s measured in outcomes delivered. We’re a team that takes ownership of the work, stays curious about problems beyond our immediate scope, and builds relationships meant to grow, not just renew or end. We invest in our people with the training and support they need to grow their careers, and we back a culture where everyone, regardless of role, is encouraged to notice opportunities, ask one more question, and help lead the story for our clients, not just deliver it.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior AI Developer to build agentic solutions on Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry), along with the reusable framework that sits underneath them. You will join our client, an AI-native Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform consultancy based in Melbourne that delivers business applications and agentic solutions for clients across financial services, property, government and legal.

The work covers orchestrating agents, a governed knowledge repository, and shared skill sets and tools, all integrated with Dataverse and the Power Platform so the work lands in the applications people already use.

A typical build combines agents that run routine steps autonomously, co-pilot steps where a person reviews and approves, and human-led steps where judgement stays with the professional. You will make that governance model real in code, with approval gates, audit trails and evaluation.

  • Level: Senior
  • Location: Philippines and India

  • Work schedule: PHT or IST
  • Reports to: AI Practice Lead

Job Responsibilities

  • Agentic framework: Design and build multi-agent systems on Foundry Agent Service using Microsoft Agent Framework (Python and .NET), including orchestration, hand-offs, tool calling and long-running work.

  • Skill sets and tools: Package reusable skills and tools (Foundry toolboxes, MCP servers, Azure Functions) so new agents inherit capability rather than rebuild it.
  • Dataverse and Power Platform: Use Dataverse as the system of record and for agent state, connect through the Dataverse Web API, MCP and custom connectors, trigger Power Automate flows, and surface agents in Copilot Studio, Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

  • Evaluation and observability: Set up tracing, evaluators, regression datasets and red-team tests, and monitor quality, latency and token cost in production.
  • Security: Give each agent its own Microsoft Entra identity, use managed identities and Key Vault, and design for private networking, content safety and data residency.
  • Delivery: Deploy with infrastructure as code (Bicep or Terraform) and CI/CD through GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, across dev, test and production.

  • 6+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years building LLM-based applications.
  • Hands-on experience delivering solutions on Azure AI Foundry, including agents, model deployments, Azure AI Search and evaluation.
  • Strong Python and C#/.NET skills, with solid engineering habits such as testing, code review, Git and CI/CD.
  • Production experience with agentic patterns, including tool use, planning, memory, multi-agent orchestration and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Working knowledge of Azure services such as Functions, Container Apps, API Management, Key Vault, Entra ID and Application Insights.
  • Working knowledge of Dataverse (tables, security model, Web API) and how the Power Platform connects to external services.
  • Experience applying guardrails and evaluation to AI systems in production, not just prototyping them.

  • Fully remote work arrangement.

Description

At Ledgebrook, we’re building a next-generation insurance infrastructure - fast, smart, and scalable - and are looking for a Director of Actuarial Services to join Stonehaven Specialty Insurance Company, Ledgebrook’s new third-party hybrid fronting carrier.

This role reports to the Chief Risk Officer and shifts the traditional actuarial mandate from end-to-end pricing/reserving to validating and relying on third-party bordereaux data, reserving gross/ceded/net independently, and reserving/capitalizing the re-assumed tail above treaty caps to full-carrier standards.

About the Role

Stonehaven is seeking a Director of Actuarial Services to validate third-party bordereaux data, establish loss-development assumptions before each program onboards, reserve gross/ceded/net independently, and support the Reserve Committee and the annual statement of opinion. The successful candidate will bring deep P&C actuarial reserving experience and direct experience with bordereaux-based or third-party-sourced data.

﻿What You'll Do:

  • Validate third-party/bordereaux data before relying on it for analysis or financial reconciliation, in coordination with Underwriting, Reinsurance, Finance, and IT.
  • Establish ELR and expected development patterns before each program onboards; run quarterly actual-vs-expected against original assumptions.
  • Reserve gross, ceded, and net independently; evaluate and reserve the re-assumed tail above treaty caps.
  • Build the actuarial “toolbox” (ISO, RAA, S&P Schedule P) for loss development, trend, and PY/AY/AQ adjustments on thin or ramping program data.
  • Oversee DUA pricing and monitor actual-vs-expected results by program; produce the quarterly program “report card.”
  • Support the Reserve Committee in a lead technical and advisory capacity.

About you

We love working with people who are eager to learn constantly and genuinely excited about the chaotic, rewarding process of building a company from the ground up.

You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • A Strong Moral Compass: You believe in doing the right thing, period. We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for toxic behaviors.
  • Customer-First Empathy: You are passionate about delivering an exceptional experience to everyone you work with, both inside and outside the company.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You naturally question the status quo and love finding innovative ways to solve problems.
  • A Growth Mindset: You possess a hunger for continuous learning and want to constantly expand your skillset.
  • Urgency & Prioritization: You can pivot quickly and balance the need to get things right with the speed of getting them done right now.
  • A Solution-Oriented Outlook: When things go wrong, you don't look for blame—you immediately focus on how to fix it.
  • Transparent Communication: You value honesty, clarity, and open feedback.
  • Team-First Energy: You want to win together as a high-performing team and actively build connections across our remote locations.

Requirements

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of P&C actuarial experience, including reserving for both retained and ceded business.
  • Direct experience with bordereaux-based or third-party-sourced data (MGA, program, or reinsurance actuarial work).
  • Experience reserving re-assumed/tail exposure above treaty caps, not only quota-share slices.
  • Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society (ACAS).

Nice to Haves:

  • Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS) is preferred.
  • Prior fronting-carrier or program-actuarial experience specifically.
  • Experience serving as or coordinating with an appointed/independent actuary.

Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options.
  • Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage.

Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location.
  • Employees in this position are eligible to participate in Ledgebrook’s equity incentive program.

The Cloud Platform Engineering team operates as a strategic enabler for the enterprise, delivering a secure, scalable, and fully automated cloud foundation that supports mission‑critical workloads across the organization. This is a remote position. In this role you would work Monday through Friday normal business hours and can be a remote position if you live in the following states only: AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, ND, NE, NH, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV & WY.


Your pay and benefits (Total Rewards) are important components of your Journey at Banner Health. Banner Health offers a variety of benefit plans to help you and your family. We provide health and financial security options, so you can focus on being the best at what you do and enjoying your life.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is a key member within the Cloud Platform Engineering Organization. Leads cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize Banner Health’s multi-cloud infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and OCI. The role helps lead the development of Banner’s long-term cloud strategy, ensuring scalability, security, resiliency, and cost-effectiveness across the organization’s cloud systems. Works closely with the Cloud Platform Engineering & Operations and Network Operations departments, Digital Engineering and support stakeholders across departments to lead cloud adoption and migration, enhance cloud maturity, improve performance, implement best practices, and drive cloud-based innovation. Serves as a subject-matter expert and trusted advisor, providing guidance and working closely with IT partners and business units to ensure successful solution delivery on cloud platforms. This position works at the intersection of Digital Transformation and Cloud Modernization to ensure that Banner’s cloud capabilities align with business needs and scale to meet future growth.


CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Provides strategic and technical oversight in developing, managing, and optimizing multi-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, OCI). Leads cloud architecture and governance initiatives ensuring scalability and compliance, as well as partnering with Cybersecurity on security, across all platforms.


2. Designs, develops, and oversees the implementation of service offerings for platform engineering.


3. Serves as a cloud-native technical resource to determine business needs and recommend solutions across the broader cloud and platform engineering ecosystems. Provides thought leadership in cloud native technologies, DevOps, and platform engineering. Provides insights into the partner ecosystem, advancements and emerging technologies related to Platform Engineering, Automation and Observability.


4. Implements and maintains secure cloud connectivity solutions (AWS Direct Connect, Azure Express Route, Oracle Fastconnect or Google Cloud Interconnect).


5. Aligns solutions with standards and best practices, working with cross-functional engineering and business teams. Collaborates with IT team to integrate cloud solutions with on-premises infrastructure that drives innovation.


6. Ensures resiliency by managing critical disaster recovery and response plans for cloud outages, security events and incidents. Maintains comprehensive documentation, disaster recovery plans, and performs ongoing gap analysis to optimize cloud performance.


7. Creates and maintains cloud architecture diagrams. Develops and delivers proof of concepts. Contributes to developing the best internal practices and new, innovative, hands-on service offerings that are put into production.


8. Designs and implements automation tools to enable efficient cloud services deployment and meet business demands.


9. Provides leadership and mentorship to cloud engineers, ensuring adherence to cloud best practices.
